title: Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained — both on the job and through formal programs led by a world-class Sales team — to take on your next role as a closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will build and work a portfolio of target accounts for our EMEA business in France: researching each account for commercial signal, prioritising which contacts to approach and in what order, and running a connected, multi-touch outbound motion that generates qualified pipeline rather than one-off meetings.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: if you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You're excited by AI: you'll use cutting-edge AI tools every day and sell some of the most advanced AI in the physical operations space.
  • You think several moves ahead: you'd rather build a real relationship across an account than force a single contact to a decision they're not ready to make.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: one day you'll be researching a transport operator, the next a food distribution centre. Our best reps dig into the businesses they support to make a sharper case for why Samsara matters to them specifically.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: in this role you will get hung up on and told no. You need the resilience to prepare, call again, and adjust.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go further than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Research target accounts before outreach — pulling commercial signal out of public information (financials, news, hiring activity, compliance or safety pressure) to build a specific, defensible point of view on where Samsara adds value.
  • Build and prioritise an account-level contact plan, identifying who to approach first across a range of stakeholders (e.g. MD, Operations/Transport Manager, Compliance/H&S, Finance) and being able to justify that choice.
  • Run a connected, multi-touch outbound motion across phone, email and LinkedIn — using early conversations to gather information and multi-thread the account, not just to book a meeting at any cost.
  • Write personalised, researched outreach (including cold emails) that carries a specific point of view into every call, rather than working from a generic script.
  • Read what a contact gives you on the call and adapt in real time — including recognising when the right move is to gather information and position a follow-up with someone else, rather than push for a meeting the contact can't actually commit to.
  • Keep meticulous account and contact records in Salesforce.
  • Become a product expert and represent the Samsara brand at trade shows and events.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1–3 years professional experience, ideally in customer-facing roles
  • 6–12 months experience in a sales or equivalent target driven role
  • Highly motivated and committed, with a strong desire to work in target-driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding targets in previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Curious, and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French
  • AI literacy and ability to showcase examples of leveraging AI in your work

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Comfort turning unstructured information (an annual report, a website, a news article) into a clear commercial argument
  • Experience multi-threading or navigating multiple stakeholders within a single sale
  • A genuine willingness to prepare — to research and write — before a call, rather than relying on improvising well under pressure
  • Experience in closing-sales roles or similar target driven environment
  • A proven track record of achievement beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space.

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility. With emphasis on continued professional development, training doesn't stop after onboarding — we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and competitors, develop hard skills, and work with mentors to progress through three levels:

  • ADR I — focus on inbound leads: a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with interested prospects. Learning opportunities include call sessions with senior Sales team members, tool training (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, and objection handling.
  • ADR II — work on top-of-funnel movement, creating high-quality sales engagements, and supporting Account Executives. Enrolled in specialised training including professional writing, persona-based messaging, cold calling 2.0, and AE collaboration.
  • ADR III — work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers. Partner on large accounts, implement territory plans, join weekly strategy meetings, and schedule/attend customer demos, alongside a mentorship program ahead of an AE interview.

Please submit an English CV with your application.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Account Director, Influencer Marketing
descriptionHtml:
At Viral Nation, we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world’s fastest-growing digital brands. Viral Nation offers a fluid, creative, and growth-oriented environment that will support your ambitions to apply your talents in an open, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We’re driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we’re just getting started.

While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar!

Position Overview:

Viral Nation is seeking a dedicated Account Director with a robust mix of influencer marketing, social media, analytics, and content marketing experience. By nature, they are a confident, courageous and strategic leader who excels in building bulletproof relationships with both their clients and their internal team. They are known to bring value to every conversation, provide consultative direction to their clients, and know when and how to challenge the status quo within our ever-changing industry. 

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the day-to-day primary point of contact for key clients, owning strategic relationships and ensuring consistent alignment to goals, KPIs, and performance expectations.
  • Identify, develop, and surface growth and expansion opportunities across accounts, partnering with CSLs and internal teams to drive revenue and long-term client value.
  • Lead strategic planning, quarterly business reviews, success measurement, and account vision-setting, ensuring narratives are insight-driven, performance-focused, and tied to client impact.
  • Oversee end-to-end campaign execution across influencer, community management, production, paid social, and events, ensuring flawless delivery across all products and services.
  • Lead and oversee creator communications for Macro & Mega tiers, ensuring white-glove talent management, clear expectations, and strong partnership execution.
  • Manage campaign pacing, KPIs, optimization efforts, and overall program success to consistently meet or exceed performance benchmarks.
  • Drive elevated brand storytelling, creative ideation, insights, and analytics, pushing teams to deliver innovative, differentiated work across a client portfolio.
  • Lead the BI partnership kickoff for all key accounts, aligning on measurement frameworks, KPIs, reporting timelines, and success metrics in collaboration with the CSL.
  • Own the wrap-report workflow, coordinating with BI, reviewing all reports for accuracy and strategic alignment, and ensuring insights are clearly communicated to clients.
  • Provide leadership, guidance and escalation support to Account Supervisors and Account Managers, fostering accountability and growth.
  • Coach and develop direct reports by providing regular feedback, training, and guidance, fostering a collaborative team culture that drives strong performance, career growth, and high-quality client delivery.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Creative, Finance, and BI to deliver integrated, scalable solutions for clients.
  • Act as the internal advocate for the client’s POV, ensuring their needs, priorities, and feedback are clearly represented across teams while balancing those inputs with what’s required to deliver successful, high-performing campaigns.
  • Maintain accurate Kantata project data, ensuring budgets, resourcing, timelines, and tasks are consistently reviewed and optimized.
  • Identify and implement AI-driven efficiencies across planning, forecasting, and client-facing materials to improve speed, quality, and scalability.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • 6+ years of experience in digital, social, and influencer marketing across integrated service offerings, managing multiple client portfolios with strong business outcomes.
  • Proven expertise in strategic planning, business insights, and performance measurement, using data to guide client recommendations, forecasting, and account growth.
  • Advanced knowledge of influencer marketing and production strategy, including paid and organic tactics, contract negotiations, content development, and campaign measurement.
  • Strong ability to lead high-level client relationships, ensuring alignment with goals, long-term partnership success, and consistent delivery.
  • Demonstrated success in revenue growth and account expansion through strategic recommendations and opportunity identification.
  • Effective people leader with experience coaching and developing teams to meet client expectations and performance standards.
  • Exceptional project management and cross-functional collaboration skills, partnering with planning, creative, production, and media teams to drive results.
  • Expert grasp of social platforms, amplification strategies, and cross-channel integration.
  • Proficient with influencer management tools (e.g., CreatorIQ, Klear, Tagger, Upfluence), social management platforms (Sprout, Sprinklr, Hootsuite), CRM tools (HubSpot), and presentation software (MS Office, Google Workspace).
  • Familiarity with creative tools (Photoshop, Canva, motion graphics) and relevant certifications (Facebook Blueprint, Twitter Flight School, Google Analytics) are a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

Privacy Policy:

By submitting your application, you acknowledge your data will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy. 

Compensation Philosophy:
At Viral Nation, compensation is structured, performance-led, and market-aligned. Pay decisions are intentional, based on role requirements, performance, and market alignment by country, and are set to maintain internal pay equity across comparable roles and levels.
Compensation progression is tied to demonstrated performance, expanded scope, and sustained contribution over time, not tenure alone. Employee compensation is reviewed regularly through formal performance reviews and check-ins to ensure alignment with role expectations and impact.   AI in Recruitment:   Viral Nation does not use AI-enabled tools to screen, assess, rank, or select candidates – our hiring teams make all hiring decisions. AI note-taking tools may be used during interviews.

DEI Commitment:

Viral Nation is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our agency. Viral Nation welcomes applications from people with visible and non-visible disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruiting and selection process.

title: Account Executive - Cologne/ Düsseldorf
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the Role

We're looking for our first hospitality fan Sales person in NRW. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market.

In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more.

What You’ll Do

Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate:

  • Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about

  • Create engaging ways to show our product

  • Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter

  • Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully

  • Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection

  • Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel

  • Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants’ needs to create our own path

What You’ll Need

You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry:

  • Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations

  • Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail

  • Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested

  • Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality

  • You are comfortable working in both English and German

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary & Uncapped Commission

  • Flexible time off

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Account Executive Enterprise DACH
descriptionHtml:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Own a specific geographical region or country within the EMEA market which includes target-accounts and an existing book of business that has companies with 3000+ employees. Primary focus is on hunting new business opportunities, building sales pipeline, and driving growth within the ENT sector. Upscaling existing account base through expansion and upsell, leveraging our Extended Access Management Identity.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Expectations of this role

This is a field-based sales role. That means you are expected to be regularly engaged in customer-facing activities, including in-person meetings, events, and other travel as required to effectively support your territory.

Your primary work location will be your home office, but your role requires a lot of mobility and flexibility. Travel within your assigned territory, and occasionally outside of it, will be a part of your job, and you are responsible for managing your schedule in a way that works for the company and you.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

 

What we're looking for:

  • You can communicate in English and German fluently

  • 5+ years of SaaS sales experience, preferably in security with a focus on Enterprise accounts OR top performance in MidMarket/Commercial and ready to step up.

  • Familiarity with the DACH region.

  • Demonstrated success in owning and growing a geographical territory or country within the DACH region.

  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and KPIs.

  • Outstanding sales skills in prospecting, pipeline building, strategic account planning, value-based selling, and territory management, with meticulous operating rigor in pipeline management, forecasting, and pacing to target

  • Demonstrated success in upselling & cross-selling to both new customers and across a book of business, and in uncovering customer pain points beyond what's initially shared

  • Proficient skills in business acumen, negotiation, relationship building, communication & presentation skills to C-Suite

  • Demonstrated ability to understand and articulate complex cybersecurity concepts, particularly in Identity and Access Management.

  • Self-motivated, driven, and able to work independently in a remote setting.

Please note that this job description is subject to modifications and is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities.

What you can expect:

    • Contextual Business Understanding & Multithreading: Develop deep insights into the enterprise's structure, key decision-makers, and buying processes. Implement multithreading to engage various stakeholders across departments, ensuring broad influence and deeper engagement.

    • Excellence in Outbound & Pipeline Generation: Leverage a combination of self-generated outreach, BDR collaboration, and marketing-driven initiatives to consistently build a high-quality pipeline.

    • Tailored Discovery & Scoping: Align 1Password’s value to the enterprise's unique challenges through comprehensive discovery and scoping, ensuring that proposed solutions are relevant and impactful at scale.

    • Continuous Improvement via Coaching: Maintain a growth mindset by actively participating in high-quality coaching sessions, driving incremental improvements in sales performance weekly

  • Drive Organic Growth: Identify opportunities to expand and cross-sell 1Password’s solutions within existing accounts by building key stakeholder relationships and leveraging your understanding of Extended Access Management.

  • Engage the Industry: Attend industry events, trade shows, and conferences to represent 1Password, build brand presence and build relationships with potential customers

  • Stay Informed: Stay up to date on cybersecurity trends and developments, particularly in Identity and Access Management, to provide valuable insights to clients and position 1Password as an industry leader.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally:

This approach ensures a comprehensive understanding of the client's business, enhancing account health and expanding long-term value.

  • Focus on Solution-Driven Selling:

    • Implement 1Password methodology to ensure our solutions are strategically aligned with client goals and tailored to their specific needs.

    • Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of client challenges, and position our offerings as impactful, customized solutions that drive value and outcomes.

  • Present and Negotiate:

    • Confidently present to executives, articulating the value proposition of our products and services.

    • Create mutual action plans to align the sales team and prospects on responsibilities, steps and timelines for closing deals.

    • Utilize effective negotiation skills to drive mutually beneficial outcomes.


At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Opportunity

We are looking for hungry and talented sales professionals to help us take our top-line revenue to new heights!

title: Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Sales team at SevenRooms is on a mission to reshape the hospitality industry by empowering operators to take control of their guest relationships. We’re a passionate, high-performing group of go-getters who act as trusted advisors to restaurants and hospitality groups around the world. We take a consultative approach to sales—identifying business gaps, crafting thoughtful solutions, and helping operators reduce reliance on third-party networks. We believe in the power of hospitality, and we’re proud to partner with businesses to streamline operations and deliver magical guest experiences every day.

About the Role

As an Account Executive, you’ll work directly with restaurants and hospitality groups to understand their business needs and recommend the best-fit SevenRooms solutions—from reservations and table management to online ordering and marketing automation. You’ll drive new business by adding operators to the platform and working closely with our onboarding and account teams to ensure a smooth and enthusiastic transition. This role plays a key part in helping hospitality operators thrive, combining strategic thinking, relationship-building, and product knowledge to deliver real impact.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Build and Manage a Sales Pipeline. Identify and engage prospective restaurants and hospitality groups to grow your book of business.
  • Showcase the Platform. Present the value of SevenRooms through compelling demos and conversations that help operators understand how we can support their success.
  • Lead Sales from Start to Finish. Own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and pitching to negotiation, contracting, and go-live support.
  • Deliver Live Product Demos. Conduct live, engaging product walkthroughs both virtually and in person when needed.
  • Be a Trusted Partner. Build strong relationships with prospects and clients, always advocating for their success and acting as a true advisor throughout the process.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 3+ years of experience in hospitality technology sales
  • You’re confident presenting to clients both in person and virtually
  • You’re self-driven and comfortable working independently, whether in the office or remotely
  • You’re tech-savvy and quick to pick up new tools and platforms
  • You’re results-oriented and bring energy and focus to your daily work
  • You’ve worked with tools like Salesforce, Outreach, or similar systems
  • You have a background in hospitality or restaurants (a big plus!)
  • You’re open to occasional travel into key markets to connect with clients face-to-face

Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only

We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using Covey Scout for Inbound from August 21, 2023, through December 21, 2023, and resumed using Covey Scout for Inbound again on June 29, 2024.

The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Results of the audit may be viewed here: Covey

About SevenRooms

In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. What began as a mission to help restaurants better understand and serve their guests evolved into a powerful platform used by merchants around the world.

With best-in-class tools for marketing, operations, and guest experience — all deeply integrated with its industry-leading CRM — SevenRooms empowers operators to drive revenue, streamline operations, and deliver experiences that keep guests coming back.

In 2025, DoorDash acquired SevenRooms to strengthen its in-store strategy and expand its merchant-first offerings. The combination brings together DoorDash’s scale, reach, and digital innovation with SevenRooms’ in-store capabilities to support hospitality businesses across every channel — from discovery and delivery to on-premise dining.

As DoorDash builds out its in-store capabilities, SevenRooms plays a central role in enabling merchants to grow their businesses and connect more meaningfully with guests, whether they’re ordering online or dining in. This move reflects DoorDash’s broader commitment to empowering local businesses, fostering stronger connections between consumers and the places they love, and building technology that meets merchants — and their customers — wherever they are.

descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2.1B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €10k to €300k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

    • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
    • Get In Early: The DACH Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.
    • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.

Minimum Requirements for the role:

  • Winning DNA: Minimum 18 months+ closing experience in an outbound-heavy SaaS environment. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Over-achievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt
  • Native German language speakers

Advantageous:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

At Secfix, we’re at the forefront of automating security compliance in Europe. We help companies get and stay ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, and SOC 2 fast and easy and reduce hundreds of hours of manual work.

Secfix is run by a 100% remote team with hubs in Munich, Berlin and London. We’re a high-performing team looking for passionate, execution-focused, owners to help us automate security and compliance for modern companies and become the European compliance automation leader.

We’ve just raised our $12M Series A and are backed by top VCs, including Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital.

 

About the Role

We’re hiring an SMB Account Executive to run our fast-moving SMB sales motion in the DACH region.

This is a plug-and-play, high-velocity motion — around 80% of your pipeline comes to you inbound or pre-qualified by our BDR team, so most of your time is spent qualifying, demoing, and closing rather than prospecting from scratch.

This is an ideal first AE role for a BDR (ideally already promoted to Senior BDR) with ~1–2 years of experience who is hungry to make the jump into a closing role or an experienced AE who enjoys the high-velocity SMB sales cycle.

What You'll Do:

You will play a big role in one of the biggest levers we have for growing the company: generating demand and closing deals. We don’t (and can’t afford to) micro-manage. We have gathered many best practices and will give you full context on things that work. You will:

  • Own and drive net-new revenue across SMB accounts in DACH, working primarily from inbound and BDR-sourced pipeline (~80%), while self-generating the rest (~20%)

  • Manage the full sales cycle from qualification to close on a fast, ~30-day average sales cycle

  • Run structured discovery and demo calls, qualifying leads efficiently against a clear framework

  • Engage SMB decision-makers (founders, ops leads, and similar)

  • Translate compliance and security topics into clear, fast business value

  • Collaborate closely with the BDR team, product, and onboarding

  • Maintain accurate pipeline and forecasts in HubSpot

  • Share market feedback to help refine SMB qualification, pitch, and playbook

About You:

  • ~1–2 years of experience as a BDR, ideally already promoted to Senior BDR, looking for your first AE role; or an experienced AE who enjoys the high-velocity SMB sales cycle

  • Competitive and hungry to close deals

  • You live sales and are always looking to learn and improve — we’re not looking for a fully “finished” or multi-threading-capable seller, the role will develop that

  • Comfortable operating in a fast, high-volume, demo-driven sales motion

  • Ability to communicate clearly and confidently in German

  • Coachable — you’ll be closely supported and coached by our Head of Sales

  • Familiarity with sales tools (HubSpot, Clay, Apollo) is a plus

  • Munich-based, or willing to be for in-person interview and onboarding stages

Nice-to-have:

  • Some exposure to demo calls or closing, even informally

  • Experience in an early-stage startup environment

  • Academic or extracurricular track record of high achievement (top university, competitive sports, etc.)

  • Exposure to compliance, information security, risk, or GRC topics

What we offer

  • Hybrid-Flexible Work: 2-3 days in our new sales office in Munich and added flexibility where needed.

  • Competitive Salary: Industry-competitive local salaries. We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this philosophy with GitLab.

  • Equity: Generous equity package – we’re all owners of Secfix and beneficiaries of our collective success.

  • Mentorship: We are backed by top VCs and accelerators and have direct access to world-class mentors.

  • Development Budget: €1,000 annual personal development budget.

  • Home office Budget: Home office budget and access to co-working spaces.

  • Holidays: 26 days holiday + local public holidays.

  • Health Insurance: Comprehensive health coverage.

  • Annual Retreat: Annual retreat to build connections and inspire ideas (this year we’re headed to Milan!).

  • Company Events: Company-wide events to build relationships and have some fun!

  • Tech Equipment: Latest tech equipment (MacBook, monitors, headphones).

Interview Process:

  • 30 min - Screening call with Talent Team

  • 30-45 mins - Hiring Manager interview

  • Take-home challenge

title: Account Executive - Specialist Care
descriptionHtml:
🏷️ Title: Account Executive

👫 Department: Found, Commercial. Reporting to the Head of Commercial, Found

💰 Salary: OTE £75,000 - £105,000 (£50,000 - £70,000 base) + equity

🎁 Benefits & Culture: See here

📈 Equity: A very generous EMI share offering

🌴 Holiday: 26 days + bank holidays

💗 Mission: Elevate later life for everybody and build the care sector of the future

💻 Office Policy: Hybrid with a minimum of 2 core office days per week

🌍 Office Location: London Bridge, London, UK

 

🔍 The Opportunity:

Lottie is building the AI operating system for social care. Families find care through our marketplace. Providers use Found to manage enquiries, occupancy and finances, with Eliza, our AI agent, answering family calls and chats on their behalf.

We're opening Found for Specialist Care as a new vertical, alongside Care Home and Home Care, and we need someone to build it. This is a market to create, not a playbook to follow.

You'll own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, shape the messaging, and become our go-to expert on specialist care. You won't start from zero: 7-8 specialist care providers already use Found, plus a pipeline we previously turned away. Product work over the next two quarters will be shaped by what you hear from the market.

You'll sit alongside our Care Home and Home Care sales leads, with direct access to commercial leadership, product and our founder. If you want to own a vertical and prove what you can do with real autonomy, this is the role for you!

 

💻 What does this role involve?

  • Own the full sales cycle for specialist care and supported living providers, from first conversation to close, then hand over cleanly to Customer Success

  • Build the go-to-market for the vertical: test messaging, learn what resonates and iterate on what works

  • Re-engage providers we previously talked to and grow from the existing 7–8 specialist care customers

  • Build and manage your pipeline through outbound (calls, emails, LinkedIn, events) alongside inbound leads

  • Run discovery calls and demos, often with head-office and operational leaders at multi-site providers

  • Negotiate and close deals against MRR targets, with uncapped commission on ARR closed

  • Feed market insight to Product and Engineering as we build out Found for Specialist Care

💪 What problems will you be solving?

  • Opening a market Found hasn't sold into before, so specialist care providers get modern tools that help them support the people they care for

  • Winning in a largely local-authority-funded world, where buying decisions and ROI look different to private-pay care

  • Selling honestly while the product is still evolving, and turning provider feedback into what we build next

  • Building a repeatable sales motion the team can scale as we grow this vertical

  • Being the voice of specialist care providers inside Found, so their needs shape the product

👀 We think you’ll be a great fit if…

  • You're a self-starter who can take a brief and run with it, without a ready-made playbook or an SDR feeding you leads

  • You have at least 12 months of closing experience in a B2B sales role and have consistently hit or exceeded targets

  • You're strong on the phone and comfortable building your own pipeline from outbound

  • You build genuine relationships: empathetic and consultative rather than overly "salesy", and providers warm to you

  • You're comfortable selling to operators who aren't always tech-savvy: you explain value in plain language and never talk down to them

  • You're motivated by targets and commission

  • You're curious about how a new market works and enjoy turning what you learn into messaging and process

  • You're ready to own this vertical for at least 12 months and build something meaningful

  • Bonus: B2B SaaS sales methodology, startup experience, or experience selling into regulated or publicly funded sectors. Care sector experience is not required

Sound like you but not quite 100%? Apply anyway - we're looking for potential and passion, not perfect CV match

 

💔 This role isn’t for you if…

  • You want an established playbook, highly structured processes and constant guidance

  • You're not comfortable with outbound prospecting and have mainly worked inbound leads

  • You're looking for a stepping stone and want to move into something different in 6 months

  • You don't have proven closing experience or a track record of hitting quota

💻Application

We'd love to see a short video (2-3 minutes) answering this question:

Introduce yourself, tell us why you’re interested in Lottie and what makes you a good fit for this role.

We appreciate this takes time. We receive a high volume of applications and this helps us assess you on more than your CV.

🔢 Lottie’s Interview Process

  1. First Interview with Lottie's Talent Acquisition Lead - 20 mins (remote)

  2. Case Study with Tom Frost (Head of Commercial, Found) and a member of the Commercial team - 1h presentation with additional pre-work (remote)

  3. Final interviews with Will Donnelly (Lottie's Co-Founder & CEO) and Tom Frost (Head of Commercial, Found), 1h30 total (in-person)

🤩 Candidate Experience:

  • Pre-Screen & First Interview: You'll receive an email notification, but no specific feedback will be provided at this stage.

  • Case Study: If you are not successful after the assessment, you'll receive constructive feedback via email and be offered a debrief call with our Talent Lead.

  • Final Interview: For final-stage candidates who are not offered the role, we will provide your feedback live via a phone call.

🚀 Meet Lottie

Founded with a mission to build the care sector of the future, Lottie is creating the AI operating system for social care - designed to unlock profitability for care providers and to make finding care as easy as booking a holiday on Airbnb.

Launched in London in July 2021, Lottie has raised over £25m from tier 1 venture capital funds (Accel and General Catalyst) and is widely recognised as one of Europe's fastest growing tech companies. Most recently, Lottie was the acclaimed winner of Deloitte Fast 50, LinkedIn Top Startups, The Sunday Times Tech 2026 and Startups 100.

As of today, Lottie offers three core products:

  • Lottie (B2B2C Marketplace) - Free service that helps families find the UK’s best care homes and home care services.

  • Found by Lottie (B2B Vertical SaaS) - AI-native OS software supporting care providers to effectively manage their enquiries, occupancy and finances. Eliza by Found is our newest Found module. AI agents that handle care home enquiries - so no family goes unanswered. Launch video here.

🤩 Why Lottie?

  • Career Opportunity - A career-defining opportunity to own a new revenue vertical from day one and build Found for Specialist Care.

  • Early Hire Benefits - Be an early hire at one of the UK’s fastest growing startups and benefit from fast career progression, as well as a generous stock options package.

  • Mission - Tech for good that aims to build the care industry of the future and to positively impact millions of people's lives. Care is one of the final remaining large consumer industries that is yet to be disrupted and positively revolutionised by technology.

  • Investors - Series A backed startup having raised £25m+ from tier 1 venture capital investors including Accel and General Catalyst.

  • People - Join a kind, talented and mission driven team that loves coming to work every day.

title: Account Manager Performance Marketing (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Als Account Manager Performance Marketing (m/w/d) bei SPCTR. übernimmst du Verantwortung für eigene Kundenaccounts und wirst zu dem festen Ansprechpartner, dem unsere Kunden vertrauen. Wir arbeiten als verlängerte Online-Marketing-Abteilung, von wachsenden Start-ups bis zu namhaften größeren Unternehmen.

Deine Rolle sitzt genau an der Schnittstelle: Du führst deine Kunden souverän durch Jour Fixes und Quarterly Business Reviews und arbeitest gleichzeitig operativ in den Accounts, wenn Performance-Kampagnen auf Google, Meta, TikTok und Snapchat umgesetzt und optimiert werden. SEO und GEO gewinnen dabei zunehmend an Bedeutung, genauso wie der Einsatz von KI und Automatisierung im Alltag. Bei uns arbeitet das ganze Team mit Claude.

Was wir am meisten schätzen, lässt sich schwer in eine Anforderungsliste fassen: Proaktivität. Menschen, die Probleme früh benennen und mit einem Lösungsvorschlag um die Ecke kommen. Wenn du dich darin wiedererkennst und unternehmerisch denkst, passt du zu uns.

Aufgaben

  • Du betreust eigene Kundenaccounts eigenverantwortlich und bist der feste Ansprechpartner für Strategie, Umsetzung und Ergebnisse.
  • Du führst Jour Fixes und Quarterly Business Reviews selbstständig, auch bei größeren Kunden mit mehreren Entscheidern und festen Entscheidungswegen.
  • Du setzt Performance-Kampagnen auf Google, Meta, TikTok und Snapchat operativ um und optimierst sie kontinuierlich entlang klarer KPIs.
  • Du denkst die Accounts ganzheitlich und bringst SEO- und GEO-Themen mit ins Spiel, wenn sie zu den Zielen des Kunden passen.
  • Du erstellst Analysen, Reportings und Dashboards und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für Kunden und Team ab.
  • Du nutzt KI-Tools und Automatisierungen aktiv im Tagesgeschäft, bei uns vor allem Claude, für Analysen, Reportings, Recherchen und operative Prozesse.
  • Du erkennst wiederkehrende Aufgaben und manuelle Workflows und denkst sie proaktiv in Richtung Automatisierung weiter.
  • Du benennst Probleme früh, transparent und mit einem Lösungsvorschlag im Gepäck.
  • Du behältst Markt, neue Plattform-Features sowie Entwicklungen rund um KI, Search und GEO im Blick und bringst Relevantes ins Team ein.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Performance, Content und Design zusammen, in flachen Hierarchien mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.

Qualifikation

  • Du bringst 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Online oder Performance Marketing mit, idealerweise im Agenturumfeld oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit direktem Kundenkontakt.
  • Du hast ein Studium im Bereich BWL, Marketing, Kommunikation oder Vergleichbares abgeschlossen, eine passende Ausbildung gemacht oder dir dein Können in der Praxis erarbeitet.
  • Du bist kommunikationsstark und trittst gegenüber Kunden klar, souverän und professionell auf, auch wenn mehrere Entscheider und festgelegte Prozesse im Spiel sind.
  • Du kennst dich praktisch mit Google Ads und Meta Ads aus. Erfahrung mit Looker Studio, Google Analytics und Google Tag Manager ist ein Plus.
  • Du hast idealerweise ein Grundverständnis von SEO und GEO, gerne auch mehr, und richtig Lust, dich in diese Themen weiter einzuarbeiten.
  • Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools wie zum Beispiel Claude oder ChatGPT und siehst darin einen echten Hebel für produktiveres Arbeiten.
  • Du hast Drive: Du willst dich und das Unternehmen aktiv nach vorne entwickeln und übernimmst Verantwortung, ohne dass man dich darum bitten muss.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlässlich und priorisiert, und verlierst auch bei mehreren Projekten parallel nicht den Überblick.
  • Du kommst mit modernen Tools gut zurecht. Wir arbeiten mit awork sowie Microsoft 365 und Teams.
  • Du bist Teamplayer, schaust über den eigenen Tellerrand und unterstützt dein Kollegium, wenn es eng wird.

Benefits

  • Ein offenes und engagiertes Team, das von den Gründern selbst geführt wird und einen starken Zusammenhalt pflegt. Auch nach der Arbeit.
  • Echte Account-Verantwortung von Anfang an, mit Kunden, bei denen du deine Wirkung siehst.
  • Ein Umfeld, in dem KI und Automatisierung ausdrücklich gewünscht sind und neue Tools und Ideen ausprobiert statt ausgebremst werden.
  • GEO und KI-Sichtbarkeit als Zukunftsthema, das du mit uns gemeinsam aufbaust.
  • Viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, vollständig remote zu arbeiten.
  • Work from anywhere: Arbeite von dort, wo du am besten arbeiten kannst, plus die Möglichkeit, in unserem Büro in Köln zu arbeiten (optional auch Hamburg).
  • Spannende Start-ups und namhafte größere Kunden, an denen du fachlich schnell wächst.
  • Datengetriebenes Arbeiten, ehrliche Kommunikation und moderne Marketingprozesse.

Klingt das nach der richtigen Herausforderung für dich? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Eigenschaften wie Drive und Lernfähigkeit zeigen sich selten im Kennenlerncall, sondern erst in der Zusammenarbeit. Deshalb halten wir den Prozess schlank und ehrlich: Wenn es von beiden Seiten passt, merken wir das schnell.

Wenn du Kunden souverän führen willst, Performance Marketing operativ stark umsetzt und Lust hast, SEO, GEO und KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen mit uns weiterzudenken, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil des Teams bei SPCTR.

title: Accountant
descriptionHtml:
Accountant

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our finance team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

We're seeking an Accountant to join our Finance team and become the backbone of our financial operations. Working day-to-day with the Senior Accountant and Manager – Group Reporting, you'll be responsible for keeping cash flowing, invoices accurate, records clean, and month-end close predictable. This is a high-impact, hands-on role in a rapidly scaling AI infrastructure company where your accuracy and initiative directly enable faster decision-making and smoother operations.

You'll have broad exposure to financial operations across Radiant's global platform — from day-to-day banking and AR/AP to supporting the setup of new entities as we expand. If you're someone who takes pride in getting numbers right, enjoys solving problems, and wants to grow as the business scales, this role offers real visibility and development opportunity.

What You'll Do

  • Own AR/AP and banking activities that keep cash flowing and vendor relationships strong, processing invoices, payments, and queries with speed and accuracy.

  • Support and gradually own month-end close processes toward becoming predictable and smooth, preparing journals, accruals, and management schedules that leadership can rely on.

  • Assist with and learn revenue billing to ensure invoices go out accurately and on time, supporting clean revenue recognition and customer relationships.

  • Prepare reconciliations (balance sheet, bank, intercompany) that give the business confidence in its numbers, identifying and resolving issues quickly.

  • Support new global entity setups as Radiant expands into new jurisdictions, working with the Senior Accountant and external advisors to ensure proper accounting foundations from day one.

  • Collaborate across finance and operations to understand the business behind the transactions, learning how deals, contracts, and operations flow through the numbers.

  • Assist with year-end financial statement preparation and audit support, ensuring auditors have clean deliverables and the process runs smoothly.

  • Contribute ideas for process improvements and automation - spotting inefficiencies and suggesting ways to work smarter as we scale.

What You'll Bring

  • Part-qualified or actively working towards a professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

  • Experience in accounting or finance, ideally in a fast-paced or multi-entity environment where you've worked hands-on with AR/AP, reconciliations, and month-end close.

  • Solid accounting systems knowledge, strong Excel skills and comfort picking up new tools quickly.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy, you catch errors before they become problems and take pride in clean, reconciled numbers

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, you can investigate discrepancies and resolve them with support from the Senior Accountant.

  • Clear communication and collaborative approach, you work well with the Senior Accountant, colleagues across finance, and stakeholders in operations

  • Strong organisation and time management, you can juggle multiple deadlines and priorities in a fast-moving environment

  • Intellectual curiosity about the business, you want to understand not just how to process a transaction, but why it matters and how it impacts the company

  • Proactive mindset, you don't just follow processes, you suggest better ways to do them

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with Xero or other modern accounting platforms and navigating system migrations

  • Exposure to fast-scaling or multi-entity businesses

  • Familiarity with energy, infrastructure, or capital-intensive industries

What Success Looks Like

AR/AP runs smoothly, invoices are processed on time, and payments happen without friction or escalation.

Month-end close is predictable and efficient, the team trust your work, your schedules, and your ability to own pieces of the close.

Your reconciliations are thorough and timely, you catch issues early, resolve them fast, and the business has clean, accurate numbers it can rely on.

You contribute ideas that improve how we work, suggesting automations or process changes that make the team more efficient.

Why Join Radiant

  • Competitive compensation including company-wide share scheme, bonus, travel paid

  • Work on a rapidly scaling AI infrastructure business at the forefront of the industry

  • Get broad exposure to financial operations, AR/AP, close processes, entity setup, audit - developing well-rounded accounting skills

  • Be part of a team where you're genuinely valued and your work directly enables business decisions

  • Develop your career in a Brookfield-backed company with resources, mentorship, and genuine growth opportunities

Bij afwijkingen zoek je uit wat er speelt en werk je samen met leveranciers en collega’s aan een oplossing.

Daarnaast onderhoud je de workflows en autorisatieschema’s in 4cee, het factuurverwerkingssysteem. Daarmee help je het factuurverwerkingsproces efficiënt en overzichtelijk te houden.

Je maakt deel uit van een Finance-team van acht collega’s en rapporteert aan de Finance Manager.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Controleren en boeken van inkoopfacturen op de juiste grootboekrekening en kostenplaats, met toepassing van de juiste btw-code.

  • Controleren of facturen aansluiten op contractuele afspraken en, waar van toepassing, inkooporders.

  • Bewaken van de voortgang van factuurgoedkeuringen en proactief opvolgen van openstaande acties bij collega’s.

  • Uitzoeken en oplossen van afwijkende, geblokkeerde of onvolledige facturen.

  • Onderhouden van workflows en autorisatieschema’s in 4cee, in afstemming met de verantwoordelijke collega’s.

  • Voorbereiden van betaalvoorstellen en verwerken van betalingen volgens de interne autorisatieprocedure.

  • Verwerken van bankmutaties die betrekking hebben op leveranciersbetalingen.

  • Bijhouden en controleren van leveranciersgegevens volgens de afgesproken procedures.

  • Onderhouden van leverancierscontact over facturen, betalingen en openstaande vragen.

  • Controleren en afstemmen van openstaande crediteurenposten.

  • Ondersteunen bij de maand- en jaarafsluiting, onder meer door ontbrekende facturen en nog te verwerken kosten te signaleren.

  • Zorgen voor een volledige en controleerbare digitale administratie.

title: Acheteur Industriel
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive and technically minded Industrial Buyer to support our procurement and industrialisation activities.

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Supply Chain teams, you will be responsible for sourcing technical components, identifying and qualifying suppliers, negotiating commercial agreements and ensuring the timely procurement of materials and services required for our manufacturing operations.

You will play a key role in building and developing our industrial supplier network as we transition from product development towards serial production.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic & Operational Procurement

  • Manage procurement activities for industrial components, raw materials, equipment and manufacturing services.

  • Source suppliers and identify suitable industrial partners based on technical, quality, cost and delivery requirements.

  • Manage RFQs, analyse quotations and negotiate pricing, payment terms and delivery conditions.

  • Place and follow up on purchase orders, ensuring timely delivery.

  • Monitor procurement costs and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.


Supplier Sourcing & Management

  • Identify, assess and qualify new suppliers and subcontractors.

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with strategic suppliers.

  • Monitor supplier performance in terms of cost, quality and delivery.

  • Coordinate supplier reviews and manage corrective actions where required.

  • Support the development of a reliable and competitive industrial supply chain.


Technical & Manufacturing Coordination

  • Work closely with Engineering to understand technical specifications, BOMs and component requirements.

  • Support sourcing activities during product development, prototyping and industrialisation.

  • Coordinate with Manufacturing to anticipate material and production requirements.

  • Identify supply chain risks, component shortages and potential long lead-time items.

  • Support the transition from prototype procurement to production sourcing.

Procurement Performance & Reporting

  • Monitor purchasing activities, supplier lead times and procurement costs.

  • Maintain accurate purchasing data and supplier documentation.

  • Track purchase orders, delivery performance and outstanding commitments.

  • Contribute to the development of procurement processes and supplier performance indicators.

Candidate Profile

  • Master's degree or equivalent in Purchasing, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

  • 2–7 years of experience in industrial purchasing or technical procurement.

  • Previous experience in aerospace, defence, automotive, electronics or complex industrial environments.

  • Experience sourcing technical components, mechanical parts, electronics or industrial subcontracting services.

  • Proven experience in supplier negotiations and supplier relationship management.

  • Good understanding of manufacturing processes, technical drawings and BOMs.

  • Experience working in a growing industrial organisation or scaling manufacturing environment is an advantage.

descriptionHtml:
Amsterdam/Hilversum - Bereik 91% van alle Nederlanders met jouw werk! Als Advertising Data Specialist maak jij elke dag impact door middel van onze nieuwsmedia, magazines, online services, radio en TV. Je vertaalt de advertising doelstellingen van adverteerders naar slimme, datagedreven audience-oplossingen en draagt zo direct bij aan succesvolle campagnes. Wat ga je doen?
Als Advertising Data Specialist vertaal je de targeted advertising-doelstellingen van adverteerders naar de praktische implementatie binnen onze data- en advertentieplatformen. Met jouw technische inzicht en commerciële affiniteit ontwikkel en optimaliseer je audiences en dataproposities, zodat adverteerders hun doelgroepen effectief kunnen bereiken. Je neemt eigenaarschap over onze data offering, je volgt de prestaties, signaleert verbeterkansen en werkt continu aan de verdere ontwikkeling van ons aanbod. Daarbij krijg je veel ruimte om met eigen ideeën te komen en initiatief te nemen. Zonder jouw expertise worden kansen op het gebied van doelgroepdata, automatisering en campagneprestaties niet optimaal benut. Dit doe je onder andere door:

  • Verantwoordelijk te zijn voor het functioneel beheer en de optimalisatie van het Data Management Platform, inclusief de juiste inrichting, incidentmanagement en ondersteuning via verschillende kanalen.

  • Segmenten en dataproposities te ontwikkelen, beheren en optimaliseren, zodat adverteerders gerichte campagnes kunnen inkopen op al onze titels, op (mobile) web, in-app en via connected audio & TV.

  • Interne stakeholders te adviseren over de beschikbaarheid, mogelijkheden en inzet van doelgroepdata, audiences en privacyvraagstukken.

  • Ontwikkelingen in de markt, nieuwe databronnen en AI-toepassingen te vertalen naar innovatieve audiences, producten en geautomatiseerde processen.

  • Samen te werken aan projecten die de effectiviteit van onze data aantonen, analyses uitvoeren op audience prestaties en continu zoeken naar verbeteringen van onze data offering.

Wie zijn wij?
Je wordt onderdeel van het Advertising Data (BENE)-team binnen de afdeling Digital Sales Development. Vanuit Amsterdam of het Mediapark in Hilversum werk je in een omgeving die continu in ontwikkeling is. Ons team bestaat uit 17 collega's uit Nederland en België en richt zich op het ontwikkelen van nieuwe dataproposities, het aansluiten van nieuwe partners, het bouwen van eigen tools, het ontwikkelen van slimme AI-oplossingen en het aantonen van de kracht van onze data. Je werkt intensief samen met Product- en Innovatieteams, Ontwikkelteams en collega's binnen je eigen team om onze datagedreven advertentieoplossingen verder te ontwikkelen.

Voor deze rol zoeken wij een gedreven mediaprofessional. Jij bent optimistisch, betrokken, gedreven en creatief. Daarnaast bezit jij:

Bij ons krijg je een inspirerende werkomgeving die continu in beweging is. Collega’s die denken in mogelijkheden, het glas halfvol zien en we geven jou de kans je dagelijks te ontwikkelen. Bij DPG Media werken we voor meer dan 90 sterke nieuwsmerken, magazines, televisieprogramma’s, radiostations en online services zoals Qmusic, NU.nl, Tweakers, Libelle, RTL en meer. Heb je direct zin om aan de slag te gaan? Solliciteer dan direct! Je krijgt binnen 10 werkdagen een reactie op je sollicitatie en te horen of je bij de eerste selectie zit. title: Agentic Marketing Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.
