title: AI Enablement Engineer
descriptionHtml:
AI doesn't run in one place anymore. It runs in the browser tab, the desktop app, the agent your engineers kicked off, and the copilot embedded in the tools you already pay for. Harmonic Security governs all of it.

Our AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform sits on the device, inside the interaction, at the moment of action, reading what AI is actually doing (not just the traffic around it) and acting in real time. Security teams get full visibility and control across every AI surface, including the agentic and MCP layer that traditional tools can't see. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.

We're gaining serious traction at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.

How We Work: AI-First by Design

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively leverages AI tools to perform their best work, from deep research and writing to building robust processes and automating complex workflows. We expect every new hire to bring a genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to using it to work smarter, faster, and with greater creativity.

For some, this involves tinkering and remaining open to emerging tools; for others, it means architecting entirely new systems with AI at the core. We will be transparent about expectations for every role and provide the tools and support needed for you to thrive.

About the Team

Our Product Delivery team is the engine that turns vision into impact. We ship early and often, getting valuable features into the hands of customers quickly and iterating from there. We work in the open by default, sharing progress and ideas, and we trust each other to own outcomes. We’re a small but mighty crew where every person plays a critical role and we’re committed to using AI to work smarter and faster.

About the Role

We're looking for an AI Enablement Engineer to join the Platform team in Product Delivery. You'll own the AI tooling our engineers use every day to design, build, review and ship software.

Our engineers share a common AI coding setup, including skills, plugins, MCP tools and conventions, so an improvement one person makes reaches everyone. You'll run that setup and keep making it better. That means building agents that take on parts of how we deliver, such as code review, and turning the corrections engineers make again and again into skills, hooks and automated checks.

What You'll Do

  • Own the shared AI coding setup and internal plugin marketplace, including skills, hooks, MCP tools, settings and safe access

  • Own our AI-driven development lifecycle and build agents for tasks such as code review

  • Use telemetry and engineer feedback to spot recurring problems and fix them in skills, plugins or deterministic checks

  • Own evaluations that show whether changes to skills and agents make them better

  • Work with engineers across disciplines to build useful tooling, assess new harness and model features, and retire what isn't used

  • Own the docs and onboarding that help engineers use the tooling effectively

What You Bring

  • A genuine passion for AI coding tools and agents, with hands-on experience building and maintaining skills, plugins, MCP integrations and other tooling that helps engineers get more from their tools and automates real work.

  • Hands-on software engineering experience, shipping and maintaining code that others depend on

  • Experience configuring, rolling out and maintaining shared developer tools, including safe handling of access, secrets and sensitive data

  • Experience deploying and managing Agents that improve the software delivery lifecycle

  • Strong scripting and automation skills, plus experience with Git, CI/CD and developer tooling

  • Experience evaluating AI workflows against real examples, understanding failure modes and improving results

  • Clear writing and collaboration skills, and comfort navigating a polyglot stack: Java, React and TypeScript, Python and Terraform on AWS

You Might Be a Fit if You

  • Fix the cause when you find yourself correcting the same thing twice, and prefer deterministic checks where possible

  • Care about developer experience and check whether a tool actually saves time

  • Enjoy helping colleagues get more from their tools through pairing, demos and docs

  • Thrive in fast-paced startup environments where ambiguity is the norm

Why Join Us

This isn't just a job - it's a chance to help define a category. Harmonic Security was named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, and we're just getting started. We're building at the intersection of AI and security, carving out an emerging market where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.

We believe today's talent is tomorrow's success, and we're committed to creating an environment where you can do the best work of your life.

  • Recognized momentum - We made the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, a signal that the market is taking notice

  • Rare market opportunity - Join early in a category-defining company at the convergence of AI and security, where your work directly shapes how enterprises tackle one of the biggest unsolved problems in tech

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity - A real stake in Harmonic's success, not a token gesture

  • Comprehensive benefits - pension plan and flexible hybrid work

  • A small, high-trust team that values transparency, creativity, and continuous learning - no politics, no bureaucracy

  • Thoughtful leadership - that cares deeply about your growth, not just your output

  • Annual global off-sites - past trips include Lisbon, Portugal and Nashville, TN

  • Real ownership - you'll shape the product, the culture, and the direction of the company from day one

Harmonic's Core Values

🌱 Flourish in the Unknown

We embrace new, unfamiliar situations that require initiative and rapid decision-making. We orient ourselves quickly and deliver results with minimal guidance.

🔥 Never Full

We raise our hands, take on challenges, and assist others whenever possible. We hunger for opportunities to learn and do more.

🤝 Perfect Harmony

We support one another to create cohesion and unity. We collaborate openly, share feedback honestly, and help everyone produce their best work

HRtechX is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: AI-First Adoption Lead (m/w/d) KI- Einführung und Prozessautomatisierung
descriptionHtml:
Jobbeschreibung

Wer wir sind

benuta ist eine Designmarke für Wohnräume: eigene Kollektionen, Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa und über 150 Menschen in der Gruppe, vom Design über E-Commerce bis zur eigenen Logistik. Wir bauen unsere Multibrand-Strategie aus und entwickeln neben benuta weitere Marken.

Worum es geht

benuta arbeitet AI-first. Nicht als Projekt, sondern als Betriebsmodell. Jede Marke, jedes Team und jeder Prozess läuft auf derselben Grundlage:

benuta Nexus, dem Betriebssystem, mit dem die gesamte Gruppe arbeitet.

  • Nexus Cortex: Wissen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen. Eine Wahrheit, an einem Ort.
  • Nexus Flow: jede Aufgabe und jeder Ablauf, nachvollziehbar und automatisierbar.
  • Nexus Core: Konten, Zugänge und Ablage als Fundament.

Die Architektur steht, KI-Agenten und Automatisierungen laufen. Jetzt geht es um Adoption: Jedes Team arbeitet vollständig in benuta Nexus, und aus Prozessen werden durchgängige, KI-gestützte Workflows.

Warum wir das machen

Wir setzen KI ein, um besser zu werden: für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden, für unsere Marken und für die Menschen, die bei uns arbeiten. KI nimmt Routine ab und schafft Raum für das, was wirklich zählt. Sie schafft Transparenz: Alle sehen, woran wir arbeiten, was entschieden ist und welche Wirkung unsere Arbeit hat. So wachsen wir schneller, schaffen mehr Wert für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und sorgen dafür, dass unser Team im KI-Zeitalter vorne mit dabei ist.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Prozesse neu denken: Du nimmst die Abläufe unserer Teams auf, von der Zentrale über die Marken bis zur Logistik, vereinfachst sie und überführst sie in automatisierte, KI-gestützte Workflows.
  • benuta Nexus einführen: Du bringst jedes Team auf unseren Standard, mit klaren Verantwortlichen und verbindlichen Spielregeln, und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Alltag gelebt werden.
  • Befähigen: Du schulst Teams und Führungskräfte, entwickelst kurze, wirksame Formate und machst neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen vom ersten Tag an arbeitsfähig.
  • Anforderungen schärfen: Du übersetzt den Bedarf der Teams in vollständige Anforderungen mit Problem, Ablauf, Nutzen und Abnahmekriterium und bringst sie in die Weiterentwicklung von benuta Nexus ein.
  • KI-Werkzeuge verantworten: Du führst unsere KI-gestützten Lösungen, etwa im Kundenservice und im Bewertungsmanagement, und sorgst dafür, dass ihre Ergebnisse dort ankommen, wo daraus Verbesserungen werden.
  • Transparenz schaffen: Du misst Nutzung und Wirkung, analysierst, wo es hakt, und berichtest ehrlich, was funktioniert und was nicht.

Du berichtest direkt an den CEO und arbeitest eng mit dem COO zusammen. Mittelfristig besteht die Perspektive, die Leitung unseres Tech-Teams zu übernehmen.

Stellenanforderungen

Das bringst du mit

Umgesetzte KI-Projekte: Du hast KI in einem Unternehmen produktiv eingeführt, zum Beispiel mit KI-Agenten, Automatisierungen oder KI-gestützten Abläufen, und kannst den Nutzen in Zahlen belegen.

  • Prozess- und Workflow-Denken: Du denkst in Abläufen über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg und erkennst, wo Automatisierung den größten Hebel hat.
  • Systemverständnis: Du verstehst, wie Architektur funktioniert, wie Systeme ineinandergreifen und wie Unternehmensprozesse in einer gewachsenen Systemlandschaft orchestriert werden.
  • Analytische Stärke: Du arbeitest sicher mit Daten und Kennzahlen, ziehst daraus klare Schlüsse und berichtest sachlich, auch wenn ein Ergebnis hinter dem Plan bleibt.
  • Leadership: Du gehst voran, schaffst Klarheit, setzt Ziele, lebst Regeln konsequent vor und nimmst die Menschen auf den Weg mit.
  • Starke Kommunikation: Du erklärst Komplexes einfach, überzeugst vor Gruppen und im Einzelgespräch und schreibst präzise.
  • Hands-on und Tempo: Du bist Macher, nicht Verwalter. Du packst selbst an, treibst Themen mit Energie voran und fühlst dich in einem hohen Tempo wohl.
  • Sprache: Deutsch auf sehr hohem Niveau in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englisch.
  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung in E-Commerce, Handel oder Logistik sowie mit Modellen von Google, OpenAI oder Anthropic. Die Modelle bei uns sind gesetzt; entscheidend ist, was du damit im Prozess erreichst.

Was diese Rolle nicht ist

Wir suchen niemanden, der vor allem neue Tools einführt oder dessen KI-Erfahrung sich auf die Arbeit mit Chat-Assistenten beschränkt. Wir suchen jemanden, der Lösungen baut: Prozesse versteht, automatisiert und messbar besser macht.

Das bieten wir

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle in einer gelebten AI-First-Strategie, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Ein System, das schon steht und jetzt in die Breite muss. Du startest nicht bei null.
  • 60.000 bis 75.000 € brutto im Jahr, davon bis zu 15.000 € erfolgsabhängig nach Zielvereinbarung.
  • Einen Vertrag, der zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet ist, mit dem klaren Ziel der unbefristeten Übernahme.
  • Ein Team vor Ort: drei Tage pro Woche am Standort, an bis zu zwei KI-Arbeitstagen wahlweise im Büro oder zu Hause.

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und eine kurze Beschreibung eines KI-Projekts, das du selbst umgesetzt hast: Ausgangslage, dein Vorgehen, das Ergebnis in Zahlen und was du daraus gelernt hast. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Im Prozess erwartet dich eine Fallaufgabe vor Ort. Start: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin ist Sonja Bialas (Teamlead HR).

Bei uns zählt der Mensch und seine Motivation, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion oder sexueller Orientierung. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit einer Schwerbehinderung oder ihnen Gleichgestellten werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

title: AI R&D Engineer – Model Training  (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

Team Culture

At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.

We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other.

About the Role

As an AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri.

  • You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals.

  • No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term.

  • We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models.

  • Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work.

  • Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates.
    The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming.

  • Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg.

  • We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes.

Requirements

  • At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before.

  • As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor.

  • Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful:

    • Test Driven Development (TDD)

    • Trunk based development

    • Continuous integration

    • Domain Driven Design

Nice-to-haves

  • Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase.

  • Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes.

  • We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus.

What we offer

  • Become part of an AI revolution!

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub

  • Mental health support through nilo.health

  • Substantially subsidized company pension plan for your future security

  • Subsidized Germany-wide transportation ticket

  • Budget for additional technical equipment

  • Flexible working hours for better work-life balance and hybrid working model

  • JobRad® Bike Lease

Note: We welcome applicants at every stage of their career. Your drive and willingness to learn are far more important to us than strict experience requirements.

title: AI Resident UK/EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Ema

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

The residency

The AI Residency is a 6-month builder role, not a research placement. Every engineer at Ema owns delivery end to end — from understanding the customer's problem to shipping, measuring and supporting it in production — and residents are held to the same bar. You won't be parked on one project: you'll contribute across several avenues, all toward one goal — creating real value and impact for our enterprise customers.

  • Real production work. You work in the production codebase, on real customer problems and real production data. Recent residents have shipped agent harnesses, eval infrastructure, inference-cost reductions, PII redaction, automated QA pipelines and backend service hardening used by enterprise customers.

  • End-to-end ownership. You take work from a problem statement to a shipped, measured result — design, build, test, launch, and the follow-through until it's reliable.

  • Mentorship. A senior mentor, weekly 1:1s, regular reviews with your team, and exposure to the founders and engineering leadership.

  • A path to full-time. Top-performing residents are offered full-time roles at Ema. Several of our engineers started as residents.

Choose your specialist track

Whichever track you choose, you own delivery end to end. The track decides where you go deepest.

  • Backend. Go and Python services, APIs and data models for multi-tenant SaaS. Integrations that let agents take real actions in SAP, ServiceNow, Workday, Teams and Slack.

  • AI/ML. Agents, harnesses and context engineering; evals and LLM judges calibrated against human labels; retrieval and memory; post-training (SFT, preference optimisation, RL) and distilling frontier behaviour into cheaper models.

  • Systems & Infra. Kubernetes and cloud (Azure, GCP), regional deployments and data residency, model serving, observability, CI/CD and reliability at enterprise scale.

Where you'll contribute

Over the residency you'll work across several of these avenues, not just one:

  • Customer deployments. Build and ship AI Employees for UK and European enterprises, working with the people whose problem it is.

  • Platform and product. Turn patterns from the field into Ema's core product: new connectors, agent primitives, APIs and tooling.

  • Quality and evaluation. Make agents measurably better: benchmarks from real workflows, failure mining, and the loop where production traces become training and eval data.

  • Reliability and cost. Latency, uptime, inference cost and observability. Quality per pound is a metric we track.

  • Trust and compliance. PII detection and redaction, data residency, and audit-ready evidence for customers under UK GDPR and the EU AI Act.

What we're looking for

  • A builder's mindset and high agency. You find a way to ship rather than waiting for the blocker to clear, and you follow your work into production.

  • Final-year undergraduates, MSc/MEng and PhD students, recent graduates and self-taught builders are all welcome. What matters is what you've built.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and clean code in Python, Go or a similar language. You're comfortable in a large production codebase.

  • Real depth in your chosen track. Backend: services, APIs and data modelling. AI/ML: ML fundamentals, PyTorch, LLM systems or evals. Systems & Infra: Linux, containers, cloud and networking. One area you can teach us beats five you've touched.

  • Honest measurement as a habit. You define what "done" and "better" mean before you build, and you'd rather kill your own feature with a clean experiment than ship it on a hunch.

  • Clear communication. You can explain your work to engineers, customers and leadership, in writing and in person.

Show us what you've built

The best way to capture our attention is to point us to something you've built. Include a link — a GitHub repo, a live URL, a demo, or a write-up — with your application.

Logistics

  • Location: Hybrid, from our London office.

  • Term: 6 months, flexible start.

  • Stipend: £ 2,500 - £ 3,000 / month.

  • Right to work: You must have the right to work in the UK for the length of the residency.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

title: Backend Engineer - Acquisition Technology
descriptionHtml:
Backend Engineer - Acquisition Tech - DE

Hybrid in London or remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer

You'll be the first engineer on the German side of Acquisition Tech, owning the customer acquisition systems that decide which small businesses iwoca reaches and how they convert.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Acquisition Tech team owns how iwoca reaches German small businesses – across paid advertising, SEO, social media, direct mail, and outbound sales – and how they become customers. The data and models behind every channel sit with the team.

You'll report to the engineering lead for iwoca's German market, based in London alongside the rest of the technical team. Day to day you'll work with a product manager and a data scientist in London, plus commercial strategy, marketing, and sales – some of whom sit in Germany.

You'll be the only engineer on the German side of acquisition, working in iwoca's UK Acquisition Tech team's codebase. You'll work with their engineers on code reviews and design decisions.

The role

You'll build the backend behind iwoca's German acquisition technology – building on what already runs in the UK, and creating what Germany needs of its own.

  • Ownership. You'll own the German side of the acquisition stack – from the lead-value signals iwoca sends to ad platforms, to the bidding and attribution built on them – and decide what to build from scratch.

  • Technical strategy. You'll help shape the long-term roadmap. The team sets commercial objectives; you’ll shape the architecture, scaling, and technical direction.

  • Funnel optimisation. You'll work with marketing and data science to target relevant businesses across paid search, direct mail, and outbound sales, and to convert more of them once they arrive. You'll integrate third-party APIs to minimise friction in sign-up and improve the lead data behind every channel.

  • Data engineering. You'll build the pipelines, databases, and REST APIs behind the acquisition stack, plus the HubSpot tooling the sales team use.

  • Models in production. You'll engineer the features that data scientists need, put their models into production, and set up the versioning and monitoring that keep them running.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Backend engineering. You have hands-on experience designing and building backend systems in Python, in production.

  • SQL. You are comfortable in SQL beyond CRUD. You shape schemas, tune queries, and reason about how data flows through relational systems.

  • End-to-end. You take work from an initial problem through to delivery, shaping solutions, making trade-offs, and iterating based on how systems are used.

  • Commercial or product thinking. You're comfortable working directly with marketing and sales. You take a business goal, dig into the root of what they need and why, then shape what gets built – as well as owning how.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Full-stack. You’re open to coding frontend elements, particularly in React or TypeScript.

  • Python stack. You have worked with SQLAlchemy, scikit-learn, pandas, and PostgreSQL.

  • Database design. You have designed, built, and managed relational databases.

  • Analytics tooling. You have used Snowflake, Looker, or the equivalent.

The salary

We expect to pay from £70,000 to £85,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

About our Engineering Teams:

We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.

These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.

title: Backend Software Engineer, ML Inference
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

About the role

You will have ownership over designing, building, and scaling the core systems that bring Prior Labs' foundation models to the world. This is a unique opportunity to make fundamental architectural decisions, establish engineering best practices from the ground up, and profoundly shape the technical direction for serving state-of-the-art AI.

TabPFN does its learning in the forward pass, and it now handles datasets in the millions of rows. Making that fast, reliable, and affordable is an exciting engineering challenge.

You'll work directly with world-class AI researchers, translating cutting-edge models into scalable production systems. This role offers significant autonomy and impact, with clear paths to specialize in areas you're passionate about (like inference optimization and core backend systems) or grow into a technical leadership position as our team expands. You won't just be implementing features; you'll be building the backbone of our company.

What you'll work on:

  • Own Inference: Own the serving path end-to-end: latency, throughput, batching, memory behavior on large inputs, and cost per prediction. Our models serve through our managed API, inside customer VPCs, and as self-hosted open weights, and you’ll have an impact across the board.

  • Architect & Design: Design robust, scalable, and secure backend systems and production-grade APIs for serving our foundation models.

  • Build & Implement: Develop high-quality, maintainable code for core backend services.

  • Own Infrastructure: Design, deploy, and manage core infrastructure on cloud platforms, focusing on reliability, monitoring, observability, and cost-efficiency.

  • Ensure Compliance & Security: Implement secure, GDPR-compliant systems, including data storage, access control, usage tracking, and quota management.

  • Champion Best Practices: Drive high standards for testing, CI/CD, documentation, and security within the engineering team.

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in machine learning and backend engineering, with a proven track record of managing production infrastructure.

  • Proven experience deploying and operating machine learning models in production, with a strong understanding of how models behave and fail under real traffic.

  • Strong, hands-on experience designing and building production-grade APIs and backend services.

  • Significant experience building and operating services on cloud platforms, with GCP preferred.

  • Strong, hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform.

  • Significant experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Proficiency in Python.

What sets you apart

  • Experience building or managing infrastructure specifically for machine learning (MLOps, model serving frameworks, feature stores, data pipelines).

  • Deep experience with inference optimization (quantization, compilation, dynamic batching, caching strategies, interplay with distributed computing).

  • Experience with PyTorch and FastAPI specifically.

  • Contributions to relevant open-source projects.

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

We care about how your data is handled - see our Recruiting Data Privacy page

  • US | NY • $170K – $355K • $25K – $315K Equity

Für ein international tätiges Industrieunternehmen der Energieinfrastruktur steuerst du Angebote für Hochspannungsprojekte in globalen Märkten. Du führst das Bid-Team über alle Funktionen, bewertest Risiken und Chancen und bringst die Unterlagen termingerecht zur Abgabe. Gefragt ist echte Tender-Erfahrung aus der Branche, keine reine Vertragsassistenz.

Das zeichnet die Stelle aus

  • Gesamtverantwortung für den Angebotsprozess, von Bid/No-Bid bis zur Abgabe
  • Internationale Ausschreibungen von Netzbetreibern und Generalunternehmen

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ausschreibungen sichten und gemeinsam mit der Verkaufsleitung fundierte Bid-/No-Bid-Empfehlungen erarbeiten
  • Bid-Team aus Engineering, Projektmanagement, Einkauf, Produktion, Logistik, Finanzen und Recht führen
  • Kostenkalkulationen, Preisofferten und Vertragsbedingungen erarbeiten, Risiken und Chancen strukturiert bewerten
  • Angebotsunterlagen technisch, kommerziell und rechtlich zusammenstellen, prüfen und fristgerecht einreichen
  • Präqualifikationen und Lieferantenregistrierungen bei Netzbetreibern und Generalunternehmen vorbereiten und abschliessen
  • Ausschreibungs- und Pipelinedaten im ERP, zum Beispiel Microsoft Dynamics 365, pflegen und das Verkaufsreporting unterstützen
  • Vertragsverhandlungen begleiten, Win/Loss-Analysen auswerten und Vorlagen sowie Abläufe im Bid-Management verbessern

Dein Profil

  • Abschluss in Elektro- oder Energietechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Betriebswirtschaft, oder vergleichbare Ausbildung
  • Mindestens fünf Jahre eigene Tender-Verantwortung in Energieinfrastruktur oder vergleichbarem internationalem Projektgeschäft
  • Erfahrung mit Hochspannungssystemen oder Generalunternehmer-Projekten ist ein klarer Vorteil
  • Sichere Kostenkalkulation, starke Analytik und gute Kenntnisse kommerzieller Vertragsbedingungen
  • Nachweisbare Koordination funktionsübergreifender Teams, sicher in MS Office und ERP-Systemen
  • Verhandlungssicheres Englisch ist Pflicht, Deutsch im Alltag von Vorteil

Arbeitsort: Raum Aarau, Schweiz (vor Ort). Pensum: 100%.

Du bewirbst dich bei CONCAPE GmbH, Personalvermittlung, Städtle 13, 9490 Vaduz, Liechtenstein. Den Namen des Unternehmens besprechen wir persönlich mit dir. Vorgestellt wirst du nur mit deinem OK.

title: Business AI Architect (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Aufgaben
  • Du identifizierst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden KI-Potenziale in Geschäftsprozessen und bewertest Use Cases nach Business Value, technischer Machbarkeit, Risiken und Skalierbarkeit.
  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus Fachbereichen und IT in End-to-End-Architekturen für KI-Lösungen und wählst passende Ansätze, zum Beispiel Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, KI-Agenten oder Workflow-Automatisierung.
  • Du entwickelst Prototypen und Proofs of Concept und integrierst diese über APIs und Datenplattformen in SAP- und Non-SAP-Systemlandschaften.
  • Im SAP-Umfeld arbeitest du je nach Projekt mit SAP Business Technology Platform, SAP AI Core, SAP Generative AI Hub, Joule und Joule Studio.
  • Du berücksichtigst von Beginn an Informationssicherheit, Datenschutz, Berechtigungskonzepte, Nachvollziehbarkeit und AI Governance.
  • Du konzipierst und moderierst Discovery-, Use-Case- und Architekturworkshops und begleitest Lösungen von der Idee über den PoC bis zur produktiven Skalierung.
  • Du unterstützt Presales-Aktivitäten und entwickelst unser Business-AI-Portfolio sowie wiederverwendbare Lösungsbausteine weiter.

Dein Profil

Fachlich

  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Generative AI, Machine Learning oder intelligenten Automatisierungslösungen sowie mit modernen Cloud- und Integrationsarchitekturen.
  • Du kennst zentrale Konzepte wie Large Language Models, RAG, Embeddings, Vector Search und KI-Agenten und kannst deren Einsatzmöglichkeiten und Grenzen realistisch bewerten.
  • Du kannst Prototypen selbst entwickeln, zum Beispiel mit Python oder JavaScript, und hast Erfahrung mit APIs, Datenintegration und gängigen Entwicklungswerkzeugen.
  • Du kannst Architekturentscheidungen strukturiert herleiten, dokumentieren und gegenüber technischen und fachlichen Stakeholdern verständlich vertreten.
  • Du denkst dich schnell in Geschäftsprozesse und fachliche Problemstellungen ein und übersetzt sie in konkrete, umsetzbare technische Lösungen.
  • Know-how in SAP BTP, SAP Business AI, SAP AI Core, SAP Generative AI Hub, Joule, SAP Business Data Cloud oder SAP S/4HANA ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.
  • Erfahrung mit Frameworks wie LangChain oder LangGraph sowie mit dem Model Context Protocol ist ein Plus.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
Persönlich
  • Du erklärst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich und adressatengerecht, vom Entwicklungsteam bis zum Management.
  • Du arbeitest gerne direkt mit Kunden, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Lösungen eigenständig voran.
  • Du bewertest neue Technologien nach ihrem konkreten Nutzen und ihren Risiken, nicht nach dem Hype.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, pragmatisch und gerne im Team und teilst dein Wissen.

Warum wir?
  • Attraktives Gehalt
  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem wachstumsstarken Unternehmen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Homeoffice-Option
  • Angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre und gute Führungskultur (kaum messbare Mitarbeiterfluktuation)
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Firmenwagen und moderne IT-Ausstattung
  • Fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

The Vicos then act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects.

Already, 100+ Vicos with thousands of freelancers work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Zeiss and many SMEs. descriptionHtml:
Who Are We ?

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

💼 About This Role

We are looking for a Project Manager to join our team and act as a mini-CEO for one of our key markets, taking full ownership of its performance and growth. You will play a crucial role in establishing and maintaining our products' market position, driving product expansion, and enhancing operational efficiency.

🎖️What success looks like

In your first month

  • You understand our product, customers, and operational landscape; how value is created, delivered, and scaled and start identifying opportunities for improvement.

  • You establish strong working relationships with the Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams.

By 3 months

  • Alongside our Product Owner, you contribute to defining a clear product vision and strategy, grounded in customer needs and market realities.

  • You analyse product workflows and cost structures to improve efficiency and reduce time-to-market without sacrificing product quality.

  • You coordinate cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to ensure efficient and well-executed go-lives.

  • You become the main point of contact for our customers and engage directly with them, turning feedback into clear, actionable insights.

By 6 months

  • You proactively drive product and operational improvements that measurably impact efficiency, cost, and customer satisfaction.

  • You influence roadmap decisions through market research, competitive analysis, and customer data.

  • You streamline customer support and success processes to improve response times and long-term customer health.

  • You’re trusted as a key partner across teams – shaping how we scale, not just what we build.

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful:

  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field.

  • You bring several years of professional experience in customer success, account management, or similar roles within a B2B environment, ideally in SaaS.

  • You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. Proficiency in additional languages is a plus.

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds who value ownership and continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way.

🌍 International team: With several nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together.

🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every time and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, talk to us! We consider support for courses, workshops, or other training opportunities.

title: Client Complaint Senior Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Trust unlocks our greatest potential.

For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution.

What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our Client Services team as a Client Complaint Senior Analyst? Reporting to the Associate Director, Client Support you will take independent ownership of client complaints, using your judgement and complaints expertise to resolve non-routine cases fairly, effectively and within relevant requirements. You will support consistently high standards across complaint handling by identifying themes and improvements, sharing your knowledge and providing direct line management, day-to-day support and coaching to the Complaint Analyst.

Your role includes:

  • Independently manage client complaints from receipt through to resolution, applying sound judgement to deliver fair, timely and well-evidenced outcomes in line with complaint handling standards, relevant requirements and internal policies

  • Investigate non-routine complaints, bringing together information from systems, teams and stakeholders to establish root cause, reach appropriate conclusions and identify when complex matters require escalation

  • Produce clear, accurate and customer-focused written responses, ensuring decisions and outcomes are appropriately supported and communicated

  • Identify recurring complaint themes, risks and root causes, using insight from cases to suggest practical improvements to customer outcomes, service quality and complaint management processes

  • Take direct line management responsibility for the Client Complaint Analyst, setting clear objectives, holding regular one-to-ones, providing feedback and coaching, and supporting their onboarding, performance and development

  • Share complaints knowledge and best practice across the team while continuing to manage your own complaint caseload

  • Support consistent complaint handling standards across the team by providing guidance on day-to-day cases and constructively challenging where an approach may not achieve the right outcome

  • Build trusted relationships across Client Services, Financial Crime, Operations, Product and other relevant teams to resolve issues and support improvements that benefit customers and the Bank

What you’ll bring:

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

  • Strong working knowledge of complaint handling in a customer service, financial services, operations or regulated environment, with the ability to apply relevant processes, policies and controls independently

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, including the ability to investigate non-routine issues, assess evidence, identify root causes and reach well-reasoned conclusions

  • Sound judgement, with the confidence to make day-to-day decisions independently and recognise when a more complex or higher-risk matter should be escalated

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex matters clearly and produce high-quality customer communications

  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage varied complaint activity and competing priorities while maintaining quality and timeliness

  • A collaborative approach, with the ability to line manage the Complaints Analysts, set clear expectations, provide constructive feedback and coaching, and support their performance and development

  • Curiosity and a continuous-improvement mindset, with the confidence to identify problems, challenge constructively and suggest better ways of working

What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you?

  • You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank;

  • You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care;

  • You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate;

  • ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary.

Regretfully we are not able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes at the current time.

What we offer in return:

  • We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.

  • Offices – Work in a way that works for you – whether that’s in the London office, at home, or hybrid.

  • Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus bank holidays.

  • Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.

  • Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the UK for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.

  • Socials – Regular social events open to all.

  • Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice.

  • Wellbeing – 24/7 employee assistance programme including mental health support, life assurance and income protection.

  • Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you.

  • Healthy living – Private healthcare and discounted dental cover, with employee perks and discounts.

  • Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave.

  • Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

title: Clinical Operations Lead & Registered Manager (CQC) at AIOS — Remote (UK), £90k–£150k/yr inc equity
descriptionHtml:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving 200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

 

Being a Clinical Ops Lead at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Clinical Ops Lead at AIOS Tech, you’ll build an A+ clinical operations team at scale. You’ll also be our CQC Registered Manager, personally accountable for the safety and quality of our regulated service.

You’ll:

  • Lead a fast-growing UK clinical ops team. Set the bar high and make sure your team holds it.

  • Be our CQC Registered Manager. We’re inspection-ready every day, and you build the systems that keep us there.

  • Nail capacity planning. No backlogs, no long waits, no clunky patient experiences.

  • Build an operation that runs itself. Clear KPIs and SLAs, and performance management that’s automated first, so it scales as we grow.

You’re a killer operator first. You run on numbers, cadence and relentless follow-through. You spot problems before they show up in the data, fix them at the root and make sure they don’t come back. To you, the best-run operation is also the safest and most compliant one.

Our patients deserve a world-class experience. You use technology to close gaps, keep standards high and redesign pathways around what’s best for patients.

You’re not pretentious. You’ll get stuck in with the leads who report to you and make sure our strategy holds up as we scale. You’ll work with our Talent team to hire and keep the sharpest people in the country.

Doing this well means we become the UK’s largest GLP-1 provider and expand into new verticals, safely, compliantly and without slowing down.

This is a full-time, fully remote role in the UK, with occasional travel to Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn. You’ll have flex in your calendar for kids if you have them — many of our team have kids so we’re kid-friendly.

This is a Lead role. You’ll report directly to our Head of Clinical Product & NI, Farah Haque. We’re intense, so you’ll also be intense.

You’ll also work closely with:

  • Arvee Sese-Bondoc, Customer Support Lead

  • Phuong Nguyen, Superintendent Pharmacist

  • Rich Hannibal, Head of Customer Experience & Operations

  • Zoe Wheeler, UK People Lead

 

Key responsibilities

  • Registered Manager: You’re our CQC Registered Manager and personally accountable for safe, high-quality care. You own our relationship with the CQC, set our compliance strategy and make sure the business meets the fundamental standards as it scales.

  • Quality: Working with the NI, you set our path to an Outstanding rating. You build a service that runs to the CQC’s five key questions by default, so we’re inspection-ready every day.

  • Governance: You design and lead our governance framework for incidents, complaints, safeguarding and duty of candour. You make sure the lessons drive real change in how we work to keep patients safe.

  • Leadership: You lead the leaders. You set the performance bar, and build a strong bench of team leads who maintain high standards across the entire clinical operation.

  • Talent: You’ll partner with Talent to hire and keep A+ prescribers and Team Leads. You’ll have ongoing training in place as we expand into new verticals.

  • Operational strategy: You own capacity and workforce planning in step with growth and expansion. You make the calls on structure, resourcing and investment, so demand never outpaces us.

  • Performance: You set the KPIs and SLAs the operation runs on, and hold your leads to them. You objectively assess accurate data, and are responsible for the accuracy of that data.

  • Collaboration: You’re a senior voice in the leadership team. You bring clinical ops insight into company decisions and represent the service internally and externally.

 

Need to have

  • Experience: You have 3+ years leading teams in a high-growth, digital/telehealth organization.

  • CQC: You have experience as a CQC Registered Manager, and have taken a service through a CQC inspection and received rating Good or Outstanding.

  • Alignment: You have experience leading large clinical teams (>50), and you’ve likely led teams much larger than that (>100). You smoothly get large teams aligned so everyone’s adhering to protocols and SOPs.

  • Operator: You’re a killer operator, with a track record of running clinical operations based on metrics (SLAs, rotas, forecasting). You embrace accountability, and your reports do, too.

  • Metrics: You possess data fluency and understand the importance of accurate data when it comes to setting KPIs. You have owned critical KPIs in the past and don’t balk at the responsibility that comes with it.

  • Automation: You recognize that we’re in the midst of a technological revolution, and embrace AI and automation to kill off manual, clunky workflows. You ensure your team isn’t getting left behind.

  • Standards: You maintain exceptionally high standards, a bias to action and are happy to get stuck in. You detest pretentiousness.

Nice to have

  • Product & Engineering: You’ve worked with Product and Engineering to automate operational workflows in a start-up environment. You understand what they need and don’t make vague requests without clear justification. You validate what’s shipped yourself.

  • Scale: You’ve scaled a service through rapid growth and probably launched new clinical services or verticals along the way. You can “figure it out” as you go without needing your hand held.

  • Regulatory: You possess experience with regulators and standards beyond just the CQC, such as the GPhC, MHRA, ICO and/or DSPT

 

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2030 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

🎯 "You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

 

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: £90k–£150k/yr inc equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: £1,000/yr budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: £1,000/yr budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

title: Collections & Recoveries Specialist
descriptionHtml:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a Collections & Recoveries Specialist

We're looking for an experienced Collections & Recoveries Specialist to own our most complex and high-value overdue accounts — taking each one from start to resolution, whether that's a negotiated settlement, litigation or insolvency. This is a specialist recoveries role covering contentious and non-contentious collections. You'll already understand the end-to-end lifecycle of these types of accounts and be confident communicating with customers and stakeholders to secure the best outcome for iwoca and our customers.

The team

The Collections & Recoveries team at iwoca is responsible for supporting customers who have fallen behind on repayments, with a focus on achieving fair, sustainable outcomes for both the customer and the business.

The team takes a customer-first, solutions-oriented approach, working closely with small to medium business owners to understand their financial situation and agree on realistic repayment plans where possible. They balance empathy with commercial awareness, ensuring regulatory compliance while protecting iwoca’s loan portfolio.

Where you’ll work

This is a hybrid role based in Leeds or London. For your first month you'll be in the office every day for training, with the expectation dropping to once or twice a week thereafter.

The role

Our Specialist's work within a fast-paced, commercially focused environment, balancing fair treatment of customers with the the best outcome for the iwoca. You will have strong hands-on experience in either debt recovery through the UK courts and/or insolvency procedures. You will know the lifecycle of these accounts from beginning to end and can confidently handle the complexities that come with them.

You will manage a portfolio of accounts with outstanding balances up to £1m through to completion with varying and unique circumstances, managing inbound and initiating outbound telephone calls, letters and emails with the greatest level of care, accuracy and professionallism.

A flavour of what you'll own:

  • A portfolio of complex, high-value accounts through to resolution — including County Court Judgments (CCJs), charging orders and enforcement action

  • Reviewing the full financial and asset picture of an account to decide the best route to recovery

  • Recommending and evidencing the right strategy for each account — a negotiated settlement, a repayment arrangement, or pursuing recovery through litigation

  • Negotiating and monitoring repayment arrangements on difficult accounts, with clear consequences for non-payment

  • Instructing and liaising with internal paralegals and external insolvency practitioners

The requirements

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Essential:

  • End-to-end, hands-on experience of debt recovery through the UK courts and/or insolvency procedures. This is essential — you'll be expected to assess the strategic recovery position on each account to maintain your assigned portfolio

  • At least 2 years debt recovery and / or insolvency experience, ideally in the commercial/business sector

  • Sound commercial judgement and the confidence to make decisions on complex, high-value accounts

  • A patient, empathetic and professional manner, especially in difficult conversations

  • Strong communication skills, accuracy and confidence

Desirable / Nice to have

  • Experience managing a large portfolio of high-value business cases

  • Experience in the finance or lending industry

  • Experience with bankruptcy and high level litigation cases

  • Business acumen and genuine enthusiasm for helping SMEs

We don't expect you to tick every desirable box — but the courts and/or insolvency recovery experience above is genuinely essential for this role. If you have that, we'd love to hear from you even if the rest of your experience looks a little different.

The salary

Our base salary range in Leeds is £34,000 - £41,000. Our base salary range in London is £39,000 - £46,000. We want to pay all of our employees fairly, so that’s why we regularly benchmark salaries based on market rates and to recognise your increasing value to our business.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

title: Consolidation Intern
descriptionHtml:
About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The team

The Consolidation team, part of Finance (Accounting & Consolidation), prepares the Group’s IFRS consolidated financial statements across multiple international legal entities. The team is moving its consolidation EPM tool from SAP BFC (ViaReport C&R) to Amelkis EPM, with a go-live targeted for Q1 2027, while preparing the 2026 annual closing. The intern supports both work streams and reports to the Consolidation Director.

What you’ll be doing:

Annual consolidation closing (2026)

  • Support the preparation of the Group’s IFRS consolidated financial statements across multiple legal entities

  • Assist with intercompany reconciliation and eliminations

  • Process consolidation adjustments and review reporting packages submitted by subsidiaries

  • Liaise with subsidiary finance teams to collect, control and consolidate reporting packages

  • Support ad hoc analyses requested during the annual audit

EPM tool migration (SAP BFC to Amelkis EPM)

  • Contribute to data migration, configuration and testing workshops for the new Amelkis consolidation/EPM tool

  • Participate in the “double run” phase to ensure data accuracy between the legacy and new systems

  • Help document consolidation processes and procedures throughout the tool transition

What we’re looking for:

  • Master’s-level student (Bac+4/5) in Accounting, Finance or Audit (DSCG, Master CCA, business or engineering school), looking for a gap year (césure) or an end-of-studies internship

  • First experience with, or strong interest in, consolidation and IFRS (previous internship, audit firm exposure or dedicated coursework)

  • Comfortable working with large data sets and advanced Excel functions

  • Curiosity for finance systems and tools (EPM, SAP BFC, Amelkis EPM) is a strong plus

  • Fluent in English and French (the team reports bilingually)

  • Rigorous and structured

What the internship offers

  • Hands-on exposure to IFRS consolidation in a fast-growing, international tech group

  • Active involvement in a live EPM tool migration (SAP BFC to Amelkis EPM), a skill highly valued in the finance job market

  • Close mentoring from the Consolidation Director and the wider accounting team

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.
