title: Inside Sales Manager
descriptionHtml:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We are looking for a high-impact Inside Sales Manager in London to spearhead our high-velocity, sales engine across the UK region. Reporting directly to the Senior Manager, Outbound Sales you will be the strategic architect and frontline leader of our inside sales motion.

You will be responsible for leading a high-performing team of Inside Sales Representatives / and Account Executives (AEs). Your mission is to optimise our digital and phone-based selling motion to generate self-sourced pipeline, execute targeted outbound campaigns, and drive inbound conversion across key UK markets.

What you will be doing:

As the Inside Sales Manager, you are the primary driver of proactive, scalable revenue growth across the UK. This is a fast-paced, high-impact position where you will oversee the entire inside sales funnel—from rapid lead response and discovery through to virtual demos and closing mid-market deals.

Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Leading High-Velocity Inside Sales Teams: Manage, coach, and inspire a focused team of Inside Sales AEs and SDRs operating in a fast-paced, metric-driven virtual environment metric-driven virtual environment, with a strong emphasis on proactive prospecting and ‘hunting’.

  • Vertical-Specific Conversion Strategy: Adapt high-velocity inside sales strategies to engage and convert prospects within the Hospitality sector, ensuring messaging aligns with regional nuances and business priorities across the UK.

  • Outbound Pipeline Generation & Funnel Optimisation: Partner closely with Marketing and RevOps to build high-converting outbound strategies, driving self-sourced pipeline while maintaining rapid speed-to-lead on inbound demand.

  • Forecasting & Revenue Intelligence: Reporting directly to the Senior Manager,, provide rigorous weekly and quarterly forecasts. Leverage revenue intelligence tools (Gong, Salesforce, ChurnZero, Pure Cloud, and internal AI-based tools) to review call recordings, spot deal risks, and deliver real-time coaching at scale.

  • Live Call & Deal Coaching: Join virtual pitches and closing calls as an executive sponsor on key deals, helping your reps maintain momentum, build urgency, and close business efficiently without in-person meetings.

And a little bit of....

  • Contributing as an integral part of the wider team to achieve organisational goals, even if this means undertaking tasks outside the strict scope of your primary role.

What you need to bring:

To be successful in this role, you must demonstrate a strong command of high-velocity SaaS sales methodologies and a proven ability to coach reps to peak performance in a hybrid-selling environment.

What you will need:

  • Proven Leadership: Extensive experience in sales management, specifically having managed or led complex, multi-functional sales teams in a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment, selling to SMEs with a transactional sales cycle .

  • Operational Excellence: Expert proficiency in the modern sales stack (Salesforce, Salesloft/Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator etc.) and a data-first approach to territory management.

  • Commercial Acumen: A strong grasp of SaaS financial metrics (ARR, LTV, CAC) and the ability to translate these into strategic outbound initiatives.

  • Hands-On Coaching Style: A passion for call reviews, live role-playing, and KPI-driven performance management that drives consistent daily execution.

What’s in it for you:

You’ll enjoy:

  • A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

  • A culture that celebrates performance

  • The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

  • Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

  • Flexible paid time off and remote work policies

  • Equity options, because this is your company too

  • Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters

  • Training opportunities to grow your skills and career

  • Health and wellness credit so you feel your best (£400 per year)

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams

  • Enhanced parental leave to support growing families

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

title: Intern Data Analyst - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Fondée en 2014, Artefact est une société française de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en IA, transformation data et en data & digital marketing. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 collaborateurs répartis dans 27 bureaux à travers le monde allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises.

La mission des Artefactors ? Transformer la data de nos clients en impact business. Dans ce sens, nous collaborons avec plus de 1000 clients, leaders de leurs industries (Orange, Carrefour, Samsung, AccorHotels, L’Oréal, LVMH, Decathlon) et sommes partenaires privilégiés de Google (GMP/GCP), AWS ainsi que Microsoft Azure.

En tant que stagiaire Data Analyst, tu seras intégré(e) à une équipe travaillant étroitement avec des consultants / data scientists et tu participeras à des missions ayant un impact réel pour les clients. Tes missions pourront inclure :

  • Collecter, nettoyer, préparer les données à partir de sources diverses (bases de données internes, API, logs, etc.).

  • Explorer et analyser les données pour identifier tendances, anomalies, corrélations, patterns utiles.

  • Participer à la conception et réalisation de dashboards / reportings sous outils de data visualisation (ex. Tableau, PowerBI, ou outils internes) pour présenter les résultats aux équipes ou aux clients.

  • Contribuer à la définition de KPI pertinents selon les objectifs métier.

  • Travailler en collaboration avec les équipes métier (marketing, produit, etc.) pour bien comprendre leurs besoins et transformer ces besoins en analyses exploitables.

  • Aider à automatiser certains processus de reporting ou analyses simples.

  • Documenter tes travaux, partager les résultats et les apprentissages au sein de l’équipe, proposer des améliorations ou de nouvelles approches quand c’est possible.

Profil recherché

  • Étudiant(e) en dernière année de cycle ingénieur, Master 2, ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en Data, Intelligence Artificielle, Mathématiques appliquées, Statistiques ou Informatique et recherche un stage de fin d'études à partir de Janvier 2027.

  • Maîtrise de SQL pour extraire / manipuler les données.

  • Connaissances en langage de programmation pour l’analyse de données, typiquement Python (avec pandas, numpy, etc.).

  • Bonne compréhension des principes statistiques de base (moyennes, distributions, tests, corrélations, variance, etc.).

  • Capacité à créer des visualisations / dashboards (Tableau, PowerBI, ou outil équivalent).

  • Connaissance minimale de l’écosystème numérique et data (web analytics, datalake, dataviz, etc.) est un plus.

Compétences personnelles / soft skills :

  • Esprit logique et analytique, souci du détail.

  • Sens de la communication orale et écrite : savoir expliquer ses résultats à des non-experts.

  • Capacité à travailler en équipe, à écouter et à comprendre les besoins métier.

  • Proactivité, curiosité, et capacité à proposer des idées ou des approches nouvelles.

  • Autonomie, tout en étant à l’aise avec le suivi et les retours.

  • Bon niveau en français (oral et écrit) ; l’anglais professionnel est un plus, notamment pour échanges ou documentations.

title: Internship - Programming & Automation
descriptionHtml:
WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP

Details

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: Full-time (5 days/week)

Period: 6 months

Location: Aerospace Innovation Hub, Delft, the Netherlands

About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced onboard UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers who are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members come from different backgrounds such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics, and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub on the TU Delft campus in the Faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low-TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.

The project

Sensor calibration is a manual job today, and it does not scale to the number of sensor units we intend to ship. We are building automated test and calibration infrastructure to fix that, starting with a cell built around a UFactory UF850 robotic arm on a linear rail.

We already have the arm and the calibration software. What we do not have is the physical cell around it, or the software that drives it. This first project is split into two internships that run side by side:

• Robot programming and automation — this position

• Mechanical design and integration — separate posting

The two interns will work closely together. Neither half of this project is any good on its own. This calibration cell is the first thing we are building on this front, not the last, so there is a good chance the right person carries on to other robotics and automation projects once it is running.

Your role

If you are the kind of person who is not satisfied until an automated system actually works reliably, not just once, this internship is designed for you.

We are looking for a Robot Programming & Automation Intern to help build the software behind our robotic test and automation infrastructure. Your first project is turning a robotic arm on a linear rail into a system that reliably captures good calibration data — but the skills involved are the same ones we’ll lean on for whatever we automate next: getting a robot to move well, knowing whether the data it’s collecting is any good, and building something solid enough to run unattended.

Getting that right is the substance of this internship, on this project and on whatever comes after it.

What you’ll do

• Build the robot control layer: drive the arm through its SDK, coordinate the linear rail, and plan safe motion inside a cell that also has a target, cables, and an operator in it.

• Design pose generation that’s actually informed by the calibration problem, including getting proper coverage across a multi-camera rig rather than just one lens at a time.

• Get the timing and synchronisation right between the robot, the cameras, and the captured data — this is where automated rigs usually go wrong.

• Gate data quality at capture time, and retry within the run rather than finding out later that a dataset is unusable.

• Close the loop with our existing calibration pipeline: feed it data, read back its results, and use that to decide what to capture next and when a run is done.

• Package captures with the metadata needed to make a calibration reproducible, and make the whole thing robust to failures mid-run.

• Build a simple operator-facing workflow: mount the rig, pick a profile, press go.

• Work closely with the mechanical intern — your requirements shape their fixture design, and their measurements shape your motion limits.

Who you are

• You are enrolled in a relevant study program (Robotics, Computer Science, Computational Science and Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace, Electrical Engineering, or similar).

• You are strong in Python. C++ is a plus.

• You are comfortable with 3D geometry: rigid transforms, rotation representations, coordinate frames, and keeping your conventions straight when it is 6pm and nothing lines up.

• You are interested in robot programming specifically — motion, reachability, collisions, repeatability — and not only in the vision maths around it.

• You understand enough about how camera calibration works to reason about what makes a dataset good or useless. You do not need to be able to write the solver.

• You have worked with real sensors and real robots, and you have learned that they lie about timing.

• You care about reliability. An automated process that works four times out of five is not automated.

• You write code that another engineer can pick up and extend.

• You are comfortable taking responsibility for software that moves physical hardware.

• You are independent, curious, organized, and resourceful.

• Linux does not scare you, and neither does a robot that moves the moment your code says move.

We care much more about what you have built and made work than about grades.

Nice to have

These are strong pluses, but not strict requirements:

• ROS 2, MoveIt 2, tf2, and motion planning in practice

• Experience with industrial or collaborative arm SDKs (UFactory / xArm, UR, Franka), or motion control more generally

• Hands-on camera calibration experience: OpenCV, Kalibr, ChArUco or AprilTag targets, hand-eye calibration

• Multi-camera rigs, and the specific pain of calibrating cameras with little or no overlapping field of view

• Machine vision cameras: triggering and synchronisation, GenICam, exposure control, rolling versus global shutter

• Coverage or observability reasoning: understanding why some poses inform a parameter and others do not

• Simulation environments (Gazebo, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo)

• Docker, CI, and the habit of writing tests before you need them

• Experience turning a research script into something an operator can actually use

Please include

When applying, please include links, repositories, or writeups that show us you build things that work. For example:

• GitHub repositories, with a note on which parts you actually wrote

• robot arm or robot motion projects

• camera calibration, multi-view geometry, SLAM, or structure-from-motion work

• data capture pipelines, test automation, or anything that had to run unattended

• computer vision projects

• simulation work

• a short writeup of something that broke and how you found the cause

• anything that demonstrates hands-on technical ownership

If you have ever chased a calibration error you couldn’t explain, eventually traced it to a timestamp, and fixed it properly, you’ll probably fit right in.

Requirements

• Enrolled in a relevant study program (Robotics, Computer Science, CSE, Mechatronics, Aerospace, Electrical Engineering, or similar)

• Strong programming skills, Python at minimum

• Comfortable working in Linux

• Strong interest in robotics, automation, computer vision, or perception

• English proficiency

• Organized and proactive working style

What we offer

• 1000 euro monthly compensation

• 10 vacation days during the internship period

• Flexible working hours and the option to work from home 2 days per week where practical

• A direct and significant influence on highly innovative products

• The opportunity to work close to the hardware and the product, with fast iteration and tight feedback loops

• Full ownership of a self-contained system that the rest of the company will depend on

• A team environment where practical experimentation, learning, and ownership are expected

The application procedure

• If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself. This can be a resume, website, portfolio, or any other source that gives us a clear impression of your background, technical skills, and hands-on experience.

• We will get back to you ASAP. If we think you could be a fit for the position, we will invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a more technically focused interview may follow.

• If at that point we believe you are the person we are looking for, we will discuss the specifics such as starting date and internship period.

Welcome to the team!

title: Investor Relations | Closing & Structuration
descriptionHtml:
Contrat : CDI - Temps plein

Lieu : Paris 2e (Opéra) - Télétravail partiel possible

Prise de poste : Début 2027

Rattachement : Direction du Pôle Revenu

L'exigence d'un fonds. L'impact d'un rôle Closer / Builder.

Sowefund, groupe Founders Future, ouvre l'accès au Venture Capital aux investisseurs privés. Notre activité historique (le Deal-by-Deal Primaire) a démontré la solidité de son modèle et sa rentabilité : notre collecte a progressé de 50 % sur les douze derniers mois.

En 2027, nous changeons d'échelle sur ce moteur tout en déployant deux nouvelles lignes d'investissement : notre offre de Secondaire, ainsi qu'un troisième produit structurant (confidentiel à ce stade). Nous sommes à un point d'inflexion et recherchons un profil alliant une forte fibre commerciale à une réelle capacité de structuration, pour s'appuyer sur ce socle rentable et devenir l'un des moteurs de notre prochaine phase de croissance.

VOTRE RÔLE : LE TERRAIN ET L'EXCELLENCE OPÉRATIONNELLE

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction du Pôle Revenu, vous rejoignez une équipe Investor Relations véloce (3 postes en CDI : 2 Investor Relations dédiés à la collecte et 1 profil CSM / Ops dédié, accompagnés de 2 stagiaires) et travaillez en lien étroit avec les équipes Growth, Product et Admin. Votre mandat est double et allie l'exigence du terrain à la rigueur organisationnelle :

1. Le Closing et la Collecte (70 % - Votre focus principal)

Vous êtes en première ligne sur un flux 100 % qualifié : intentions d'investissement, base d'investisseurs existants et leads entrants (pas de prospection à froid / cold calling), avec un fort levier sur les tickets intermédiaires (5 k€ à 20 k€).

  • Vente consultative : vous engagez un dialogue direct et qualitatif avec des investisseurs exigeants (dirigeants, cadres supérieurs, entrepreneurs) pour qualifier leur potentiel, lever leurs freins et conclure les souscriptions.

  • Animation et réinvestissement : vous réactivez notre communauté d'investisseurs autour des lancements et des clôtures pour développer le réinvestissement multi-produits.

  • Montée en gamme : vous imposez un rythme soutenu dans la gestion de votre pipeline et accompagnez vos investisseurs dans la durée pour closer vos dossiers au-delà de 20 k€.

2. La Structuration (30 % - Votre levier d'accélération)

Pour accompagner notre changement d'échelle, l'exécution commerciale doit s'appuyer sur une organisation irréprochable. Vous avez la capacité d'auditer et d'optimiser nos outils et nos parcours de distribution pour l'ensemble du pôle.

  • Pilotage CRM et Pipeline : vous veillez à la parfaite tenue de notre CRM, structurez le suivi du pipeline et l'optimisez en continu.

  • Build avec Product et Growth : vous mettez en place les automatisations (dont l'IA), les process de qualification et les séquences de conversion qui rendront l'équipe plus performante et l'expérience investisseur plus fluide.

VOS PERSPECTIVES D'ÉVOLUTION À 6-12 MOIS

Vous rejoignez une structure d'investissement en pleine accélération.

  • Sur votre premier trimestre de présence : votre priorité est de maîtriser le run commercial sur nos offres, de délivrer des résultats tangibles de closing et de déployer vos premiers chantiers d'optimisation de process et de CRM.

  • À horizon 6 à 12 mois : en fonction de la régularité de vos performances et de votre impact sur la structuration du pôle, votre périmètre d'intervention (business, pilotage et encadrement) a vocation à s'élargir significativement pour accompagner la montée en puissance de nos nouvelles lignes d'investissement et de l'équipe. Chez nous, la performance dicte l'évolution.

LE PROFIL QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

  • Un historique de performance avéré (3 à 6 ans d'expérience, pas un poste de sortie d'école) : vous venez d'un environnement exigeant (FinTech, WealthTech, plateforme d'investissement, scale-up B2B/B2C Premium ou gestion privée dynamique). Vous avez déjà prouvé votre capacité à conclure des opérations de manière autonome sur des cycles courts et moyens.

  • L'alliage rare entre la relation client et les opérations (Closer / Builder) : vous maîtrisez les codes de la vente consultative de haut niveau, mais vous savez également qu'une croissance saine passe par la donnée et les process. Sans avoir nécessairement tout bâti seul(e) de zéro, vous justifiez d'un bagage concret dans la gestion rigoureuse d'un pipeline, l'optimisation d'un CRM et la mise en place d'automatisations.

  • Aisance financière et agilité intellectuelle : vous comprenez les fondamentaux du Venture Capital et de l'investissement privé, apprenez vite, saisissez les enjeux patrimoniaux de nos clients et savez instaurer un climat de confiance immédiat avec des interlocuteurs de haut niveau.

  • L'état d'esprit d'une structure d'investissement : vous recherchez un environnement volontairement resserré, véloce et directement responsable de son périmètre et de sa croissance. Vous appréciez un fonctionnement horizontal avec peu de strates, où l'exigence est élevée, les décisions rapides et votre impact directement mesurable, sans formalisme inutile.

RÉMUNÉRATION, CADRE & PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT

  • Rémunération : package attractif (fixe + variable) calibré selon votre expérience et votre profil à l'entrée, avec une trajectoire d'évolution directe à 6-12 mois liée à votre impact et à l'élargissement de vos responsabilités.

  • Lieu et télétravail : bureaux au cœur de Paris (2e, Opéra), télétravail partiel possible.

  • Processus rapide en 3 étapes :
    1. Call d'échange (20 min) -> 2. Cas pratique (Closing & Structuration) -> 3. Rencontre avec l'équipe et la Direction dans nos locaux.

title: IT Lead (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest zunächst die IT unserer Berliner Zentrale. Du sorgst dafür, dass Mitarbeitende arbeitsfähig sind, Zugänge sicher verwaltet werden und Geräte sowie Netzwerk zuverlässig funktionieren.

Gleichzeitig entwickelst du Standards und Abläufe, die auch bei der nächsten Hausverwaltung funktionieren. Mittelfristig begleitest du die IT-Integration unserer Tochterunternehmen und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem externen IT-Partner zusammen.

Du berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Product. Mit wachsender Verantwortung kannst du dich in die Rolle des Head of IT für die Buena-Gruppe entwickeln.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du hältst unsere IT in Berlin am Laufen. Du unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen vor Ort, löst technische Probleme und betreust unser UniFi-Netzwerk.
  • Du verantwortest Google Workspace. Du verwaltest Nutzer, Gruppen, Berechtigungen, Shared Drives und Lizenzen und setzt verlässliche Sicherheitseinstellungen um.
  • Du organisierst Ein- und Austritte. Neue Mitarbeitende starten mit eingerichteten Konten und Geräten. Beim Austritt kümmerst du dich um Zugriffsrechte, Datensicherung und die Rücknahme der Hardware.
  • Du verwaltest unsere Geräte. Du betreust Laptops und Mobilgeräte mit NinjaOne sowie Apple-Geräte über den Apple Business Manager und die angebundene Geräteverwaltung.
  • Du verbesserst wiederkehrende Abläufe. Du erkennst unnötige Handarbeit, automatisierst sinnvolle Schritte und dokumentierst Prozesse so, dass andere damit arbeiten können.
  • Du begleitest neue Standorte. Du verschaffst dir einen Überblick über deren IT, planst notwendige Anpassungen und setzt sie gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Partner um. Dafür reist du gelegentlich zu unseren Hausverwaltungen.
  • Für die Tochterunternehmen liegt dein Schwerpunkt auf Integration, Standards und Zusammenarbeit mit den IT-Partnern. Den täglichen Support vor Ort organisieren wir gemeinsam mit diesen Partnern.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Systemadministration und kannst eine IT-Umgebung eigenständig betreuen.
  • Du kennst Google Workspace gut und hast Erfahrung mit Geräteverwaltung, beispielsweise NinjaOne, Jamf oder Intune.
  • Du bist mit macOS, iOS und dem Apple Business Manager vertraut und verfügst über solide Netzwerkgrundkenntnisse, idealerweise mit UniFi.
  • Du hast bereits einen IT-Prozess verbessert, eine neue Lösung eingeführt oder eine Systemumstellung begleitet und kannst deinen eigenen Beitrag erklären.
  • Du gehst Fehlern systematisch auf den Grund und kannst entscheiden, was zuerst gelöst werden muss.
  • Du erklärst technische Themen verständlich und arbeitest verbindlich mit Mitarbeitenden und externen Dienstleistern zusammen.
  • Du möchtest vor Ort in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg arbeiten, bist zu gelegentlichen Reisen bereit und sprichst sehr gut Deutsch sowie gut Englisch.
  • Eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist hilfreich. Einschlägige Praxiserfahrung zählt genauso. Führungserfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung; du solltest Lust haben, mit der Aufgabe zu wachsen und zunehmend übergreifende Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Was du bei uns bekommst

  • Verantwortung für einen Bereich, den du aktiv mitgestaltest.
  • Die Perspektive, mit Buena in eine Head-of-IT-Rolle hineinzuwachsen.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Head of Integration und kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Attraktives Gehalt und 500 € „Close-to-Office“-Bonus.
  • MacBook und Studio Display.
  • 110 € Essenszuschuss und 50 € Fitnesszuschuss.
  • Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.
  • Tägliches Frühstück und Spezialitätenkaffee im Büro.

Lerne uns kennen

Im Bewerbungsprozess sprechen wir über Aufgaben und Entscheidungen aus deiner bisherigen Arbeit. Vor Ort lösen wir gemeinsam ein praxisnahes IT-Szenario. Dabei interessiert uns, wie du Probleme eingrenzt, Prioritäten setzt und deine Überlegungen erklärst.

title: IT Support Specialist L2 (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

 

We are looking for a hands-on IT Support Specialist to join our IT team in Berlin.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, takes ownership of their work, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.

You will be responsible for providing reliable IT support, managing incidents and service requests, supporting device lifecycle operations, and ensuring a smooth employee experience.

 

We are looking for someone who can work independently, communicate confidently with stakeholders, and balance urgent requests with structured service delivery.

 

What you'll do:

  • Own and resolve L1/L2 technical support requests end-to-end, ensuring timely resolution and adherence to SLAs.

  • Provide hands-on walk-in and remote IT support across multiple locations.

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, connectivity and application issues across Windows, MacOS, iOS and Android devices.

  • Manage, prioritize and document tickets in Jira Service Management or similar ITSM platforms.

  • Investigate recurring incidents, identify potential root causes and collaborate with relevant teams on resolution.

  • Escalate complex issues appropriately while maintaining ownership and tracking progress.

  • Manage competing priorities in a high-volume support environment while maintaining service quality.

  • Configure, deploy and maintain laptops, mobile devices and peripherals using Microsoft Intune and other endpoint management tools.

  • Maintain accurate IT asset records, including device assignments, returns, replacements and inventory.

  • Support hardware lifecycle activities, including provisioning, repairs and secure disposal, in line with IT security policies.

  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding, including device preparation, access provisioning, equipment handovers and returns.

  • Assist with large onboarding waves, ensuring timely preparation, tracking and delivery of devices.

  • Troubleshoot Microsoft Teams Rooms, conferencing equipment and related AV systems.

  • Provide technical support for Microsoft 365, Teams and other workplace collaboration tools.

  • Identify opportunities to improve support processes, reduce recurring issues and enhance the employee experience.

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides and knowledge base articles.

  • Collaborate with distributed IT teams to ensure consistent service delivery across locations.

  • Communicate proactively with employees and stakeholders, setting realistic expectations and providing timely updates.

  • Follow established IT processes, security standards and escalation procedures.

 

What you'll bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on IT support experience in a corporate or enterprise environment.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows and macOS environments.

  • Practical experience supporting Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and enterprise applications.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Intune or similar endpoint management tools.

  • Experience with ITSM platforms such as Jira Service Management.

  • Understanding of ITIL principles, incident management, request fulfilment and SLA-driven support.

  • Experience with hardware provisioning, device troubleshooting and IT asset management.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks and manage competing requests.

  • Strong communication and customer service skills, including handling challenging situations professionally.

  • A proactive, accountable and solution-oriented approach.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting large-scale onboarding and offboarding operations.

  • Familiarity with Snipe-IT or similar IT asset management systems.

  • Experience troubleshooting Microsoft Teams Rooms and audiovisual equipment.

  • Basic networking knowledge, including VPN, DNS, DHCP and connectivity troubleshooting.

  • Basic scripting knowledge using PowerShell or Bash.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Defender and endpoint security concepts.

  • Experience working with distributed or international IT teams.

  • Awareness of ISO 27001, GDPR and IT security best practices.

     

Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

 

What we offer:

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

  • The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

  • The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.

  • Investing in your future – We don’t just think sustainably when it comes to energy, but also when it comes to you. Take advantage of our company pension scheme to build a solid foundation for your future, step by step.

  • Make your home smart – Sustainability starts at your doorstep. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a permanent 25% discount on the entire Bosch Smart Home product range – for an even more efficient and connected home.

title: Junior Projektentwickler (m/w/d) Batteriespeicher
descriptionHtml:
Über Return

Gestalte mit uns die Energieinfrastruktur von morgen.

Mit mehr als 100 Experten und Aktivitäten in mehreren europäischen Märkten – darunter Deutschland, die Niederlande, Belgien und Spanien – treiben wir den Ausbau dieser Schlüsseltechnologie voran. Eine starke Kapitalbasis, etablierte Partnerschaften und eine schnell wachsende Projektpipeline bilden die Grundlage für unsere ambitionierten Wachstumsziele.

Deine Aufgaben in der Projektentwicklung

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit erfahrenen Projektentwicklern sowie internen und externen Projektpartnern zusammen und übernimmst zunehmend eigene Verantwortung.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen schnell umzusetzen.

title: Junior Sales Trader  (Berlin based)
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

We offer a highly competitive compensation package with On-Target Earnings (OTE) , designed to reward high performance and results. This includes a strong base salary complemented by an uncapped commission structure, meaning there is no limit to what you can earn — your success directly drives your income. Top performers have the opportunity to significantly exceed OTE, supported by a transparent, performance-driven bonus plan that truly rewards achievement.

Building on this performance-driven culture, not every candidate ticks every box — and that’s why we value individuals with a growth mindset who bring potential, initiative, and a willingness to learn.

What you will do

  • Trading & Sales: Sell and trade construction materials across the DACH and key European markets. You’ll build and manage customer relationships, negotiate pricing and volumes, and take full ownership of deals from lead generation to closing. Your focus will be on driving profitable transactions in a fast-paced, margin-sensitive environment.

  • Market & Strategy: Track market trends, pricing, and demand across various regions. You’ll run competitive analyses, identify trading opportunities, and contribute to our buying and selling strategies with real-time insights.

  • Operational Execution: Ensure smooth end-to-end execution of trades — from order processing and logistics coordination to invoicing and delivery follow-up. You'll collaborate closely with the Ops and Finance teams to make sure everything runs like clockwork.

  • Team & Culture: We’re building a high-performing, entrepreneurial team. You’ll contribute to its growth by bringing energy, curiosity, and a hands-on mindset. As we grow, so will your role — fast.

Who you are

  • You demonstrate excellent German/Italian/French language skills , both strong verbal and written communication skills in English

  • You bring first experience in a highly competitive environment such as Management Consulting, Investment Banking, Venture Capital or a high-growth startup.

  • You are interested in and passionate about growth startup and to change a traditional industry together with an international team

  • You have strong analytical and communication skills

  • You possess a hands-on mentality - only the implementation satisfies you.

  • You demonstrate ability to speak directly with customers, suppliers, partners and investors, and take the initiative to get involved

title: L3 Support Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role 

We are building our L3 Support Line from scratch to serve as the datacenter center of expertise for servers, firmware (BIOS/BMC), and deep Linux diagnostics across Europe and the US.

This is a senior technical role focused on deep investigations, cross-site pattern detection, and driving permanent fixes with R&D and ODM vendors. You will turn complex incidents into scalable solutions and elevate L1/L2 capabilities through strong technical enablement.

The work location is in Béthune, France. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

Deep Technical Investigation (Primary Focus)

  • Lead root cause analysis beyond L2 depth (GPU failures, firmware issues, Linux-level faults, HW/SW interactions).

  • Detect recurring patterns across sites and convert findings into durable fixes.

  • Own technical workstreams during high-severity incidents.

Vendor & R&D Collaboration

  • Build evidence packs and drive escalations with ODM and R&D.

  • Push for firmware, component, and platform-level resolutions.

Firmware & Platform Readiness (BIOS/BMC)

  • Support validation and rollout of firmware updates (risk assessment, staging, rollback planning).

  • Help operationalize platform standards across datacenters.

Knowledge & Enablement

  • Create scalable runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and error catalogs.

Hands-on Support (As Needed)

  • Travel to datacenters for complex troubleshooting, new platform readiness, or incident containment.

We expect you to have: 

  • Strong hands-on experience with datacenter servers and deep Linux troubleshooting.

  • Ability to diagnose across hardware, BIOS/BMC firmware, and Linux (logs, drivers, storage basics, performance triage).

  • Structured incident response experience and clear communication under pressure.

  • Experience driving evidence-based escalations with vendors/R&D.

  • Fluent English (written and spoken).

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  • Strong familiarity with GPU server platforms and tooling (for example: nvidia-smi, dcgmi, Linux logs correlation).

  • Experience with ipmitool and Redfish workflows, firmware lifecycle, and staged rollouts.

  • Scripting skills (bash and basic Python) for log collection, triage automation, and simple reliability analysis.

  • Exposure to OCP-based platforms and ODM manufacturing ecosystems.

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Lab Automation Lead
descriptionHtml:
About us, and our mission

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI.

Position overview

Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. However, you do need a proven experience in working deeply embedded in interdisciplinary teams.

Key responsibilities

  • Map cell culture workflows end to end and identify key process automation and optimisation opportunities.

  • Own the automation roadmap. Present and lead the implementation of the major decisions to Orakl’s leadership.

  • In line with the automation strategy you will have identified, evaluate vendors and integrators. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project.

  • Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds.

  • Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests.

  • Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists.

  • Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step.

  • Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly.

  • Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs.

  • Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management.

In this role you will collaborate closely with our cell culture, cell biology and data science teams. You will be at the heart of Orakl Oncology’s capabilities roadmap and help generate unprecedented amounts of biological data to power scientific discovery in cancer.

Key qualifications

Must-have

  • Engineering degree (generalist, robotics, industrial, mechanical or process engineering) or equivalent, and at least eight years of experience.

  • Exceptional process thinking skills: you map flows, time operations, find bottlenecks and question the processes.

  • Experience in supplier negotiation and budget ownership on your own projects.

  • Experience in PLC and robot programming concepts, scheduling software, instrument interfaces, basic scripting.

  • You enjoy and are comfortable spending time on the floor with operators. You have experience in communicating and operating with engineers, technicians and workers at the heart of production processes.

  • Autonomy: you tell your manager what you decided and why, not what you need decided.

  • Fluency in English is required.

Nice-to-have

  • You have put automated lines, cells or special machines into service end to end: requirements, vendor selection, negotiation, integration, factory and site acceptance, ramp-up, budget. This doesn’t have to be in a lab environment : plant, food and fermentation, pharma or cosmetics are other examples of relevant experience.

  • Automation in life-science or regulated environments: cell culture, biotech, food and fermentation, pharma, cleanroom or BSL-2 work.

  • A working understanding of cell culture and what it demands: sterility, contamination risk, variability between samples, and steps governed by the biological pace.

  • Liquid handling, plate-based workflows, incubators and imagers; laboratory scheduling software.

  • Experience hiring and leading an automation team.

What we offer

  • You will be Orakl's first automation hire. You will have a unique degree of ownership and scope with a strong mandate to deliver.

  • Short decision lines and fast execution.

  • An interdisciplinary environment with a results-driven culture.

Recruitment process

  1. Introductory call with Talent / People — 20 minutes

  2. Interview with the Lab Director, hiring manager — 45 minutes, including a 15-minute live mini-case on a small lab process

  3. Technical deep dive with the CTO and the Lab Director

  4. Case study on a real part of our lab: a take-home capped at four hours, then a half day on site with presentation, challenge round, lab walk.

  5. Cross-functional interviews with the technicians who run the culture, Platform Operations, the Senior Laboratory Engineers and the Data team — 60 minutes

  6. Reference calls: a former manager, a vendor or integrator you negotiated with, and an operator who ran a line you delivered

  7. Founder conversation — 45 minutes

title: Lead Product Manager, Inference
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The role

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud. Our inference platform already serves production traffic at scale. We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to own the inference portfolio within our Cloud & Inference organization.

You'll set strategy, write specs, sit with customers running production traffic, and work across our inference, infrastructure, and go-to-market teams to deliver real customer impact. Example problems you may work on include figuring out the next inference product we should launch to help our customers scale their AI workloads or how we cut fraudulent free-tier usage without adding friction for legitimate users.

You will work on state of the art infrastructure, in close collaboration with our science and research engineering teams. Your job is to turn that infrastructure into products that AI-native startups and enterprises pay for, integrated with our developer platform Studio.

You will operate as an individual contributor first — taking end-to-end ownership of complex and significant product lines — while building the foundation for the inference PM team as the portfolio grows. The size and shape of the team reporting into the role will be defined together with the VP Product once you're in place; from day one the expectation is hands-on product leadership, not people management.

You will be the first PM fully dedicated to inference and the most senior product hire in the space. You will report to the VP Product - Cloud & Inference, and work day-to-day with our inference engineering teams in the US and Europe.

What you'll do

  • Strategy and vision: define the vision, strategy, and annual goals for the inference portfolio, aligned with customer needs and company objectives. Benchmark the managed-inference field and pick where we win.

  • Roadmap and execution: own the full lifecycle for serverless inference, dedicated endpoints, and adjacent services. Prioritize, ship, measure, iterate. Economics: own adoption, revenue contribution, and gross margin for your products. Treat cost-per-token, unit economics, and capacity tradeoffs as product decisions, and partner with GTM, Finance and Marketing on pricing, packaging, and launches.

  • Customers: spend real time with AI-native startups and enterprises running advanced production workloads. Turn their constraints, like latency, throughput, compliance, and cost, into roadmap choices.

  • Engineering partnership: work daily with inference engineering and the cloud infrastructure teams behind our data centers on capacity planning, scheduling, routing, and reliability.

  • Research and open source: track open-source inference advances and emerging model architectures, and turn them into performance and efficiency gains for the product.

  • Team building: as the portfolio scales, help shape and grow the inference PM team — hiring, mentoring, and setting the product bar.

What we're looking for

  • Deep product experience in tech and infrastructure with a track record of bringing inference, cloud infrastructure, or large-scale distributed systems to market. You have built robust, at-scale AI infrastructure first-hand.

  • An engineering background before moving into product management.

  • You have taken an infra or inference product from early stage to material revenue and adoption, owning complex and significant product lines end to end.

  • Player-coach disposition: you lead from the front — hands-on product work now, with the range and appetite to build and coach a team as we scale.

  • Fluency in the economics of the business: gross margin, unit economics, and the tradeoffs behind token pricing and GPU capacity.

  • High ownership and a strong bias for action. You prototype with AI coding tools, write your own specs, and unblock yourself without waiting for engineers or designers.

  • Low ego, comfort in ambiguity, and credibility with executives, engineers, and customers alike.

title: Marketing Manager (DACH)
descriptionHtml:
The finance function is broken.

Finance teams at fast-growing, multi-entity companies are outgrowing their single-entity ledgers and facing a familiar crossroads: bolt on more tools, or go full corporate ERP. Neither option is good. The Frankenstack breaks. The ERP weighs you down with implementation fees and consultants. There has to be a better, more AI native way.

There is. It's Light.

Light is building an AI-native financial platform for modern companies. Fast to implement, intuitive to use, and designed to get smarter over time. We call it organic software.

Companies like Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy already run on Light. Following our $30M Series A last year, we're building the team that will make Light the default finance platform for the next generation of businesses.

  

Why DACH, why now.

To win Europe, you have to win DACH. We know this. That's why we're making our first dedicated hire for the region and treating it as a must-win market. You won't be a satellite of a global team running templated playbooks. You'll be a builder. The person who decides what Light looks and feels like in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

  

What you'll be doing.

  • Building Light's presence in DACH from the ground up, shaping our GTM strategy, and becoming one of the defining faces of the region. If you'd rather set the direction than follow it, this is your gig.

  • Owning the full DACH events calendar. Finhack hackathons, third-party sponsorships, roundtables. From concept to follow-up, you run it.

  • Managing the regional budget, knowing where to spend and where to hold back.

  • Working with our brand team on everything from regional messaging and localisation to experiential campaigns that cut through in a market full of noise.

  • Bringing on-the-ground market data back to your VP Marketing and Growth Lead to sharpen paid activity, targeting, and messaging across the region.

  • Driving regional pipeline, working across events, campaigns, and community to build a consistent flow of qualified opportunities for the sales team.

  • Partnering with RevOps to keep pipeline clean, prospects moving, and nothing falling through the cracks between marketing and sales.

  • Enabling the sales team with the collateral, messaging, and market context they need to win in DACH.

  • Building community, not just pipeline. You'll build relationships with press, analysts, and partners, but the bigger goal is an ecosystem of likeminded changemakers around a product that's transforming the finance function.

  

What we think you'll need.*

  • Meaningful experience in field or regional marketing at a B2B SaaS company, ideally one that was building out international presence from a non-DACH HQ.

  • Native-level German fluency. You can write the copy, run the room, and build the relationships.

  • A real track record running field marketing and events from start to finish..

  • The ability to work across Sales, RevOps, and brand without losing momentum or creating friction. You know how to get things done in a cross-functional team.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI tooling, not just comfort with it. We're an AI-native company and use AI across everything we build and do. Just as Light helps finance teams do their best work, we expect our people to use AI to do theirs.

  • To be based in London, with frequent travel.

*But really, what do we know? If the crux of the role sounds right but you don't tick every box, reach out anyway and make your case.

  

The good stuff.

🏢 In-office culture, with a high talent-density team.
💸 Competitive salary.
🏝 25 days annual leave plus public holidays in your country of employment.
🚀 The chance to shape a category from the inside, not just market around it.
🌍 Regular travel to Copenhagen, London, New York, and wherever the action is.
🥳 Company off-sites twice a year. The last one was in Italy.

  

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Medior AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Van slimme AI-modellen naar oplossingen die écht werken.

Een AI-model bouwen is één ding. Zorgen dat het betrouwbaar draait, gekoppeld is aan echte data en waarde toevoegt bij een klant: daar wordt het interessant.

Bij adesso werk je aan AI-oplossingen die verder gaan dan experimenten, van machine learning en MLOps tot generatieve AI, LLM's en agents. Je bouwt, implementeert en verbetert oplossingen die organisaties echt gebruiken.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Medior AI Engineer werk je samen met senior AI Engineers en Forward Deployed Engineers aan klantprojecten. Je pakt zelfstandig onderdelen op en groeit in architectuur en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid.

  • AI ontwikkelen: je bouwt ML-modellen, LLM-toepassingen en agentic workflows.

  • Van idee naar productie: je bouwt data- en ML-pipelines, automatiseert deployments en zorgt voor monitoring en betrouwbaarheid.

  • Slim integreren: je koppelt AI aan bestaande systemen, API's en cloud- en dataplatformen.

  • Meedenken met de klant: je vertaalt vraagstukken naar praktische, schaalbare oplossingen.

  • Kennis delen: je legt herbruikbare patronen vast en deelt wat je leert met je collega's.

Projecten die verder gaan dan het model

We richten ons op retail en e-commerce, finance en utilities. Denk aan:

  • Prognoses waar planners op durven te sturen, van retailassortiment tot netbelasting.

  • Intelligente documentverwerking, zoals KYC-dossiers of inspectierapporten, met herleidbare bronnen.

  • Agents die werk voorbereiden in klantenservice en backoffice, met evals en guardrails.

  • Computer vision, zoals in de fitnessbranche, waar we onveilige situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties herkennen.

De uitdaging zit niet alleen in het model, maar ook in betrouwbaarheid, integratie en de werking in de praktijk. Je kiest steeds de techniek die bij het probleem past.


Wat breng je mee?

  • Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en in productie brengen van ML- of GenAI-oplossingen.

  • Goede kennis van Python, SQL en machine learning.

  • Ervaring met MLOps en/of LLM's, RAG en AI-agents.

  • Kennis van minimaal één cloudplatform (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

  • Je werkt met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

  • Je denkt vanuit de klantvraag en legt technische keuzes helder uit.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Wat dit níet is

  • Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

  • Geen notebook-kerkhof. Een model is pas af als het in productie draait en gebruikt wordt.

  • Geen GenAI omdat het kan. Soms is een klassiek model beter, soms een LLM; jij kiest wat past.

  • Geen werk op afroep. Je denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee, niet pas als het ontwerp al vastligt.

Het team

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. Jij gaat als AI Engineer de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Heb je diepe kennis van finance, retail of utilities en wil je dichter op de klant zitten? Kijk dan ook naar onze FDE-vacatures. Twijfel je? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen welke rol het best past.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

  • Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

  • AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

  • adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit richting architectuur en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • €4.950–€6.050 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur

  • 8% vakantiegeld

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week

  • Een mobiliteitsvergoeding bovenop je salaris

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden

  • Goede pensioenregeling

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

title: Mid Market Account Executive - Benelux
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is a leader in a dynamic market. As a public company listed on the NYSE with $2.1B in ARR, we deliver mission-critical solutions to physical operations globally. This position is tailored for high-performing professionals seeking to accelerate their professional growth. We are seeking account managers to oversee deal sizes ranging from €10k to €300k across a comprehensive suite of 15+ product solutions, engaging key decision-makers including Finance Directors and Managing Directors. Joining our team offers the autonomy and support to tackle challenging objectives and drive impactful results.

While this position offers remote flexibility across the Netherlands, periodic travel to meet clients on-site is expected (typically bi-weekly).

You should apply if:

  • You want to help define the future of physical operations: Your contributions will directly enable real-world impact—supporting critical infrastructure, streamlining supply chains, and advancing workforce safety.
  • You prioritize continuous prospecting: Physical operations encompass wide-ranging sectors where contacts are often mobile. Top sales reps actively identify prospective organizations and build meaningful pipeline connection points.
  • You possess deep curiosity about diverse business models: You will explore various physical sectors, from field services to manufacturing and food distribution, striving to understand operational details at scale.
  • You are committed to continuous learning: Navigating our cloud platform involves mastering new operational domains and solutions, requiring dedicated focus to achieve long-term growth.
  • You foster authentic long-term partnerships: Many target organizations are transitioning from legacy methods to modern cloud technology. Earning long-term trust is core to helping them digitally transform.
  • You thrive on high-performing teams: Working at Samsara means being part of a team dedicated to excellence and pushing boundaries as we build for the future.

In this role you will:

  • Drive revenue acquisition: Take ownership of net-new customer growth by generating 80-90% of your opportunity pipeline through outbound efforts.
  • Expand key regional markets: Contribute to the growth of our mid-market segment across the Benelux region, leveraging expanding regional momentum.
  • Leverage structured methodologies: Utilize professional sales frameworks such as MEDDPICC and Command the Message to effectively guide customer engagements.

Minimum Requirements for the role:

  • Sales background: Minimum. 18 months closing experience within a proactive SaaS outreach model, demonstrating independent PG/pipeline generation.
  • Consistent quota achievement: Demonstrated performance exceeding targets within complex technology environments.
  • Complex deal navigation: Ability to manage multi-stakeholder evaluations and technical proofs-of-concept effectively.
  • Language proficiency: Native-level fluency in Dutch.

Advantageous:

  • Operational interest: Eagerness to discover how physical operations function across sectors to better address customer needs.
  • Structured methodology: A disciplined sales practice focused on consistent activity execution to produce predictable results.
  • Analytical focus: A data-informed mindset toward managing pipeline volume, discovery quality, and multi-threading for accurate forecasting.
  • Adaptability and growth: A proactive focus on continuous learning, incorporating feedback, and refining tactics over time.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary€132.000—€132.000 EUR

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

  • Prior experience in adult, dating, or adjacent creative industries a huge bonus

Unsere Spezialitäten umfassen unter anderen goldbraune Brötchen, saftiges Laugengebäck und knusprige Ciabatta.

The digital customer journey at Wellis is growing rapidly and becoming more complex. To take it to the next level, we're looking for a Mobile Developer (iOS & Android). What We Offer

Hiring Process

title: Model Risk Officer
descriptionHtml:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used.

This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. You'll design the policy, validation approach and governance from scratch, starting with the credit, IRRBB and capital models already in design for our future capital and liquidity planning. Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day.

You'll also work with our Machine Learning team and the Domains already deploying models, so you can shape how we manage model risk today, not just in a banking future. Your challenge and sign off will be visible to senior leadership, audit and, eventually, our regulator. As Mollie grows and matures its model risk management, your scope grows from building the framework to running an ongoing model risk cycle.

What you'll ship

  • Build and own Mollie's model risk management framework and policy, including model risk appetite, validation standards and the model risk lifecycle.

  • Set up and maintain the model inventory for credit, IRRBB and capital models, with materiality and risk tiering for each.

  • Coordinate independent second line validation and challenge before models are used, including credit risk and ECL, IRRBB, and Pillar 1 and Pillar 2 capital models.

  • Design the ongoing monitoring and re-validation cycle with the Machine Learning team, covering performance testing, limitation tracking and re-validation triggers.

  • Partner with model owners in Credit Risk and Treasury ALM, and coordinate within the second line Risk function, so model risk challenge is built into the wider risk and capital frameworks.

  • Coordinate clear, well documented validation reports and model risk information that stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors and internal audit.

What you'll bring

  • Around 5 to 7 years of experience in model risk management or model validation within a bank, preferably across at least one of credit, IRRBB and capital models.

  • Solid working knowledge of ECB model risk expectations and how model validation should be structured and evidenced.

  • Comfort building a model risk framework and validation approach from the ground up. You're excited to write the first playbook.

  • Strong quantitative skills to critically assess model methodology, assumptions and performance, and the discipline to document your findings so others, including a regulator, can follow them.

  • The ability to explain model limitations and validation findings to model owners and senior stakeholders, and the confidence to hold your ground under challenge.

  • Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of model validation that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgement and challenge.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.
