title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Partner Enablement Lead
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The role

Omnea is one of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and enterprise deals now make up over 30% of our pipeline. Enterprise deals bring a consultancy into the room, and the largest global SIs are already asking how to get their consultants trained on Omnea. Demand is running ahead of our capacity to train them, and the person who closes that gap sets how fast Omnea grows.

You’ll be our founding Partner Enablement Lead. You’ll turn consultants at the world’s leading firms into accredited Omnea practitioners who deploy Omnea at Russell 2000 companies to the standard our own team holds. Every consultant you accredit is delivery capacity we never have to hire, and every partner-led go-live puts Omnea in front of another enterprise buyer.

You’ll design accreditation from first principles: module by module, earned through live deployments and practical assessment, so a client who sees the badge can trust the delivery behind it. You’ll build the resource bank consultants carry onto every engagement. You’ll train their trainers, so partners teach their own clients and drive the adoption that keeps customers renewing. And you’ll make the case to a Senior Partner for why an Omnea practice grows their firm’s revenue.

Our tiering is selective by design. We aim for one or two strategic partners in each market, each delivering to our standard. As partners prove capability, they take on more of each implementation. Your programme decides when they’re ready. The bar is deliberately high, so a partner-led go-live matches one run by our own team.

You’ll work with our Solutions & Implementation team, who hold the product expertise, and our GTM team, who know how we win. You own the programme that turns what they know into a partner network.

If you’ve built a function from nothing and want to define how the consulting industry delivers the market leading AI solution with an enormous TAM, this is the role.

What you'll do

  • Formalise the partner programme. Turn how we work with partners today into clear tiers, with what each one requires, for every kind of firm we work with.

  • Build accreditation. Define what a certified Omnea consultant can do and how they prove it. A client who sees the certification should be able to trust the delivery behind it.

  • Own enablement for our flagship partners. Take over their training from the colleagues running it today, and sit alongside them on live deployments.

  • Launch AI-powered self-serve training for entry-level tiers, so a new partner firm can get credible on Omnea without waiting for us.

  • Build the training repository and delivery assets partners use on live engagements, starting with implementation playbooks and sandbox environments.

  • Measure it. Track time to certification and the quality of partner-led go-lives, and take what you find back to Product and Solutions & Implementation.

What good looks like

In your first 90 days, formal accreditation is live and our flagship partners are certifying their teams through it.

By the end of year one, partner-led go-lives land to the same standard as ours, and the self-serve path certifies consultants without anyone at Omnea in the loop. You'll also have decided what the function needs next and who to hire.

Longer term, this is the programme every consultancy in procurement technology trains on, and you're the person who defined it.

You are

  • A builder. You've built a function or a company from scratch, and you can show what existed before you arrived and what existed after.

  • Ready to formalise. You can take something that works at small scale and rebuild it for a much bigger one without breaking what's live.

  • Someone consultants follow. You can hold a room at any level, from an Associate on their first engagement to a Senior Partner deciding whether to put their name behind Omnea.

  • Already getting results with AI. You can point to something you built or changed with AI and the business outcome it produced.

  • Hands on. You’ll be deep in the product, building in the sandbox yourself before you teach anyone else to.

  • Low ego, steep learning curve. You'll do the unglamorous work yourself and get better every week.

  • Here to build a generational company, with the expectations that come with it.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Platform Reliability & Performance Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

Our lab is scaling fast, and every system behind the platform takes more load each month. Customers and AI labs build automated workflows on our API, so it has to stay fast and up.

You own platform reliability and performance: observability, compute performance and cost, CI and developer tooling, and the infrastructure underneath.

What You'll Do

  • Own observability. Alerts and traces the team relies on, so we see a problem before a customer does.

  • Drive performance and cost. Profile and optimize our compute jobs and APIs, so throughput grows faster than cost and latency.

  • Make developers fast. Fast, reliable CI, builds, deploys and local setup.

  • Set reliability targets. SLOs, incident response, postmortems, and an on-call that people can live with.

  • Keep the platform secure and current. Dependencies, secrets, supply chain and infra migrations, handled before they become fires.

What We're Looking For

  • Production reliability experience. You have run systems where uptime and latency mattered, and you think in failure modes and SLOs.

  • Performance depth. You have profiled real systems and made them measurably faster or cheaper.

  • Developer-experience mindset. You treat your teammates as users.

  • Strong software fundamentals. Production Python or TypeScript, plus the tests and tooling that make the work repeatable.

  • Autonomous and pragmatic. You find what needs doing without a spec, and you know when to harden and when to ship.

  • Technical fit. SRE, platform or backend experience. Hands-on with observability tooling, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.

  • Location: London.

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

title: Principal Speciality Sales Engineer - UK
descriptionHtml:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Principal Specialist Sales Engineer to join our team. This is a UK based (Remote) role, reporting to the Director, Specialist Sales Engineering in the Data Security Specialist Team. 

Data has become the most targeted asset in the enterprise. As organisations accelerate AI adoption, the question of where sensitive data lives, who can access it, and how it moves across cloud environments has become a boardroom-level conversation — and a C-suite buying priority.

This is a specialist role. You'll go deep — operating as the technical authority for Data Security across the UK, engaging in opportunities alongside our Account Sales Consultants to bring subject matter expertise that changes the outcome of deals.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Partner with Account Sales Consultants as the data security SME — supporting discovery, competitive positioning, technical objection handling, and driving the technical win on deals where data security is a primary driver or blocker
  • Lead hands-on DSPM, DLP, and AI data risk workshops with CISOs, Chief Privacy Officers, and data engineering stakeholders, translating complex data risk into measurable business outcomes
  • Build and deliver tailored product demonstrations of Zscaler's data security platform — including AI-powered data classification, automated DLP, and DSPM posture management
  • Own Proof of Concept (PoC) engagements end-to-end — scoping success criteria, managing technical execution, presenting results, and responding to technical RFIs/RFPs where data security is the primary subject matter
  • Build and share reusable technical assets (demo environments, discovery playbooks, competitive battlecards), represent Zscaler as a data security thought leader at UK industry events, and serve as the primary conduit between the field and Zscaler's Product and Engineering teams

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • BSCS or equivalent practical experience as a Systems Engineer (SE) or systems integrator
  • 7+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering roles, with at least 3 years selling security or networking solutions in direct or high-touch sales environments
  • Strong technical expertise in Data Protection, DSPM and web-related technologies
  • Proven ability to work effectively in a matrixed environment with the broader GTM team to promote, sell, and support the Data Security business line through value-based selling
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging or willingness to adopt AI tools and technologies to increase productivity, streamline workflows, and accelerate technical sales outcomes

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Direct experience working with Zscaler or competitive solutions in the Data Protection market

title: Product Analyst
descriptionHtml:
London/Hybrid

£40,000 - £60,000 + share options up to £14,500 + Benefits

💬 Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. We’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book,which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

The team

We have a massive vision and even more ideas, but right now, our ambitions are outstripping our capacity. That’s where you come in. We aren't looking for someone to just "run the reports" we’re looking for a foundational member of a growing function who is excited to help us redefine how data influences product.

At Accurx, we don't just wait for a roadmap to be handed down; we expect everyone to help shape it. While you'll be part of a team of expert data and product leaders, you'll be the one in the driver's seat for your domain. You won't be watching from the sidelines - you'll be proactively hunting for insights, challenging our current assumptions, and taking ownership of how data can save clinician time from day one. This is a role for a critical thinker who is energised by the "blank canvas" of a growing function and has the drive to turn raw data into a better reality for millions of patients.

Challenges you’ll solve...

  • You will steer product strategy by partnering with Product Managers to define what success looks like and by monitoring the KPIs that prove our impact on the frontline of healthcare.

  • You will interrogate user behaviour by performing deep-dive analyses that look past the surface to find the "why," ensuring we’re solving the right problems for the right people.

  • You will lead rigorous experiments by helping design and run A/B tests, owning the process from the initial hypothesis through to the final, data-backed recommendation.

  • You will build the engine for self-service insights by creating the dashboards and visualisations that ensure your pod has high-quality data at their fingertips to move fast.


You should apply if...

  • You've worked within a product team environment (not just as a standalone data or BI function), partnering directly with Product Managers, Engineers, and Designers on live product decisions, not just reporting on outcomes after the fact.

  • You are a proactive investigator who doesn't need a ticket to start digging; when things are quiet, you’re already looking for the next trend or bottleneck that we’ve missed.

  • You have a "get stuck in" mindset - you’re excited by a lean environment where you can build your own processes and take on challenges that push you outside your comfort zone.

  • You bring strong Product Thinking with an understanding of user funnels and a hunger to master metrics like activation, retention, and cohort behaviour.

  • You are sharpening a strong technical toolkit, with a solid command of SQL and the ambition to use Python.

  • You are a delivery-focused collaborator who thrives in agile environments and knows how to communicate technical findings clearly to engineers and designers.

  • You’ve used tools like Mixpanel or Amplitude and are ready to become a power user who empowers the whole team through effective data storytelling.

What’s in it for you?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers

  • £40,000 - £60,000 salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team

  • Equity: £14,500 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Built for collaboration: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week

  • Close to our users: Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Support at home: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own chefs: Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches, plus a weekly sweet treat

descriptionHtml:

The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You own Banking Experience: the accounts at the center of customer's relationship with the bank, and the API and dashboards they use to manage them.

In this role you’re responsible for redefining what beautiful software in banking looks like. You'll define account structures that give customers powerful building blocks for their products, and craft intuitive interfaces grounded in a deep understanding of their use cases and workflows.

You report to Will, Head of Product, and work closely with Simon, our CTO. You're expected to operate with full autonomy on your team's roadmap, collaborating with design and engineering.

Your First Six Months

  • Months 1-2: Take over day-to-day ownership of the Banking Experience team - the roadmap, the ways of working, the hard decisions. Establish yourself with customers and how they use our accounts. You define and ship your first project.

  • Months 3-4: Execution mode. You're unblocking engineering daily, making hard prioritization calls, and shipping your roadmap to customers. You're proactively raising the bar across accounts, API, and dashboard by feeding what you learn from customers into the product.

  • Months 5-6: You're working with live customers on the products you've built. Deposits and number of account holders are scaling. You've moved from execution to platform mode - evolving the roadmap based on what our customers are building on top of Augustus.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You want to spend time with customers to intimately understand and then innovate on their workflows.

  • You’re a structured and relentless problem solver.

  • You combine first-principles thinking with deep domain knowledge to make complex processes simple.

  • You have taste and care deeply about the quality of what you build.

  • You leverage AI to push the boundaries of what a PM can do.

  • You’re excited about building a programmable bank and helping shape what that means.

Hard Requirements

  • Experience end-to-end owning and building banking, fintech, or developer platform products.

  • Technical enough to spar on architectural decisions with engineers - you're comfortable in API design discussions, not just UI reviews.

  • You have strong opinions on information architecture and how to organize complex products so they feel simple.

  • Comfortable in customer-facing roles - you've pitched, demoed, and can close early adopters.

  • Based in Berlin or New York, or willing to relocate.

Pay transparency

Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual US base salary range for this role is €90,000-€120,000 + equity.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.

title: Product Manager, Context
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Product Manager on the Context team, you will define and build the foundation for how AI agents access, interact with, and leverage context, data, tools, platforms, and environments, to deliver powerful, scalable solutions. This role exists to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI capabilities and real-world usability, ensuring our agents are both capable and seamlessly integrated into Mistral’s broader product ecosystem.

You’ll work at the intersection of engineering, research, design, and business, aligning stakeholders around a shared vision while driving execution from concept to launch. The impact of your work will shape how users and enterprises interact with AI, unlocking new possibilities for automation, intelligence, and efficiency.

What You Will Do

  • Define and evangelize a clear product strategy for our Context & Search platform, aligning it with company goals and market opportunities.

  • Lead market and UX research to identify unmet needs, competitive gaps, and emerging trends in enterprise AI.

  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation to launch, balancing speed, quality, and user-centric design.

  • Collaborate with design and research teams to create intuitive, high-impact user experiences, iteratively refined by data and feedback.

  • Drive go-to-market efforts, including pricing, positioning, and adoption strategies, in partnership with marketing and sales.

  • Align engineering, design, and business teams around priorities, trade-offs, and timelines to ensure seamless execution.

  • Maintain a dynamic roadmap that delivers quick wins while advancing long-term strategic bets.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on Product Management experience, preferably with a focus on Agentic AI, Context Engineering, Data platforms, MCP/Connectors, Search, Ontology and semantic layers in B2B/Enterprise environments.

  • Strong technical fluency to navigate trade-offs and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.

  • A relentless focus on solving real user problems, backed by data and qualitative insights.

  • Proven ability to align and inspire cross-functional teams—engineering, design, and go-to-market—without direct authority.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling narratives for executives, teams, and users.

  • Adaptability to thrive in dynamic environments where priorities shift rapidly.

  • Low ego, high EQ, and a collaborative mindset to build trust and drive decisions through clarity.

  • A builder’s mindset, with experience turning 0→1 ideas into products users love, and the autonomy to own outcomes end-to-end.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Product Marketing - Agents - Government
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

Earlier this year, we launched ElevenLabs for Government, and are now looking for an exceptional product marketer to help us scale this story into global government and public sector markets.

Government agencies everywhere are being asked to answer more calls, in more languages, with the same amount or less staff. ElevenAgents resolves support, cuts hold times, and reaches people who cannot navigate a website or sit on a phone line. This role is to help us shape these capabilities into every market where governments serve citizens by voice.

  • Own positioning and packaging for ElevenLabs for Government

  • Scale the narrative across regions: National and Local government in the UK, EU, Federal, State and Local in the US, and public sector agencies across APAC, LATAM, and more

  • Anchor everything in citizen outcomes: non-emergency contact centers (311), benefits and eligibility, health and social services, licensing and permitting, and more

  • Position our solution for accessibility, compliance, language requirements, and the security and data residency mandates

  • Lead industry content, landing pages, and thought leadership pieces

Who You Are

  • You are an experienced product marketer who has scaled messaging into Government and Public Sector segments, from a growth or product marketing seat, ideally both

  • You've sold or marketed into more than one segment of public sector

  • Technical enough to become our internal expert on conversational agents: latency, telephony, tool calls, evals, and guardrails

  • Excellent project management across multiple countries, regulatory regimes, and simultaneous launches

  • You take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

This is a full-ownership product role at the centre of one of Allica's most effective growth channels. Accountants already introduce established SMEs to Allica and are often the first port of call when those clients make financial decisions. You will be responsible for turning that relationship into a product experience that drives more recommendations, retention and product depth across their client base. You will define and deliver Allica's proposition for accountants: a product that must feel trustworthy, work flawlessly across a portfolio of client accounts, and set the standard for how Allica builds propositions for the specific people and partners around our SME customers.

You will own the full product lifecycle: setting strategy, shaping the roadmap, leading your squad, and being accountable for commercial outcomes. You will work with a deep understanding of how accountants operate, such as day-to-day reconciliation, VAT and payroll processing, and cash flow advisory across a portfolio of clients, and bring that expertise to bear on a product that is both ambitious and grounded in what accountants and their SME clients actually need.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Own the end-to-end product strategy, vision, roadmap and execution for Allica's accountants proposition

  • Lead a cross-functional squad (Engineering, Design, Data and Operations) to deliver high-quality customer-facing product features

  • Take full commercial accountability for your squad's OKRs — including accountant-driven customer acquisition, growth, retention, and product depth across accountant-connected SMEs

  • Define and implement the accountant access model, from read-only visibility into client accounts toward richer permissions and access controls

  • Define and deliver the accountant-facing product experience — a multi-client experience and workflow tools that help accountants monitor, reconcile and advise across their portfolio of SME clients

  • Partner with Design, UX and Research to use customer discovery, prototyping and iterative research with both accountants and their SME clients to validate what to build next

  • Define metrics, track outcomes, and anchor all decisions in data — building a culture of evidence-based product development within the squad

  • Identify and manage product, regulatory, and delivery risks proactively, working closely with Compliance and Risk teams to ensure the product meets all relevant obligations

  • Maintain a clear and well-communicated roadmap, providing regular updates to the Tribe Lead, wider squads and leadership

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Significant experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager in financial services, ideally building products for accountants, bookkeepers or other professional services audiences

  • Deep understanding of how accountants and bookkeepers operate day to day, including practice workflows, client management, and common accounting software such as Xero, QuickBooks and Sage

  • Experience taking a product from early MVP to a fully-fledged proposition, ideally within banking, fintech or professional services software

  • Strong commercial acumen — comfortable owning OKRs and making data-driven prioritisation decisions

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to operate confidently across technical, commercial and regulatory audiences

  • Decisive, with a track record of moving quickly while maintaining quality and managing risk appropriately

  • Experience working in agile squads with Engineers, Designers, Data Analysts and Operations

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support
descriptionHtml:
Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren.

Wie ben jij

Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.


Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.


Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.


Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.


Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers.


Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat.

Wat ga je doen

Wat breng je mee?
Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen.

• Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;

Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen;
• Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn;
• Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee;
• Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren;
• Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn;
• Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving;
• Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is;
• Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré.

Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening.

Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is?

We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.


• ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support;
• prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen;
• vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten;
• richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening;
• sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid;
• onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen;
• afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams;
• samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren;
• signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren;
• richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur;
• kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;
• organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.

Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan.

Wat bieden wij

Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie.

Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf.

De functie is ingeschaald in schaal 10. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring ligt de salarisrange (schaal 10) tussen € 65.807 en € 94.551 bruto per jaar (op basis van een 38-urige werkweek inclusief vakantiegeld, een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning).


De belangrijkste arbeidsvoorwaarden op een rijtje:
• je krijgt een prima salaris, afhankelijk van je opleiding, ervaring en competenties;
• 13e maand;
• variabele Collectieve Prestatie Beloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris;
• arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd;
• 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek;
• goede studiekostenregeling;
• prima pensioenvoorziening;
• reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en een thuiswerkvergoeding;
• en natuurlijk: korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.


Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie.

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé.


IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.
Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner.
Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken.

Bijzonderheden

title: Professional Services Consultant - AI Security
descriptionHtml:
Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era. 

As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents. 

Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide. 

As a Cato AI Security Professional Services Consultant, you will be a trusted advisor to our customers to help see them through their AI security implementation journey. You will provide technical guidance and direction to ensure the Cato AI security solution's smooth and successful implementation.

Curiosity – You have a desire to truly understand our customers' business needs.

Creativity – You can find a sustainable path to yes.

Empathy – You connect at a human level with our customers, and you genuinely care

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain expert-level implementation proficiency of the Cato Networks AI Security solution while keeping abreast of the dynamic AI security and enterprise IT infrastructure landscape
  • Develop meaningful relationships with key customer stakeholders and their partners, adopting a consultative and prescriptive approach that inspires trust and confidence
  • Lead end-to-end customer engagements implementing Cato AI security solution for AI risk management, model security, and data protection so that our customers can realize the total value of their investment in our technology
  • Work with customer teams to design secure AI architectures and establish governance frameworks aligned to standards such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and EU AI Act guidance
  • Translate technical findings into actionable recommendations for both executive and technical audiences
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on AI and LLM security across the Cato Networks customer base
  • Contribute to development of internal knowledge sharing, solution playbooks, and enablement materials for partners and customers
  • Foster collaboration with our product management, support and engineering teams by providing feedback from the field on features and functionality, influencing roadmap priorities based on customer needs and emerging threats
  • Support pre-sales scoping of professional services for new customer engagements
  • Identify opportunities to expand customer value through additional AI security services and capabilities
  • Collaboration with greater professional services team to help synthesize experiences and trends observed in the field into repeatable technical best practices in collaboration with other Cato functions
  • Operate day-to-day with minimal oversite as a point of technical escalation to provide guidance on and ensure timely resolution of any issues

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in cloud architecture with a primary focus on AWS or Azure, including hands-on deployment and management of Amazon EKS or ECS, or Azure Kubernetes Service and hybrid connectivity services
  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing role (e.g., consulting, professional services, pre-sales, managed services) for a high-tech software or technology vendor with a proven track record leading enterprise consulting or professional services engagements
  • Exposure to implementation of API gateways (e.g., Zuul, Apigee, Kong, Amazon API Gateway, Azure API Management) and AI application specific gateways (e.g., LiteLLM, Portkey, Helicone, TrueFoundry)
  • Solid understanding of public cloud networking constructs (e.g., AWS VPCs, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, and Gateway Load Balancer – Azure VNets, VNGs, ExpressRoute, vWAN, Load Balancer, and DNS)
  • Experience designing and securing AI/ML infrastructure including AWS SageMaker, AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, Google Vertex AI, Databricks, GPU-accelerated compute, and model inference pipelines
  • Exposure to unique threat landscape for AI and LLMs including AI specific threat models and risks (e.g., prompt injection, data poisoning/leakage/exfiltration, model inversion/manipulations/poisoning, and other adversarial attacks)
  • Proficient with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK with version-controlled deployment pipelines and automation scripting skills in Python, Bash, or Go is a plus
  • Familiarity with container security, runtime protection, and service mesh architectures (Istio, App Mesh)
  • Practical experience with observability and monitoring stacks (e.g., CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)
  • Knowledge of data sovereignty, residency requirements and compliance frameworks relevant to AI workloads (e.g., FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, HIPPA, PCI, HITRUST, GDPR)
  • Familiarity with data protection regulations and AI Security frameworks (e.g., GDPR, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, MITRE ATLAS) is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of influencing at all levels and gaining a ‘Trusted Advisor’ status with key stakeholders
  • Industry accredited security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CCSK, CISM) and AI security–specific credentials
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with an innate ability to methodically get to the root of issues
  • Very well organized and work effectively in an agile and fast-paced environment
  • Solid command of the English language (written and spoken) with additional language skills is a plus.
  • Comfortable working within a geographically distributed and diverse team for a hypergrowth global organization.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time for customer on-site meetings and various company meetings

title: Proposition Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
THE CARWOW GROUP

Carwow Group is driven by a passion for getting people into cars. But not just any car, the right car. That’s why we are building the go-to destination for car-changing. Designed to reach drivers everywhere with our trail-blazing portfolio of personality rich automotive brands; Carwow, Auto Express, evo, Driving Electric and Car Buyer.

What started as a simple reviews site, is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe - over 10m customers have used Carwow to help them buy and sell cars since its inception. Last year we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with over 1.1 billion annual views, sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

 

WHY JOIN US?

We are winners of the prestigious Culture 100 award that recognises the most loved and happiest tech companies to work for! We recently raised $52m in funding led by global venture capital firm Bessemer Venture Partners (an early backer of LinkedIn and Shopify) to accelerate our growth plans!

As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility – building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers.

Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!).

Our team of 500 employees across the UK, Spain and Portugal are revolutionising car-changing and we are fast expanding our mission across every single brand and country we operate in, so jump in!

OEM & MEDIA TEAM @ CARWOW

Our OEM & Media team works with 40+ car manufacturers, helping them reach millions of in-market car buyers across Carwow, Auto Express and evo. Our Brand Partnerships Managers own those relationships. This role owns what they take to market: the products, data and tools that make our partnerships work harder for every brand.

YOUR MISSION

You'll own the day-to-day development of our OEM & Media proposition, running the commercial projects that keep Carwow ahead of the industry, from data and reporting to marketplace integrations. Your job is to make sure our Brand Partnerships team have everything they need to grow their relationships with manufacturers.

This is a role for a generalist project manager who loves getting stuck into intricate, cross-functional work and is interested in the commercial side of the automotive industry. No two weeks look the same. One day you'll be scoping a finance calculator integration with Product and Legal, and the next you'll be building the data story for a major manufacturer pitch.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own a portfolio of projects from first idea to final delivery, using Carwow's OKR process to prioritise what will make the biggest commercial difference.

  • Be the go-to person for everything happening across the OEM proposition, keeping Product, Data & Analytics, Legal and Commercial pulling in the same direction.

  • Deliver the integrations that connect manufacturers to our marketplace, from OEM stock feeds and lead integrations to finance calculators.

  • Own our OEM & Media data suite (dashboards, Google Sheets, automated decks and AI integrations) and keep making it better.

  • Equip our Brand Partnerships Managers with the tools, collateral and best practice they need, and help bring our biggest pitches to life with data.

  • Be the voice of OEM & Media on cross-functional Carwow Group projects, and help raise the team's profile across the automotive industry.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Experience in project management, proposition development or commercial operations, taking projects from a blank page to delivery.

  • A track record of delivering intricate projects with lots of moving parts and lots of stakeholders.

  • Seriously good organisation skills: you'll be juggling several projects at once, each at a different stage and with different people involved.

  • The ability to bring people with you, influencing stakeholders at every level and keeping their priorities aligned with project timelines.

  • Confidence with data and the ability to turn the numbers into a clear story.

  • Clear, engaging written and visual communication, whether that's client collateral or an internal deck.

BONUS POINTS

  • Commercial experience in the automotive industry, whether OEM-side, at an agency, or at a marketplace or publisher working with manufacturers.

  • Experience delivering technical or integration projects with Product and Engineering teams.

  • An understanding of media and advertising, such as campaign reporting, attribution or measurement.

  • Curiosity about AI tools and finding new ways to automate reporting and workflows.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private medical and dental insurance, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

title: QA Engineer - Payments
descriptionHtml:
SumUp is already live in 38 markets and still growing. Our Global Expansion Team takes SumUp's payment products into new countries, with Mexico and Canada among our most recent launches and more markets like New Zealand and Argentina on the way. As a QA Engineer in our Berlin payments team, you'll build the automated and manual tests that decide when a new card reader can go live in a market, across frontend, backend and mobile flows, and you'll also help complete L3 certification (the final round of testing that acquiring banks and card networks require). It's hands-on engineering work with real launch impact, because your tests help new markets go live and recently launched ones stay stable, so small businesses there can take card payments with confidence.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain frontend and backend test automation, with mobile where relevant, and add targeted regression tests to continuous integration (CI) workflows so market specific checks run consistently after code changes
  • Test SumUp products across markets, with a mix of automated and manual testing, functional, integration and regression checks, plus edge cases and recovery scenarios.
  • Spot ways to improve how we test, explain why they matter and make a convincing case for the changes with the biggest payoff
  • Trace failures through complex payment flows using logs and transaction traces, then raise clear, prioritised defects and work with engineers and external partners until they're fixed
  • Own the testing of end-to-end communication between a payment terminal, software applications, and an acquiring network. with acquiring banks and card networks, and keep the team informed on certification status, quality risks and release readiness so launch decisions rest on evidence
  • Work closely in collaboration with engineers, product and market-launch teams, as well as acquirers, card schemes and certification labs.

What you'll bring

  • Programming or scripting skill to build and maintain automated tests for frontend web and backend APIs, and comfort reading code in languages such as Golang, Kotlin, Java or others on our Tech Radar.
  • Experience testing software both manually and with automation, including turning requirements into test scenarios and deciding what to automate first based on customer, launch and technical risk.
  • Ability to analyse logs, transaction traces and test results, and to write defect reports that include reproduction steps, expected versus actual behaviour, impact and evidence.
  • Comfort working with Git and Jira (or similar tools)
  • Experience with SQL and test-data setup, contract testing, mocking or service virtualisation.
  • An engineering mindset: the ability to spot what can be improved, explain the reasoning and persuade others with clear evidence
  • A curious, ownership minded approach: seeking out context when things are unclear and using AI tools where they help.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Card payments, payment terminals, acquirers, card schemes or certification labs.
  • Market launches, device integrations, external technical partners or business-to-business communication.

Payments experience is helpful but not required. We'll support you in learning card payments, devices and the certification process.

Why you should join SumUp

  • 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first set up
  • 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
  • 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success
  • 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education
  • 💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions
  • 🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days
  • 🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches
  • 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service
  • 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.
