title: Relationship Manager - Thames Valley
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. We don’t pretend to have all the answers yet, and you will play a role in continuing to shape our offering.

Our Relationship Manager team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow with the Bank at pace. Providing every customer who opens an account with us with a Relationship Manager, to work alongside them and provide outstanding service, is core to our strategy.

In addition to providing outstanding service, our Relationship Managers build deep levels of understanding and trust with their customers, and get to understand their ambitions, goals and motivations. Allica Relationship Managers support their customers through the provision of appropriate Allica Bank products including Business Current Accounts, Savings Accounts, Commercial Loans, Asset Finance and Working Capital Facilities.

All Relationship Manager roles at Allica Bank carry a requirement for new business acquisition as we continue to build the bank. Where portfolios are held, they are built to allow capacity to do this. Relationship Managers will bring, and continue to build, a strong network of trusted SME advisors such as accountants, solicitors, business organisations and others (but not commercial finance brokers – these are looked after by our dedicated broker team).

Principal Accountabilities

  • Relationship Manage a portfolio of SME customers, understanding customer’s needs and business aspirations, and looking for opportunities to support them via Allica Bank services and through their own external networks

  • Originating SME lending opportunities for both existing and new customers from initial enquiry through to completion, including writing credit papers in line with Allica’s credit policy and appetite.

  • Delivering the business plan for your local area, and actively managing your objectives and personal development plan.

  • Making your colleagues proud that you represent Allica in your local area, by ensuring excellent service for local SME customers, prospects and advisors.

  • Working closely and collaboratively with all areas of Allica to ensure a seamless and professional service is always provided.

  • Being a positive contributor to Allica’s culture, and always demonstrating the bank’s values

  • Complying with all mandatory policies, and adherence to operational procedures to maintain internal controls.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Highly capable Relationship Manager and Business Developer with a long-term track record of building high-value, trust based and long-lasting referral relationships.

  • A strong understanding of SME banking, which must include a background in commercial lending.

  • Able to demonstrate a history of exemplary level of service, and of maximising the value with prospects and customers.

  • Be able to demonstrate a passion for SMEs, be a self-starter and bring an entrepreneurial mindset to your work.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills together with evidence of strong career progression and/or outperformance.

  • Be able to evidence an ability to work expertly with customers, colleagues and advisors to structure new lending proposals and write credit applications.

  • A proven track record in providing excellent customer service, and in generating new income opportunities whilst effectively managing credit risk.

  • An ability to analyse and review financial accounts and associated information.

#LI-Remote #LI-AD1

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

descriptionHtml:

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintech-Unternehmen in Frankreich, und wir beschleunigen derzeit unser Wachstum in Deutschland 🇩🇪

🤝 Das Vertrauen von Tausenden Kund:innen und Steuerkanzleien zu gewinnen und hervorragende Bewertungen zu erhalten

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1,3 Millionen kleine und mittlere Unternehmen sowie über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien in Frankreich dabei zu unterstützen, Pennylane zu nutzen

Über die Position als Accounting Product Specialist

Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Buchhaltungsexpertise und Produktentwicklung. Dabei stellst du die technische Qualität und die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben unserer Software für die Buchhaltung sicher.

Was bedeutet Erfolg in dieser Rolle?

Die drei wichtigsten Verantwortungsbereiche

  1. Du berätst das Product-Team, beantwortest Fragen und teilst dein Fachwissen, damit buchhalterische Funktionen korrekt entwickelt werden.

  2. Du testest das Produkt und meldest Fehler sowie Feedback an das Product-Team.

  3. Du schulst andere Personen im Umgang mit dem Produkt, insbesondere zu buchhalterischen Themen. Dazu gehören externe Zielgruppen, wie die Steuerkanzleien, mit denen wir zusammenarbeiten werden, sowie interne Zielgruppen, zum Beispiel neue Mitarbeitende in den Bereichen Product, Sales und Support. Du erstellst dafür geeignete Schulungsunterlagen und organisierst entsprechende Sessions.

Dein erwarteter Beitrag in den ersten sechs Monaten

  • Du trägst aktiv zum Produktlaunch bei und stellst sicher, dass die wichtigsten buchhalterischen Funktionen korrekt, gesetzeskonform und effizient umgesetzt sind.

  • Du dokumentierst zentrales Wissen zur französischen und deutschen Buchhaltung sowie zur Funktionsweise des deutschen Produkts.

  • Du schulst die ersten Steuerkanzleien, die Pennylane Deutschland nutzen.

  • Du unterstützt bei der Einstellung und Schulung wichtiger Teammitglieder, insbesondere in den Bereichen Partner Success und Customer Success.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

Fachliche Expertise

  • Du unterstützt die Product-Teams bei der Entwicklung und Validierung buchhalterischer und steuerlicher Funktionen, zum Beispiel durch Workshops und die Prüfung von Prototypen.

Qualitätssicherung

  • Du wirkst bei der Definition buchhaltungsbezogener Testszenarien mit.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass das erwartete buchhalterische Ergebnis einer Funktion erreicht wird.

Wissensmanagement und Schulungen

  • Du erstellst und pflegst technische Dokumentationen zu buchhalterischen und steuerlichen Themen.

  • Du schulst interne Teams zu wichtigen Buchhaltungskonzepten.

Dein Profil

  • Sprachen: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Du bist neugierig und verfügst über die Fähigkeit, komplexe buchhalterische Themen für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen klar, verständlich und praxisnah zu erklären.

Was wir tun, um deinen Arbeitsalltag zu erleichtern

🏢 Diese Position kann vollständig remote von jedem Ort in Deutschland ausgeübt werden. Wenn du in Berlin ansässig bist, kannst du auch unsere Büros in der Rosenthaler Straße 43–45 nutzen.

🤝 Unser Bewerbungsprozess

title: AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Founded in 2010 in the Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued.

Today, our team of approximately 240 employees spans 22 countries, supporting more than 2,000 organisations worldwide. We partner with leading enterprises including Mazda, the UN International Organization for Migration, The Adecco Group, and the University of Cape Town to deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences through the power of Microsoft Teams and AI-driven innovation.

Driven by our commitment to innovation, customer focus, accountability, and continuous improvement, we help organisations modernise communication and customer engagement across complex enterprise environments.

Our portfolio includes:

  • Dialogue Cloud – our enterprise dialogue management platform built for Microsoft Teams.

  • Deepdesk – AI-powered Agent Assist technology that helps service teams work faster and smarter.

  • Tendfor – a customer engagement and contact centre solution designed for Microsoft Teams environments.

Together, these solutions enable organisations to create more intelligent, efficient, and personalised experiences for both customers and employees.

As we continue to accelerate our AI-first strategy, we're investing heavily in the next generation of agentic solutions, creating exciting opportunities for engineers who want to help shape the future of enterprise AI.


About the Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise solutions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, building, and scaling intelligent agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. You'll transform defined business use cases into production-ready agentic solutions, leveraging modern AI technologies, Azure services, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture.

As part of the Agent Factory team, you'll develop agents that can securely access enterprise systems, interact with business tools, manage context and memory effectively, and operate reliably at scale. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and AI leadership to ensure every solution delivers real business value while meeting enterprise standards for security, performance, and governance.

Beyond technical delivery, you'll bring product thinking and commercial awareness, helping to identify meaningful customer challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and relevant market trends. Your insights will contribute to shaping and refining the Agent Factory roadmap and backlog.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building practical AI applications and can take solutions from concept through to production deployment.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and Deliver Intelligent Agents

  • Design, build and deploy AI agents that solve real customer and business problems.

  • Create agents that deliver value independently while contributing insights to a broader intelligence ecosystem.

  • Translate product requirements and use cases into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Develop MCP-Based Integrations

  • Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide agents with secure access to tools, systems and enterprise data.

  • Define and implement tool interfaces, authentication mechanisms and resource access patterns.

  • Ensure agents can interact with enterprise services in a structured, secure and reliable way.

Integrate Enterprise Systems

  • Connect agents with business-critical platforms including:

    • Microsoft Dynamics 365

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Dataverse

    • ServiceNow

    • Contact Centre and Customer Experience platforms

    • Internal and third-party APIs

Design Context, Memory & Intelligence

  • Define how agents manage memory, context and decision-making patterns.

  • Implement retrieval, reasoning and tool-use strategies that promote consistent and predictable behaviour.

  • Design guardrails that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within enterprise environments.

Contribute to the Agent Ecosystem

  • Develop supporting services including adapters, event processing capabilities and integration layers.

  • Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions.

  • Help shape future product direction by contributing technical expertise, customer insights and market observations.

What You'll Bring

  • Microsoft Technology Expertise

  • Strong software engineering experience using C# and .NET.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure services, including:

    • Azure Functions

    • Azure App Service

    • Azure OpenAI Service

    • Azure AI Foundry / AI Studio

  • Experience integrating with Microsoft business platforms such as:

    • Dynamics 365

    • Dataverse

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Power Platform

  • Knowledge of Azure security and identity services, including:

    • Microsoft Entra ID

    • Managed Identities

    • Azure Key Vault

Agentic AI & MCP Experience

  • Practical experience building or consuming MCP servers.

  • Knowledge of agent frameworks and orchestration technologies such as:

    • Semantic Kernel

    • AutoGen

    • Microsoft AI SDKs

  • Experience with:

    • Function and tool calling

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    • Vector databases

    • Context and memory management

  • Ability to design clear, reliable and secure agent interactions.#

Broader Engineering Skills

  • Strong API integration experience, including REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven architectures.

  • Experience with cloud-native deployment, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code approaches.

  • Understanding of performance, latency, reliability and cost considerations when working with Large Language Models in production.

  • Commitment to software quality, testing and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to work closely with QA teams on agent evaluation, testing and quality assurance.

Who You Are

You'll be successful in this role if you are:

  • A pragmatic builder who can take ideas from concept to production.

  • Passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

  • A systems thinker who understands how individual components contribute to larger platforms and architectures.

  • Security-conscious and focused on building reliable enterprise-grade solutions.

  • Excited by emerging AI technologies and eager to learn as the landscape evolves.

Nice to Have

title: Compliance & Security Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Trigger.dev

Trigger.dev is an open source platform used by developers to build production-grade AI agents. It's an SDK and the infrastructure to run agents reliably at scale, so teams can focus on the product instead of the plumbing.

Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users' code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. With the rise of AI, being able to offload async tasks reliably is a key part of any developer's toolkit: We're building the infrastructure to make that a reality.

About the position

We're looking for our first Compliance & Security Lead to own security compliance and data protection at Trigger.dev. You'll report to the founders, and work closely with engineering.

We already hold SOC 2 Type II, run our program through Oneleet, and publish a trust portal covering SOC 2, GDPR and HIPAA. Until now the founders and engineers have handled compliance alongside their day jobs. As we grow, customers send more security questionnaires, ask for more reports and negotiate more DPAs. Now we need somebody to own this, keep it running all year, and free our engineers to build.

You don’t need to be an engineer, but technical experience is a bonus. This role suits someone process-minded who likes making compliance practical, rather than just ticking boxes.

What you'll be doing

You'll do a variety of things including:

  • Running our SOC 2 and HIPAA programs: owning our SOC 2 audit, managing evidence collection in Oneleet and keeping us audit-ready all year

  • Using AI and automation to speed up compliance work, from drafting questionnaire answers to collecting evidence and reviewing policies

  • Completing security questionnaires and vendor assessments, sharing our reports and bridge letters, and keeping our trust portal current

  • Reviewing and negotiating DPAs with customers and suppliers, working with our lawyers, keeping our records of processing up to date and handling data subject requests under UK and EU GDPR

  • Writing and maintaining our security, privacy and data retention policies, and making sure retention periods are enforced

  • Reviewing new tools and sub-processors before we adopt them, and keeping our sub-processor list current

  • Deciding when we need new frameworks, such as ISO 27001 or ISO 42001 (the AI management standard), and leading the work to get there

  • Making compliance seamless for the team: onboarding training, simple processes and automated evidence collection wherever possible

  • Keeping our incident response and breach notification process ready, and testing it each year

Requirements

You really need to have:

  • 5+ years in security compliance, GRC or data protection, ideally at a SaaS or developer tools company

  • Experience at an early-stage startup as the first or only compliance hire, with full ownership

  • Hands-on experience running a SOC 2 audit, from evidence collection through to the final report

  • An up to date working knowledge of UK and EU GDPR, and experience reviewing or negotiating DPAs

  • Experience completing security questionnaires accurately and quickly

  • Clear, plain writing - you can turn a policy into something engineers will read

  • Enough technical understanding to talk to engineers about cloud infrastructure, access control and logging (you don't need to write code)

  • If you are remote you must be within CET to ET timezones (GMT+1:00 to GMT-5:00). We will arrange 3 in-person events throughout the year

You'll be an amazing fit if you:

  • Have experience with ISO 27001 or HIPAA

  • Have used a compliance automation platform such as Oneleet, Vanta or Drata

  • Hold a privacy or security certification, such as CIPP/E, CISA or CISSP

  • Use AI tools to speed up questionnaires, evidence review and policy work

  • Are based in the UK and able to join the team in London

About the team

  • We are a small team with a flat hierarchy

  • We encourage continuous learning and personal development

  • Everyone operates autonomously; we trust you to get the job done, but to also quickly raise your hand if you need help

  • We care about our customers and the open-source community

  • Being a start-up, the work is challenging and fast-paced, but we also understand the importance of taking time off to recharge

Working at a Commercial Open Source Software company is more than just your day job

  • Our code is public, so anyone can see how we build and run our platform. We want our security and compliance to be just as open.

  • We publish our security reports and trust portal, so customers can check our work instead of taking our word for it.

  • Customers trust us with their code and data. We’re open about how we protect it.

Benefits

  • Generous compensation and equity - We hire the best talent and pay to reflect that. We also offer equity as a way to ensure everyone is invested in the success of the company.

  • Async working - Need a heads-down day or meeting-free days to stay productive? No problem!

  • Home office - We will help provide equipment for a comfortable setup so you're as productive at home as you are in the office.

  • Health insurance - Private health insurance, with Vitality for our UK team.

  • Dog and cat friendly office - Our London office welcomes four-legged colleagues.

  • Generous vacation - We believe it's important to take time off. We encourage you to take your 25 days vacation excluding national holidays, plus sick leave and generous parental leave.

  • Training budget - An annual budget to contribute towards learning such as purchasing books, an Audible subscription or online courses.

  • Pension contributions - Enroll in our company pension scheme or we'll contribute directly to your private pension.

title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenMusic
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and stream. The team works in its own environment, separate from the main org, and is agent-first with fast CI, so ideas reach users within a day or two.

You’ll own features end to end, from spotting the problem to shipping the product and the backend behind it. Most of what you build is new, in a space where few companies are working with AI and music, so there’s no playbook. You’ll define the problem yourself, test ideas with real users, and work alongside research engineering to turn model capabilities into things people love using. What you ship goes live to a large audience within days.

You’re a builder with strong product taste who understands every layer of the system. You use AI to move fast, but you own and understand everything you ship. You care about music and the people who make it.

Requirements

  • Have shipped and owned a well-designed consumer product from zero to real users, across frontend and backend

  • Understand your systems deeply enough to spot immediately when a PR is wrong, insecure or needlessly complex

  • Show excellent product judgement: you know the most valuable thing to build, and what not to build

  • Work autonomously with minimal direction, and take responsibility for fixing problems as you find them

  • Have a real interest in music, or in the people who make it

Bonus: Open-source or GitHub track record, experience building music or audio products, or experience with recommendation systems or embeddings.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

title: Partner Manager - Public Sector Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for an experienced partnerships leader to build and scale ElevenLabs' Public Sector Partner Programme in North America — bringing together resellers, VARs, and systems integrators who help deploy our technology across federal agencies, state and local governments, and education institutions.

You'll own the public sector partner strategy end-to-end — from building relationships with leading SIs and VARs with established public sector practices, to onboarding, enabling, and activating them to sell and deliver ElevenLabs products into government and education accounts.

This is a 0→1 build: you'll design partner incentive and enablement models tailored to the procurement and compliance realities of the public sector, generate qualified pipeline through partner-led opportunities, and scale the programme against North America growth targets — while owning day-to-day execution and partner performance.

 

What success looks like (first 6–9 months)

  • Partner-Sourced & Influenced Revenue: closed-won ARR through VARs, SIs, and channel partners reaching at least 20% of North America public sector revenue

  • Partner-Sourced Pipeline: qualified pipeline created through partners, with a focus on enterprise and agency-level opportunities in federal, SLED, and education

  • Revenue-Producing Partners: number of partners actively generating pipeline, opportunities, or revenue each quarter

  • Time-to-First Revenue: speed from partner onboarding to first sourced opportunity and first closed-won deal

  • Strategic Account Penetration: new agency and institution relationships unlocked through partners that ElevenLabs would've struggled to access directly

Requirements

  • 10+ years building and scaling SaaS or Cloud solutions into public sector markets, with a deep network across federal, SLED, and education that you can leverage from day one

  • 4+ years owning VAR and SI partnerships in the public sector, with proven experience driving joint account planning, co-sell motions, and revenue — not just relationship management

  • Deep familiarity with government procurement cycles, contract vehicles (e.g. GSA schedules, BPAs), and compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, FISMA, StateRAMP)

  • A builder mindset — experience creating partner motions from 0→1, rather than inheriting a mature programme

  • Comfortable working with technical, API-driven products, and able to explain complex concepts to partners and agency stakeholders

Bonus: Mix of 3–4 years in direct public sector sales + 3–4 years in partnerships or channel; prior experience at a company scaling into gov-tech from a commercial base

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is  $12,500 - $20,800 USD based on location and experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role: 

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, operate, and scale the platform that powers Sezzle. Your focus will be the hardest infrastructure problems: increasing throughput, reducing latency, removing capacity bottlenecks, strengthening resilience, and making production operations more automated and predictable as the business grows.

You will own complex technical initiatives from architecture and prototyping through implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operation. Your impact will come from the systems you build, the problems you solve, and measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

Our stack runs on AWS, with workloads orchestrated on Kubernetes and data anchored in Aurora RDS (MySQL and Postgres). You should know these technologies deeply and be comfortable moving between cloud architecture, networking, cluster internals, database performance, and application behavior to understand how the entire system scales. You will write code and infrastructure-as-code, debug production systems, and deliver changes that hold up under real traffic and failure conditions.

Operational ownership is part of the job. You will participate in the on-call rotation and take a hands-on role in recovering from major incidents, including full outages. We need someone who can form and test hypotheses using logs, metrics, and traces, make sound mitigation decisions with incomplete information, and turn incident findings into lasting engineering fixes.

You will also build and apply AI-assisted infrastructure and SRE tooling for incident investigation, capacity analysis, runbook automation, and toil reduction. You will evaluate these tools through practical results and apply appropriate access controls, validation, and auditability to their use in production.

This role reports to engineering leadership and works closely with application engineers, Security, and Compliance. You will develop a deep understanding of how Sezzle's business operates and how customer journeys, transaction patterns, and product decisions shape infrastructure demand and behavior. You will use that understanding to identify and deliver improvements across teams and technical domains, connecting infrastructure decisions to better customer outcomes and business performance.

What you’ll do: 

  • Own the technical architecture and evolution of core infrastructure: identify system limits, prioritize technical improvements, and implement changes that support increasing traffic, data volume, and workload complexity.
  • Connect business understanding to improvements across the system: learn how key business workflows behave in production, trace their impact across applications, data, and infrastructure, and partner across teams to improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency beyond any single service or team's scope.
  • Engineer for scale and performance: build capacity models, run load and stress tests, diagnose bottlenecks across compute, networking, Kubernetes, and databases, and validate improvements against throughput, latency, saturation, and cost per workload.
  • Design and build AWS infrastructure: implement resilient account, IAM, network, and service architectures; address service quotas, fault isolation, and multi-AZ or multi-region requirements as workloads grow.
  • Build and operate the Kubernetes platform: improve cluster architecture, lifecycle automation, workload isolation, resource allocation, autoscaling, safe upgrades, and deployment reliability.
  • Scale and optimize Aurora RDS for MySQL and Postgres: tune queries and indexes, address connection and replication bottlenecks, plan capacity, improve failover behavior, and implement safe schema changes and database migrations with application engineers.
  • Improve reliability through engineering: define and instrument service-level objectives and error budgets with service owners; implement failure isolation, backpressure, load shedding, and safe retry behavior where needed to prevent cascading failures.
  • Participate in on-call and drive technical recovery during serious incidents: use evidence-based triage, execute mitigations, communicate findings, and implement corrective actions from postmortems.
  • Implement and test disaster recovery: design backup, restore, and failover mechanisms against agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives; run recovery exercises and document measured results.
  • Build infrastructure-as-code and operational automation: make provisioning, configuration, deployments, upgrades, and recovery reproducible, reviewed, testable, and recoverable. Eliminate recurring manual work through code.
  • Build observability that makes production diagnosable: improve metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with visibility into service health, scaling limits, and customer impact.
  • Deliver safe infrastructure migrations: design phased rollouts, compatibility checks, validation, and rollback paths for changes to shared production systems.
  • Improve cloud cost efficiency through technical changes: right-size resources, improve utilization, tune autoscaling and storage, and quantify savings while maintaining reliability and performance targets.
  • Build and evaluate AI-assisted operational tooling: apply AI to investigation, runbooks, anomaly analysis, and repetitive operations, with bounded permissions, reviewable actions, and measurable improvements in accuracy or toil.
  • Make technical decisions clear and executable: write architecture proposals, evaluate technology tradeoffs through prototypes and benchmarks, review changes affecting shared infrastructure, and document how systems operate and fail.

What We look for: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field (required)
  • 12+ years of experience across infrastructure, platform, site reliability, software development, or related engineering disciplines, with substantial hands-on depth designing and operating production infrastructure at scale.
  • Deep expertise with AWS: production experience across compute, IAM, multi-account architectures, and networking, including VPC design and private connectivity.
  • Deep expertise with Kubernetes in production: cluster lifecycle, scheduling, resource management, autoscaling, networking, and troubleshooting business-critical workloads. EKS experience is strongly preferred.
  • Deep expertise with relational databases at scale, specifically RDS/Aurora (MySQL and/or Postgres): query performance, indexing, connection management, replication, high availability, failover, and verified backup and recovery.
  • A track record of personally delivering infrastructure scaling improvements: identifying constraints, measuring baseline behavior, implementing changes, and demonstrating gains in capacity, latency, reliability, or cost efficiency.
  • Strong coding and automation skills, using Golang, Python, or similar languages to build production tooling and eliminate operational toil, alongside infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or equivalent.
  • Strong systems fundamentals: Linux, networking, DNS, TLS, storage, concurrency, and distributed system failure modes, with the ability to debug problems across infrastructure and application boundaries.
  • Experience operating a 24/7, high-availability platform where downtime has direct customer or revenue impact, including hands-on incident response and postmortem remediation.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and demonstrated ability to recover production systems under pressure using evidence-based triage, safe mitigation, and clear technical communication.
  • Experience implementing and testing disaster recovery against defined recovery objectives, including restoring data and validating service recovery.
  • Practical experience with observability, load testing, capacity planning, and safe CI/CD practices for shared production infrastructure.
  • Active use of AI tooling in engineering or operations, with practical judgment about its limitations and how to verify generated code, recommendations, and operational actions.
  • Ability to carry ambiguous technical problems from investigation through production delivery and collaborate across engineering disciplines to resolve system-wide constraints.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or banking, operating infrastructure with demanding reliability, security, and audit requirements.
  • Experience with multi-region architectures, chaos engineering, and failure testing, including the consistency and recovery tradeoffs of distributed data systems.
  • Proficiency with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, or comparable observability systems.
  • Experience building internal platform capabilities and self-service tooling, including deployment automation, progressive delivery, and reusable infrastructure components.
  • Experience building AI-assisted incident investigation or operational automation with restricted access, auditable execution, and clear human review points

About You: 

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.
  • You go deep: you investigate how systems behave under load and failure, follow the evidence, and fix underlying causes.
  • You build and ship: you turn architecture into working code, tested infrastructure, and safe production changes.
  • You measure results: you can explain the impact of your work in availability, latency, capacity, recovery time, cost, or hours of toil removed.
  • You value simplicity: you choose systems that are understandable, operable, and appropriate to the problem, and reduce unnecessary complexity.
  • You earn trust: you listen carefully, communicate clearly, challenge technical decisions respectfully, and follow through on commitments.
  • You stay accountable for the outcome: you verify that changes work in production and that fixes remain effective as the platform scales.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Python
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres
  • DevOps and Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

title: QA & Authorisation Handler
descriptionHtml:
Turning risk into opportunity

Human progress runs on a single trade: risk for opportunity. Every venture worth doing - a new business, a new home, an exciting trip - means accepting the chance it goes wrong. Insurance is what lets us take those chances anyway, and the claim is the moment it either delivers on that promise or fails to.

We're rebuilding that moment. ClaimSorted is an AI-native claims solution for insurers and large corporates that resolves claims faster, fairer, and more reliably than the industry ever has. Handle risk that well, and people are free to take on more of it - that's how you push society toward opportunity: not by eliminating risk, but by making recovery so fast and certain it stops being a reason to hold back.

We're one of the fastest-growing InsurTechs - scaling 10x YoY, processing hundreds of millions in claims payouts, and backed by the world's leading investors: Y Combinator, Atomico, and Eurazeo.


What we are looking for

We are looking for a confident, analytical and detail-focused QA & Authorisation Handler to join our Technical Claims Support Team.

You will provide a key technical control across our claims operation, completing Quality Assurance reviews and reviewing claim settlements at the authorisation stage.

As the final line of defence before a claim settlement is approved, you will be responsible for independently reviewing the claim, evidence, policy coverage and settlement calculation before making the decision to authorise, pass back or escalate.

This requires confidence and strong technical judgement. You must be comfortable making decisions, challenging claim assessments where something does not look right and clearly explaining the reasoning behind your decision.

The role goes beyond identifying individual errors. You will use findings from QA and authorisations to identify potential financial leakage, recurring handling issues, process and control gaps and emerging trends across the claims operation.

You will be comfortable using data to understand where issues are occurring, identify root causes and turn findings into practical improvements to processes, controls, guidance and training.

As ClaimSorted works across a range of insurance products and partners, you will need to be adaptable and confident moving between different products, policy wordings, processes and priorities while maintaining consistently high standards.

As part of the wider Technical Claims Support Team, you will also support other technical claims activities where required.

Responsibilities

  • Review claim settlements at authorisation stage across all ClaimSorted products, acting as the final line of defence before payment is approved.

  • Independently review policy coverage, supporting evidence and settlement calculations, making confident decisions to authorise, pass back or escalate.

  • Complete Quality Assurance reviews across all products, ensuring claims are handled accurately, fairly and in line with policy, partner and internal requirements.

  • Identify and prevent financial leakage, incorrect settlements and other customer or financial risks.

  • Provide clear, constructive and evidence-based feedback to Claims Handlers, confidently challenging decisions where required.

  • Use QA, authorisation and leakage data across products to identify trends, recurring errors, training needs and process or control gaps.

  • Support improvements to claims processes, guidance and controls based on findings and root-cause analysis.

  • Maintain accurate records of decisions and findings while effectively managing and prioritising QA and authorisation workloads.

  • Build and maintain the technical knowledge required to work confidently across all ClaimSorted product lines, partners and processes.

  • Work collaboratively across Claims Operations and the wider Technical Claims Support Team.

Skills and Experience Required

  • +2 years experience completing claim authorisations within an insurance claims team is essential, with responsibility for reviewing and making decisions on claim settlements.

  • +3 years experience working across two or more of the following product lines within a claims role: Pet, Travel, Property, Auto, Gadget or similar insurance products.

  • Strong technical claims knowledge, with the confidence to independently review, challenge and make evidence-based decisions.

  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when reviewing policy coverage, supporting evidence and settlement calculations.

  • Strong analytical skills, with experience identifying financial leakage, trends, recurring errors and process or control gaps.

  • Able to confidently provide clear, constructive feedback and explain the rationale behind decisions.

  • Highly organised and able to prioritise a varied workload based on risk, value and urgency.

  • Adaptable and comfortable learning new products, policy wordings and processes in a fast-paced environment.

Mission

To act as a final line of defence within the claims settlement process, ensuring claim outcomes are accurate, fair and supported by policy and evidence before settlement is authorised.

The QA & Authorisation Handler will use strong technical judgement and independent decision-making to protect customer outcomes and financial performance, identifying errors, potential leakage and operational risks before they result in incorrect settlements.

Through Quality Assurance, data analysis and trend identification, the role will also identify wider knowledge, process and control gaps and help turn individual findings into sustainable improvements across Claims Operations

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary beyond the industry standard

  • Quarterly performance bonus: up to 15% of quarterly salary

  • Equity participation: stock options as an early-stage team member

  • Health insurance

  • Pension contributions

  • 28 days annual leave

  • Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

descriptionHtml:
Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d)

Remote in Germany, Austria, Spain, Portugal, Italy, the Netherlands or the UK · Full-time · Engineering, Interoperability team

About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

What to expect as our Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):

Hospital staff still spend hours typing the same patient data into different systems. Our in-house RPA tool ends that: it automates hospital information systems (HIS) on Windows desktops so our data lands in patient forms automatically. We don't use UiPath or Blue Prism. We build our own engine in TypeScript, on Electron and Node with native Windows bindings.

You'll join the Interoperability team as a hands-on engineer. Your main focus is the engine itself; everything else builds on it.

  • You build, extend and stabilize the core of our RPA engine.

  • You make automations reliable in hospital environments we don't fully control, with remote updates and failure monitoring.

  • You automate HIS applications on Windows, including the hard legacy cases: UI Automation, Java Access Bridge, SAP GUI Scripting or the browser where the app runs locally.

  • You solve the Citrix problem. Most hospitals serve their HIS through Citrix, where all we see is pixels, so you work with OCR, image anchors, mouse and keyboard input, and the redraw, scrolling and display-scaling issues that come with them.

  • You help extend the engine with new capabilities such as document extraction and voice input.

  • You set up the rollout process with our implementation team: installers, code signing and autostart in locked-down hospital IT, and fixing problems on machines you can't log into.

  • You protect health data by applying security best practices and complying with privacy regulations.


Here's how we picture you as our Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):

  • You have 5+ years of relevant industry experience and have built automation software that runs in production, not only configured bots in an RPA product.

  • You write strong TypeScript or similar

  • You have automated Windows desktop applications with UI Automation, plus at least one of Java Access Bridge, SAP GUI Scripting or browser automation over CDP, and native interop (Node native addons, C# or C++).

  • You have experience with image-based automation over Citrix or RDP (OCR, screen anchors), or a strong wish to learn it. UiPath or Blue Prism developers with Citrix or computer-vision experience who now want to build the engine are very welcome.

  • You know how to keep automations reliable in production: monitoring, failure handling, updates, and testing against apps you can't run in CI.

  • You communicate clearly in English with technical and non-technical people, and you're comfortable working with German-language software.

  • You analyze problems thoroughly and drive them to resolution.

  • Nice to have: experience with OCR, document extraction or speech-to-text; healthcare or HIS integration experience; knowledge of GDPR and sensitive data; spoken German, which helps during rollout with hospital IT.

Not a perfect match on every point? We care more about shared drive and a real sense of mission than about ticking every box.

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Research Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.


Position description

At Sonar, we are seeking an innovative Research Engineer to join our Data & Agentic team and pioneer the next generation of our code analysis and verification engines. You will be at the forefront of applying cutting-edge AI, advanced agentic workflow and static analysis techniques to complex source code. Your work will directly shape our core products—ensuring both AI-generated and developer-written code meets rigorous enterprise quality and security standards. If you are driven to turn state-of-the-art research into practical, high-impact solutions, this is the role for you.


What you will do
  • Create & Innovate: Actively participate in the conceptualization phase. Brainstorm novel ways to improve our products and provide immediate, practical feedback to steer exploratory research toward paths that are both impactful and engineering-feasible.
  • Develop Agentic Workflows: Design, prototype, and validate intelligent agentic systems and automated workflows that facilitate writing clean code, identifying root causes of system issues, and remediating complex bugs and vulnerabilities.
  • Develop Pragmatic Prototypes: Build hands-on prototypes that prove the viability and scalability of research concepts. Proactively identify engineering bottlenecks or scalability limits and propose effective mitigations early in the research phase.
  • Evaluate & Benchmark: Drive the rigorous evaluation of new product features. Construct high-quality datasets, define relevant success metrics, and implement comprehensive benchmarks leveraging Sonar’s existing IP alongside third-party and open-source AI tools.
  • Engineer Data Pipelines: Build and manage robust data pipelines to gather, process, and version massive code-centric datasets required for training and evaluating specialized models at scale.
  • Translate Prototypes to Products: Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to integrate successful prototypes into Sonar's cutting-edge products, ensuring they meet the needs of our global user base.
  • Communicate and Evangelize: Clearly articulate and document complex technical concepts and research findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Advanced academic background in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.

  • Strong software engineering experience (minimum 2+ years in industry) with proficiency in Python and major modern programming languages.

  • Experience of driving research projects from initial ideation to a demonstrable prototype with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party tools, program analysis frameworks, or open-source libraries into functional prototypes.

  • Proven experience in data handling: constructing high-quality datasets, defining objective success metrics, and building robust benchmarks for new solutions.

  • The ability to fast context-switch and maintain momentum across multiple concurrent, fast-moving research topics.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with a talent for translating complex research findings into clear, actionable artifacts for product engineering squads.

    • Plus:

  • Background in static analysis: abstract syntax trees (ASTs), code security, bug detection, etc..

  • Familiarity with LLM techniques such as model fine-tuning, semantic search engines, etc.

  • Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks and cloud infrastructure (e.g. AWS).

title: Research Manager, AI Safety
descriptionHtml:
You support a group of fellows through the AI Safety Fellowship, so that each one does strong work and leaves with a clear next step.

  • Salary: £86,750–£121,500 per year. We may be able to pay more for exceptional candidates.

  • Location: London, at our office at LISA

  • Hours: 0.5 to 1 full-time equivalent

  • Focus: From technical AI safety to AI governance possible

  • Visa: We can sponsor a Skilled Worker visa, but approval isn't guaranteed.

Why work at Pivotal

Pivotal finds people who can work on the biggest risks from advanced AI and gets them working on them. Since 2024, 135 fellows have taken part in our fellowships, and alumni now work at METR, Apollo Research, UK AISI and GovAI. We have grown from 2 staff in 2024 to 10 today, and we plan to reach at least 16 in 2027. Read more about us at pivotal-research.org, and about what it is like to work here.

What you will own

You'll be the Research Manager for about 6 research fellows, supporting each project from scoping through to publication. You'll collaborate closely with our whole research management team.

You'll engage deeply with your fellows' work: reading drafts, questioning experimental designs, suggesting framings, and helping projects stay ambitious but tractable. You’ll also hold the thread that keeps projects moving and fellows well supported.

The research support includes:

  • Run weekly 1:1 check-ins with each fellow; resolve bottlenecks quickly and adjust plans based on results.

  • Give clear, actionable feedback on drafts, figures, methodology, and experimental design.

  • Work with fellows and their mentors to scope projects that are both tractable and high-impact.

  • Coordinate mentors effectively: identify gaps in mentorship coverage and fill them yourself or through targeted introductions.

  • Help fellows with career planning, grant applications, and post-fellowship transitions.

  • Collaborate with the rest of the Pivotal team on infrastructure, and the overall fellowship experience.

Research management at Pivotal

As an individual researcher, you might advance one or two projects. In this role, you'll have a hand in about 6 projects simultaneously (and about 18 projects every year). Your leverage comes from making each fellow meaningfully more effective than they would be on their own.

The AI safety field still has a limited talent pipeline, and many of the people who will shape it over the next few years are early in their careers, still developing their research taste, and often short on high-quality guidance. This role sits at that bottleneck. You’ll help the next generation of researchers produce stronger work, find the right collaborators, and move into positions where they can have outsized impact.

If you get energy from seeing other people's work click into place, this role may let you shape the field more than you could as a single researcher.

Who does well in this role

We don’t expect candidates to arrive as fully formed research managers. We do expect strong potential, good judgment, and real motivation to grow quickly in the role. The traits & backgrounds below are signals we think may matter.

  • Research experience in AI safety, machine learning or AI governance, enough to judge whether a project is on track and to give useful feedback.

  • Good research taste: you can tell which projects matter and which are likely to stall.

  • Strong project management across many projects at once.

  • Ability to keep momentum across multiple projects simultaneously — balancing attention to detail with the ability to context-switch.

  • Care for people: fellows trust you and tell you early when things go wrong.

  • Clear, direct communication, in writing and in person.

  • A network in the AI safety field is a plus, because it helps with mentors and with fellows' careers.

We don’t expect anyone to be strong in all of this. If the role excites you, please apply, even if you match only part of what we describe here.

How we hire

We review applications as they come in, so applying early helps. The process has these stages:

  • Written application. A short form and your CV. It takes about 30 minutes.

  • Automated video interview. About 10 minutes. You record short answers to a few questions, at a time that suits you.

  • Work task. About 2 hours, based on real work in this role. We pay you for this time. You may use AI tools, as you would in the job. Tell us which ones you used and how.

  • Personal interview. About 45 minutes. We discuss your work task and how you would approach the role. With your consent, we record it so that more of the team can review it.

  • Work trial and references. Up to three paid days working with us at our office in London. We also speak to two referees, after asking you.

If you need an adjustment at any stage, such as extra time, tell us and we will arrange it. If you have questions, email ----- £86,750 – £121,500

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
descriptionHtml:
Tracksuit exists to help marketers prove their brand building is working. We give teams the data they need to make smarter decisions, convince stakeholders, defend budgets, and track their progress. The brand tracking industry is dominated by 100-page reports, static data and big price-tags. We're doing things differently by being built for the modern marketer: always-on, accessible, and approachable.

We're now tracking more than 16,000 brands across 25 countries globally. With offices in Auckland, Sydney, London and New York City, we're scaling fast with a brilliant team of collaborative and ambitious humans. Our culture is defined by "high care, high performance". We strive to be the best and look after each other while we do it.

Are you our next Sales Development Representative in London?

Brand matters. Most marketers know that already. As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you'll be the first person at Tracksuit a lot of them hear from. That's a big deal, and we treat it that way.

You'll start the conversations that grow our pipeline. You'll research who matters, reach out in a way that earns a reply, and book meetings for our Account Executives. We use AI tools and signals to work out who to contact and when, so the busywork shrinks and the thinking is yours. You'll start in the new year alongside a bigger London team, just as we reveal the next chapter of brand tracking in January 2027.

We're hiring SDRs at two levels through this ad, so whether you're building your outbound skills or already have a strong track record, we'd like to hear from you.

What you'll do

  • Build and refine lead lists using AI tools and signals

  • Write sequences and messages that people want to reply to

  • Reach out by email, phone and LinkedIn

  • Book qualified meetings and create deals for our Account Executives

  • Work with Account Executives to plan how we approach their key accounts

  • Share what you learn about buyers and the market, and help us get better at outbound

  • Keep our records clean, so everyone can see what's working

At the experienced level, you'll also help shape the sequences and playbooks the team uses, and help newer SDRs get up to speed.

What you'll bring

  • You start conversations with people you don't know. Some experience in sales development, business development or a similar role, ideally in SaaS, marketing technology, advertising or media. That's a guide, not a hard line. We care most about what you've done.

  • Drive that holds up after a "no". Outbound means hearing no a lot. You keep going, and you work out what to try next.

  • You're organised. You can take a long list and know where to start, and you keep your CRM tidy.

  • You want to be coached. You ask for feedback and use it quickly. (Fair warning: you'll get to show us this in the interview.)

  • Clear, kind communication. In writing and out loud.

Bonus points if you love brands, or know marketing or marketing technology.

Why you'll like it here

  • You'll start with a cohort. You'll join alongside other new starters, so you'll learn and ramp up together, not on your own.

  • Time together in the office. With the team in 3 to 4 days a week, you'll pick things up faster: sitting alongside people who've done it before, getting feedback in the moment, and celebrating the wins together.

  • A front-row seat. You'll talk with marketing teams at growing brands who are doing interesting things.

  • A real path to grow. Learn from great salespeople, with room to grow into an Account Executive, or into our agency and customer teams.

  • A team that wins together. High care, high performance. We're competitive, but we're not jerks about it.

Salary

We have two pay bands for this role. The band you're offered depends on the skills and experience you show us through the process, not just your years in the job.

  • Sales Development Representative: £36,000 to £44,000 base salary, with on-target earnings (OTE) of £45,000 to £55,000. For people building their outbound skills who want great coaching and a clear path to grow.

  • Sales Development Representative, experienced level: £41,000 to £50,000 base salary, with OTE of £51,000 to £63,000. For people who already book meetings consistently, write outreach that others learn from, and can help bring newer SDRs along.

The bands overlap on purpose, so we can place you fairly. We'll confirm your band, and where you sit in it, before we make an offer.

OTE is your base salary plus commission when you hit 100% of your target. Commission depends on performance and isn't guaranteed.

The details

  • Location. London, our Clerkenwell office. We're office-first, so you'll be in with the team 3 to 4 days each week.

  • Start date. Offers by the first week of January, with hires starting from mid-January into February.

How our process works

We want to get to know more of the people who apply, not just the ones whose CV tells the whole story. So instead of shortlisting on CVs alone, we'll invite more applicants into the first stage of our process.

That first stage happens in your own time. You'll record a short video interview and complete any other quick online steps, whenever suits you over a few days. It's your chance to show us how you think and what drives you. AI tools help us review these, and a real person makes every decision.

Once we've reviewed the video interviews, shortlisted candidates get a chance to speak with our Talent team about the role and their application in more detail. Then you'll come into our office to interview with the team. We'll let you know exactly what to expect, and anything to prepare, when we invite you.

Key dates

  • From Monday 23 November: invitations to record your video interview, sent as applications come in

  • Sunday 29 November: applications close

  • Once we've reviewed the video interviews: if you're shortlisted, a chance to talk with our Talent team about the role and your application in more detail

  • Monday 14 to Wednesday 16 December: interviews in our office. That's our goal, though some interviews may take place the following week

  • By the first week of January: outcomes and offers, once we're back from the Christmas break

  • From mid-January into February: new hires start

You'll hear from us either way.

Sound like you? Hit apply before Sunday 29 November. We'd love to hear from you.

Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com.

Requirements

Most sales engineers demo what exists. At Prospeum, you'll build what's next.

You won't be showing the same 5 screens to every prospect. If you want to be the technical voice that closes deals — not by talking, but by building — this is it.

Unternehmensprofil

title: SAP S/4HANA Sales & Distribution Consultant Inhouse (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Raum München, Vollzeit · unbefristet

Für unseren Mandanten, eine international tätige, börsennotierte Industriegruppe, suchen wir einen SAP S/4HANA Sales & Distribution Consultant (m/w/d), der die Vertriebsprozesse in der laufenden S/4HANA-Transformation fachlich verantwortet und den Implementierungspartner steuert.

Das Projekt

Die Gruppe führt ihre Gesellschaften in mehreren Ländern schrittweise auf ein gemeinsames SAP-Template. Das Template steht, der erste Rollout wird vorbereitet. Einen großen Teil der technischen Umsetzung übernimmt ein Implementierungspartner, an den Standorten unterstützen lokale Teams. Auf Kundenseite braucht es jemanden, der Sales & Distribution fachlich bis ins Detail beherrscht, die Vorschläge des Partners bewertet und dafür sorgt, dass Lösungen entstehen, die zum Geschäft passen. Sie berichten an die Leitung des SAP-Teams, die Projektleitung liegt an anderer Stelle.

Ihre Aufgaben im Projekt

• Sie verantworten die Vertriebs- und Auftragsprozesse im Template, vom Angebot über Preisfindung und Lieferung bis zur Faktura.

• Sie steuern den Implementierungspartner fachlich: Sie prüfen Konzepte, Schätzungen und Ergebnisse und setzen durch, was das Unternehmen tatsächlich braucht.

• Sie übersetzen Anforderungen der Vertriebsbereiche in Lösungen nah am SAP-Standard.

• Sie bereiten Pilot und Rollouts aus Vertriebssicht vor und sind bei wichtigen Meilensteinen vor Ort.

• Sie bringen Entscheidungen und Risiken klar auf den Punkt, auch gegenüber Programm- und IT-Leitung.

• Sie machen die Anwenderinnen und Anwender im Vertrieb fit für die neuen Abläufe.

• Im bestehenden System sind Sie Ansprechpartner für knifflige Fälle und für angebundene Systeme, etwa für Zoll und Versand.

Das bringen Sie mit

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit SAP Sales & Distribution, inhouse oder in der Beratung

• Mehrere S/4HANA-Projekte, die Sie in Ihrem Modul von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live getragen haben, idealerweise mit Rollouts in mehrere Länder

• Tiefes Verständnis der Vertriebsprozesse inklusive Preisfindung und der Verbindungen zu Materialwirtschaft und Finanzen

• Erfahrung mit Implementierungspartnern und die Sicherheit, deren Vorschläge fachlich zu bewerten

• Klare Kommunikation auf Leitungsebene, Selbststeuerung und einen kühlen Kopf in Phasen mit hohem Takt

• Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und fließendes Englisch

• Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit SAP ECC, Projektleitungserfahrung, Kenntnisse in Außenhandelssoftware mit SAP-Anbindung

Das erwartet Sie

• Arbeitsplatz im Raum Augsburg, München, Münster oder Essen: drei Tage pro Woche am Standort, zwei Tage mobil, dazu projektabhängige Reisen innerhalb der Gruppe

• Eine Fachrolle mit echtem Einfluss auf ein langfristiges Programm und ein SAP-Team mit rund zehn Kolleginnen und Kollegen

• Festanstellung in einer wirtschaftlich soliden Gruppe mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen

• Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, flexible Arbeitszeiten und Weiterbildung

Interesse?

Senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf mit Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestem Eintrittstermin. Stefan Schulz meldet sich bei Ihnen für ein vertrauliches Erstgespräch.

title: (Senior) Account Executive | Fund Administration | VC & PE
descriptionHtml:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

  • This role is key to supporting bunch's growth going forward. You will establish and execute our commercial strategy with Enterprise customers, including larger VC funds, leading to bunch becoming the industry standard for private market investments.

  • A successful hire will contribute to setting our Commercial strategy at pace. You will play a key role in building further market knowledge and relations with potential VC customers, supporting bunch during a pivotal time.

Top responsibilities

  • Acquire new Enterprise customers across our markets (inbound and outbound).

  • Co-build a commercial acquisition strategy for new customer segments, mostly large Venture Capital funds.

  • Build and maintain relationships between bunch and i) General Partners (GPs) / CFOs / COOs of prospect and client funds, and ii) Angel investors.

  • Understand the pain points faced by prospects and customers to develop account plans for specific lists of target accounts, including demand generation and closing plans.

  • Stay informed about the competitive landscape to create winning proposals and pricing strategies.

  • Collaborate with the Strategy, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to develop best practices for generating demand and increasing customer engagement within the target accounts.

  • Create business cases that demonstrate the business value and return on investment clients can expect by using bunch.

  • Nurture client relationships, strive for process excellence that allows us to maximise customer satisfaction and ensure long-term retention.

About You

  • At least 5 years of experience as an Account Executive or in a commercial role, ideally within the private investment market. A local network of VC Fund Managers in London is a strong differentiator.

  • Excellent relationship-building and communication skills that enable you to gain trust through authenticity, expertise, and rapport-building.

  • A results-oriented, impact-driven mindset: you're curious to understand the broader context and expected outcomes, and you approach tasks with an entrepreneurial spirit to get things done.

  • Customer-centricity: you proactively understand and champion our customers' goals, always striving to provide value and align with their objectives.

  • Operational excellence in SaaS sales: you're skilled in optimising the sales process, analysing conversion rates, managing end-to-end sales funnels, and ensuring pipeline efficiency.

  • Business-level fluency in English.

Workplace and Benefits

  • Customisable benefits package covering wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

What your interview journey will look like

  • Initial call with the People team (30 min) to get to know more about the role

  • Deep Dive with a Team member (30 min) for us to learn more about your ways of working

  • Case Study Interview with the team (60 min) for us to get a sense of how you approach Sales

  • Optional Meet & Greet: Meeting our Stakeholders at bunch Offices (2 x 30min)

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.
