descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

MAP | WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses.

About WPP

MAP is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

Do you have strong data and analytical skills, with a passion for shaping business strategy? Can you architect, build, and apply modern data models to deliver impactful marketing insights? Are you seeking an exciting role with significant opportunities for leadership and growth? Then you might be the Senior Data Insights Consultant we are looking for! 

What will your day look like?

As our new Senior Data Insights Consultant, you will join our growing Technology and Data team. Here, you will be a key leader in helping our clients make data-driven decisions to enhance their digital communication on an enterprise scale. This entails designing, enabling, and delivering complex data solutions and integrations for various campaign platforms. More specifically, your tasks will include: 

  • Architecting, building, and delivering value-adding insights solutions, serving as a key advisor to clients on how to leverage their data assets to optimize large-scale communication strategies. 
  • Performing advanced analysis to uncover actionable patterns, trends, and opportunities that directly inform client strategy and decision-making. 
  • Designing and running test-and-learn programs (A/B tests, incrementality, holdouts) across channels to measure impact and continuously optimize communication performance. 
  • Partnering with senior stakeholders to define strategic business questions and translating them into robust analytical frameworks and data roadmaps. 
  • Supporting or leading the data-stream on complex, large-scale projects with globally recognised brands, ensuring that data solutions and integrations are designed and delivered for scalability and business impact. 
  • Driving ongoing proactive client ideation — identifying new opportunities, use cases, and data-driven initiatives that help clients grow their business. 
  • Helping drive agentic AI adoption, exploring and embedding agentic solutions into our data and insights workflows to enhance efficiency and client value. 
  • Providing answers and insights to business-related questions via automated reporting solutions as well as ad-hoc data analyses, including building reports and insights dashboards within marketing platforms such as Adobe and Salesforce. 
  • Mentoring, reviewing, and advising less senior team members — elevating quality, fostering technical excellence, and supporting their professional growth. 
  • Collaborating with highly skilled specialists including Account Managers, Architects, Developers, Creatives, Strategists, Data Scientists and Marketing Operations experts to service our clients coherently. 

Who are you going to work with?

You will join a team of hands-on Data Insights Consultants, Data Scientists and Data Engineers who are passionate about bringing value and knowledge from data. We are all about unlocking insights from data through analytics and making that insight applicable in 1:1 data-driven communication and CRM. Your work will always be firmly anchored in data in a cross-disciplinary setting, collaborating closely with highly enthusiastic experts from Strategy or Creative backgrounds. 

What do you bring to the table?

As a person, you possess a strong consultancy mindset, demonstrating resilience, curiosity, and an eager-to-learn attitude. You combine this with strong business acumen, allowing you to understand and anticipate client needs effectively. You are outgoing and love being part of interdisciplinary projects and solutions. You are eager to learn and quick to understand the complexity of high-tech dialogues and solutions. 

Furthermore, you have the drive, enthusiasm, and technical credibility to act as the primary data and insights advisor for senior client leadership, guiding them through complex challenges and inspiring them to grow their business. It's an advantage if you have consulting, agency experience or marketing domain knowledge, but it's not a requirement. 

In addition, you have: 

Technical skills 

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in a consultant/business liaison role related to data, BI, analytics or reporting solutions. Can independently design, build, and optimize modern analytics solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and ready for real-world production use. 
  • Write, debug, and optimize complex SQL queries, ensuring clarity, efficiency, and production readiness. 
  • Design and build scalable dimensional data models from raw source systems (fact/dimension structures, performance-aware design). Apply strong data modelling principles, governance standards and practices that ensure data accuracy, consistency, and security. 
  • Develop and manage DBT transformations using layered architecture, including testing and documentation best practices. 
  • Build production-ready Power BI semantic models and dashboards, including advanced DAX measures, performance optimization, and secure data access (RLS). 
  • Work collaboratively using GitHub, following structured branching, pull request, and code review workflows. 
  • Familiarity with or a strong interest in the application of AI and agentic frameworks, and machine learning principles to generate conversational analytics, predictive and advanced marketing insights. 
  • Comfortable working in modern cloud data environments (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Fabric). 
  • Understanding the data structures and reporting capabilities within major marketing and martech platforms (e.g., Adobe Campaign/AJO, Salesforce Marketing Cloud). Ability to build and deliver reports and insights dashboards natively within these tools is a strong advantage 

Interpersonal skills 

  • A proven ability to build trust and act as a strategic partner to senior-level clients and internal leaders. You can confidently navigate complex, technical stakeholder environments and influence decision-making through data-driven reasoning. 
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex data concepts and insights into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and senior business audiences. 
  • The ability to critically assess complex business challenges, ask probing questions to uncover root causes, and propose robust, data-driven solutions. 
  • Proven experience in coaching and mentoring junior team members. You actively foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning within the team. 
  • You are a self-starter who can think critically, identify issues and opportunities autonomously, and take the initiative to propose and implement corrective actions. 

A leader in personalized customer experiences

WPP Enterprise Solutions MAP is a world-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanize the relationship between the brand and the customer through hyper-personalisation at scale, marketing automation, and CRM. With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency, and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world's most admired brands (including Ford, Jaguar Land Rover, Nespresso, IKEA, Lego, and Coca-Cola) to help them on their transformation journey to becoming truly customer-centric. Together, we are 1,000+ technology specialists, data scientists, strategic thinkers, consultants, operations experts, and creative minds from 55+ nationalities.

A global network

We are part of the global VML network that encompasses more than 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 60+ markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences.

descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The position of the Senior Digital Transformation & Process Optimisation Consultant (Internal Title: Senior Value Engineer) is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.

The Role:

You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.

The work you’ll do:

Identify & Frame Value

  • Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers 
  • Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive

Realize Value

  • Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
  • Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
  • Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

Scale Value

  • Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
  • Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
  • Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

The qualifications you need:

Live for Customer Value: Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.

Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP),  experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.

Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures,  being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value

Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.

Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Business Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)

Industry Expertise: Ideally expertise in one or more industries (e.g. Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer, Retail, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals) and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities 

Degree: In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program

Native-level or near-native German language skills (written and spoken), with the ability to confidently engage German-speaking customers, facilitate workshops, and present to executive stakeholders.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. title: Senior Director EMEA South
descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You’ll Do:

The Southern Europe Sales organization is responsible for establishing CoreWeave as the preferred AI cloud platform for enterprises, AI labs, digital-native companies, and emerging AI builders across France, Italy, Iberia, and the wider Mediterranean region. The team creates new markets, develops strategic customer relationships, and helps customers use CoreWeave’s infrastructure and software platform to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of AI.

About the role: The Senior Director of Sales, Southern Europe reports to the VP and Managing Director of EMEA. As the senior sales leader for the region, you will own CoreWeave’s commercial strategy and execution across all customer segments, with responsibility for both new-logo acquisition and the growth of existing customers. You will inherit an established customer base and a team spanning Account Executives, Account Managers, and Account Solutions Architects, while carrying a significant mandate to design and build the broader regional coverage model.   • Own the Southern Europe business, including regional strategy, revenue performance, consumption growth, pipeline creation, customer acquisition, retention, and expansion.

  • Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives and Account Managers, establishing clear expectations, strong inspection disciplines, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Partner closely with Account Solutions Architects to connect customer business objectives with CoreWeave’s infrastructure, platform, and developer capabilities.

Who You Are:

  • Experience selling into multiple customer segments, ideally including large enterprises, high-growth technology companies, AI-native businesses, research organizations, and startups.

  • Strong command of enterprise sales methodologies, account planning, opportunity management, pipeline inspection, forecasting, and performance management.
  • Proven ability to recruit, coach, and develop high-performing sales talent, including leaders and senior individual contributors.
  • The ability to engage credibly with both commercial and deeply technical audiences, translating customer objectives into infrastructure and platform strategies.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience structuring complex agreements and balancing customer requirements with capacity, risk, margin, and long-term strategic value.
  • A hands-on leadership style and willingness to remain personally involved in strategic selling, executive engagement, and critical negotiations.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively within a fast-growing, globally matrixed organization and align regional execution with global priorities.
  • Fluent English and French language skills.
  • The ability to travel frequently across the region and internationally as required.

Preferred:

  • Leadership experience within an AI cloud, hyperscale cloud, infrastructure, enterprise platform, or consumption-based technology company.
  • Experience building a new region or significantly expanding an early-stage market presence.
  • Experience selling GPU infrastructure, accelerated computing, machine learning platforms, developer tools, or large-scale data and AI solutions.
  • Experience managing commercial opportunities where customer commitments depend on capacity availability, infrastructure deployment, supply, or service readiness.
  • Experience engaging with founders, research organizations, venture capital firms, sovereign entities, or national AI initiatives.
  • Spanish or Italian language skills.
  • An established executive and technology network across Southern Europe.
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Wondering if you’re a good fit?

We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

  • You are a builder who is energized by the opportunity to create a market, design an organization, and turn an ambitious regional strategy into a scaled business.
  • You lead from the front, combining executive presence and strategic thinking with a willingness to engage deeply in customers, opportunities, and execution.
  • You create clarity and accountability while giving talented people the trust, coaching, and support required to perform at their best.
  • You are comfortable making decisions in an environment where demand, customer requirements, capacity, and priorities are evolving rapidly.
  • You build durable customer relationships by combining commercial ambition with technical curiosity, transparency, and consistent follow-through.

title: Senior Finance Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Ocado Technology builds the systems behind some of the world’s most advanced grocery fulfilment: the Hive grid, thousands of bots, robotic picking and automated frame loading, all run by software our Product & Engineering teams write every day. More and more of that software is now built with AI.

That makes finance here far from routine. Cloud and AI are among our fastest-moving costs, and how we capitalise engineering time directly shapes our P&L. Decisions made by engineering leaders this quarter show up in our cash flow next quarter. We want someone who’ll help make those decisions, not just report on them.

Are you our person? You’re curious about how things work, commercially sharp, and happy to challenge the way things are done when you can see a better way. You can juggle competing priorities and build trust at every level, from engineers to VPs. And you’re comfortable with AI: Claude is an official member of the team here, and you’ll work alongside it every day.

About the Role

In this role, you’ll report to the Head of Finance and have real autonomy. We’ll give you the problem, not a checklist. You’ll use AI as a core part of how you work: building tools, automating reporting and analysing data so your time goes on insight, not reconciliations. In this team, building a tracker in Claude or querying data yourself in Looker is normal. You will partner with: Product & Engineering VPs and leaders, Procurement, Treasury, Group Accounting, the Shared Service Centre, and Commercial Finance colleagues across Ocado.

The exact mix will flex with your experience, your interests and the team’s priorities, but you’ll be working across:

  • The P&E cost base: Partnering Product & Engineering leaders on budgets, outlooks and month-end, and helping them understand what drives their costs and where the opportunities are.
  • Technology spend: Getting ahead of some of our fastest-moving costs, such as cloud, software and AI, and helping the business balance P&L impact against cash.
  • Investment and accounting judgement: Making sure we treat engineering investment correctly, from capex and capitalisation to how costs are allocated across the business.
  • Decision support: Turning messy questions into short, clear recommendations for senior finance and technology leaders.
  • How finance works: Building tools, automating processes and finding better ways of doing things, and shaping the team as it evolves

About you

  • Qualified accountant (ACA / ACCA / CIMA or equivalent) with 2+ years post-qualification experience including time in commercial finance or business partnering 
  • Confidence to take the lead: you set your own priorities, chase answers down and drive work through to a decision without waiting to be asked
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your work, with examples of something you’ve automated, built or rethought
  • Strong modelling, budgeting and forecasting skills, and a solid grasp of P&L, capex and cash
  • The ability to explain technical costs in plain English to engineers and finance leaders alike, and to challenge constructively
  • Curiosity about how technology businesses work. Experience with cloud costs, capitalisation of development spend or SaaS/tech finance is a plus, not a requirement

What we offer

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:

  • Time to recharge:
    25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.
  • Health & wellbeing:
    Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.

    22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave
  • Financial support:
    Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.
  • Commuter perks:
    Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.

title: Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – Hybrid PHP/Symfony & React
descriptionHtml:
Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD
  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit
  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote
  • Standort: Berlin-Zehlendorf, direkt am S-Bahnhof Zehlendorf (S1)
  • Produkt: Konsentas, ein Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement für Behörden
  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen
  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen
  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln
  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen
  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden
  • Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)
  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)
  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID
  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework
  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.
  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab
  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL
  • Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD
  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1
  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.
  • Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen bei uns genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Dein Team

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Daniel (Developer Lead), Nico (Geschäftsführer & Projektmanager), der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Daniel und Nico übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Was wir bieten

  • Ein sinnstiftendes Produkt, das täglich in Bürgerämtern genutzt wird, in einem krisensicheren Markt
  • Echter Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen und eine Modernisierung mit klarem Ziel
  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit ab 10 Uhr, 2 Remote-Tage pro Woche
  • Weiterbildung während der Arbeitszeit, z. B. Udemy-Kurse; eigene Vorschläge sind willkommen
  • Claude-Lizenz, offen für weitere Tools
  • Hardware: Lenovo ThinkPad, offen für Vorschläge
  • UrbanSportsClub und JobRad
  • Gute Anbindung: S1 und Busse M48, 101, 115

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

  • Kennenlerngespräch mit Sara
  • Technisches Interview mit Live-Projektarbeit mit Nico und Daniel
  • Teamgespräch vor Ort
  • Angebot

Über Girona

Seit über 25 Jahren entwickelt die Girona Softwareentwicklung GmbH in Berlin Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf unsere Lösungen, Konsentas etwa in Bürgerämtern, Gesundheitsämtern sowie Kfz-Zulassungs- und Führerscheinstellen.

title: Senior Incident Response Consultant, Rapid Response
descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Sophos is seeking an experienced and motivated Senior Incident Response Consultant to join our Incident Response (IR) service. The Sophos IR team is an elite group of incident responders that are engaged by organizations worldwide to respond to and neutralize cyber threats. Specializing in industry-standard forensic tools and Sophos technologies, the team provides comprehensive investigations, response actions, remediation guidance, and root cause analysis to combat a wide range of cybersecurity incidents.

As a Senior Incident Response Consultant on the Sophos IR team, you will be responsible for spearheading incident response engagements for customers who have experienced a cybersecurity attack. In this role, you will lead a team of Incident Response Consultants, running customer-facing calls, providing detailed written updates via email, and determining the priorities of the investigation, delegating tasks accordingly to your team.

In this role, you will be accountable for ensuring that the appropriate actions have been taken by both your team and the customer to effectively neutralize the threat. Additionally, you will be tasked with conducting a thorough root cause analysis to determine the origin of the incident, including identifying whether any data exfiltration occurred, provided the necessary evidence is available.

At the culmination of each engagement, you will be responsible for producing an executive summary-style report, which will include a timeline of key events mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework. This comprehensive report will serve as a valuable resource for stakeholders, highlighting the steps taken to combat the cybersecurity incident and provide remediation guidance.

The ideal candidate for this role will possess extensive experience leading incident response efforts, a deep understanding of cybersecurity threats and mitigation strategies, and the ability to communicate complex technical information to executive-level stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.


What You Will Do

  • Lead kick off calls with customers to understand their situation and identify initial response actions to contain the threat

  • Provide guidance to customers on best practices following an incident

  • Lead daily update calls for customers to deliver forensic findings

  • Deliver concise email updates to customers between update calls

  • Direct the forensic investigations, identify priorities, and delegate tasks to analysts

  • Conduct multiple Rapid Response incidents concurrently

  • Determine TTPs identified by analysts and add them to the threat intel platform

  • Write clear and concise Executive Summary style reports in a timely manner

  • Responsible for basic to moderate complexity projects that contribute to the development of the Sophos Rapid Response service

  • Provide daily handover notes to teams located in different time zones, or when incident responsibility is being transferred to another Incident Lead

What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years of experience leading incident response investigations involving ransomware

  • Experience leading BEC investigations

  • Continuously learning and staying informed of the changing threat landscape

  • Proven track record of successful neutralization and remediation of ransomware threats

  • Excellent understanding of the Incident Response process

  • Excellent understanding of cyber risks and able to qualify them to customers

  • Excellent oral communication skills

  • Strong written communication skills

  • Ability to manage time effectively

  • Able to delegate and prioritize tasks across multiple incidents

  • Able to excel under stressful circumstances

  • Occasionally willing to begin work early and/or stay late when warranted for customer engagements

  • Strong grasp of the MITRE ATT&CK framework

  • Enjoy mentoring and assisting in the development of junior analysts

  • A team-player attitude with a willingness to share knowledge

  • Ability to work some weekends and holidays

  • Post-secondary education in Cybersecurity, comparable

  • Cybersecurity certifications an asset (e.g. CISSP, GCFA, or similar)

  • Experience with SIEM technology (e.g. Splunk, ELK, etc.)

  • Willingness to work occasional overtime during peak times or holidays

  • Experience writing SQL queries

  • Experience writing PowerShell, Python, or Bash scripts

What does remote mean at Sophos?
Sophos supports flexible ways of working, with many roles offered remotely and others working in a hybrid model. For remote roles, you may work remotely within the location specified in the job posting. Candidates must reside in and be authorized to work in that location. Our teams collaborate across locations and time zones, using technology to stay connected and deliver results.

title: Senior Incident Response & Digital Forensics Consultant (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Who are we?

It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents.

All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

Tasks

As our Senior Incident Response Consultant (m/w/d), you will support the NVISO incident response team (CSIRT) in responding to a wide range of cyber incidents. In addition to incident response and forensic engagements, you will work closely with the rest of the team to build & automate incident response processes, analytical capabilities, including threat hunting. You act as Incident Lead by setting investigative questions, delegating technical analysis tasks, and steer containment and eradication strategies. You produce high-quality forensic and executive reports to present findings to technical stakeholders and executives. You occasionally peer-review case notes, artifacts, and draft reports.

Your responsibilities

  • Perform host forensics (Magnet AXIOM Cyber, X-Ways, Autopsy), network forensics (Wireshark, tshark), memory forensics (Volatility, MemProcFS), and log analysis, including cloud telemetry (Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS, Google Cloud/Workspace), in support of cyber incident investigations.
  • Lead single-system forensic analysis and contribute meaningfully to complex intrusions, including those with lateral movement, perform timeline analysis of compromised hosts and conduct live response artifact capture, volatile data collection, containment to support eradication and recovery efforts.
  • Perform basic malware triage of executables and malicious scripts (static and behavioral) to inform containment and eradication strategies.
  • Lead customer calls during incidents and contribute to cyber crisis management, and deliver status reports, planning for containment, eradication and recovery efforts, and input to executive-ready communications.
  • Support improvement projects related to automation in digital forensics and further develop NVISO tools and incident response processes.
  • Perform threat hunting engagements within customer environments, including technical planning, requirements definition, execution, and reporting.
  • Assist in other engagements such as tabletop exercises, incident and forensic readiness assessments, and threat-intelligence-related briefings.

Requirements

  • You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience, including acting as an incident response case lead.
  • Strong knowledge of cyber intrusion analysis, incident response, digital forensics on Windows/MacOS/Unix, with demonstrated expertise in memory forensics (Volatility, MemProcFS), timeline analysis (e.g., MFTECmd, KAPE, Plaso/Timesketch), and disk forensics (Magnet AXIOM Cyber, X-Ways, Autopsy).
  • Proficiency with live response tooling (e.g., Velociraptor, GRR Rapid Response, EDR live response) and coordinating remediation actions.
  • Up-to-date on the latest cybersecurity threats and attacker TTPs.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail in documentation.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to work collaboratively with clients and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to remain calm during crisis situations and prioritize effectively under pressure.
  • Language: German and English at C1+ proficiency for client-facing work across DACH.

Your availability

  • We have an On-call rotation, typically one week per month.

Travel

  • Some limited travel within DE/AT/CH (~10–20%) for onsite response, workshops, and stakeholder meetings.

Benefits

At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components:

  • Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc);
  • An entrepreneurial and agile company, where you will be stimulated and supported in driving new initiatives (either through internal innovation or by improving our service offering), without losing sight of having fun!
  • Regular team-building and fun events;
  • Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career!
  • A training budget of 10,000 EUR plus 10 days paid time off rolling over two years;
  • An annual gross base salary between 69,000 EUR and 87,000 EUR, depending on your experience;
  • Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad options within the EU);
  • Reimbursement of Deutschlandticket + BahnCard 50 1st Class;
  • Business Bike Leasing;
  • Company Pension Scheme;
  • 30 holidays.

Disclaimer on the Use of AI Tools in the Application Process

Our expectations:

Application documents must authentically reflect your own qualifications, personality, and motivation.

In this role, you'll help us lead the Corporate Services Sourcing team for the Deliveroo and Wolt brands, driving strategic category management and delivering commercial value across a multi-million-pound indirect spend portfolio.

Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Global Sourcing team within our Global Procurement organization, reporting into the Director, Head of Global Strategic Sourcing. You will lead a team of five (5) managing a broad portfolio across EMEA (including Professional Services, Global Security, Facilities/Real Estate, BPO, HR/Benefits, and Contingent Workforce), while partnering with the DoorDash Corporate Services team to capture global enterprise synergies.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

Category Strategy & Leadership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing sourcing team of five, setting clear goals, driving accountability, and building capability across the Corporate Services portfolio.

  • Build and execute multi-year category strategies that increase category maturity, optimise total cost of ownership (TCO), and unlock value beyond traditional cost savings.

  • Partner with DoorDash sourcing leads to align global category strategies, leverage enterprise scale across brands, and capture cross-regional synergies.

Execution & Supplier Management

  • Own the end-to-end sourcing lifecycle for high-stakes corporate procurement, including data analysis, RFx creation, proposal evaluation, and complex contract negotiations (MSAs/SOWs).

  • Act as a trusted advisor and escalation point for executive stakeholders across G&A functions (Finance, Legal, HR, Security) and core business lines.

  • Establish best-in-class supplier ecosystems, tracking performance, SLAs, and supplier risk while embedding ethical and sustainable sourcing (ESG) practices.

  • Contribute to procurement transformation initiatives, championing new tooling, AI-driven sourcing workflows, and continuous process improvements.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Significant experience in Corporate Services Sourcing, with a proven track record of developing and executing strategic category plans across indirect spend categories.

  • Demonstrated people management capability, with experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing sourcing professionals.

  • Strong commercial and negotiation acumen, with proven ability to structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements (MSAs, SOWs) and utilise TCO modelling.

  • Exceptional stakeholder engagement and communication skills, capable of influencing senior leaders, managing matrixed business partners, and driving cross-brand collaboration.

  • Deep risk management expertise, including third-party risk assessments, contract governance, and mitigation strategies within multi-jurisdictional environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working within the technology sector or high-growth, fast-paced marketplace environments.

  • Proficiency with modern procurement and CLM platforms (e.g., Coupa, NetSuite, Pivot) and enthusiasm for applying AI tools in day-to-day sourcing workflows.

  • Experience operating across European markets and diverse regulatory/legal structures.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Senior Manager, Performance Creative Strategy – Casino (Remote)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

Primary Focus:

As Senior Manager, Performance Creative Strategy at Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG), you are responsible for defining the strategic priorities, audience opportunities and learning agenda that shape Fanatics Casino performance creative. You’ll uncover the hooks, angles and player insights most likely to resonate, translate them into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative team, and track performance to understand what works and why. This role is the strategic link between player insight, creative development and performance results, ensuring the right problems are being solved and that learnings continuously inform future briefs across acquisition, engagement and retention.

This position reports directly to the Senior Director, Performance Creative & GTM, and manages one Associate, Performance Creative.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the Casino performance creative strategy across paid social, app networks, CTV, affiliates and lifecycle, aligned with business priorities, audience insight and brand positioning.
  • Build and evolve the Casino creative variation framework, mapping hooks, angles, reasons to believe, formats and offers to audience and funnel stage.
  • Translate business objectives and player insight into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative agency, including scripts, hook variations and iteration briefs on winning concepts.
  • Own the Casino testing agenda, defining what we want to learn, how we measure a win, and which tests run each month.
  • Drive a high-velocity testing program across hooks, openers, formats, offers and creators, continuously improving hit rate and speed to learning.
  • Partner with Media and Analytics to track creative performance, identify winners and fatigue early, and apply learnings to the next round of briefs.
  • Write concise test readouts and maintain a living library of what works for Casino players.
  • Identify and define the performance territories, audience tensions and messaging opportunities to support creative briefs
  • Embed performance requirements into brand and full-funnel campaign briefs from the outset (in collaboration with integrated marketing and media), ensuring channel, audience, format and measurement needs are clear before creative development begins. Partner with the Casino Creative Studio to translate those requirements into effective creative, with the Studio retaining ownership of creative direction and execution.
  • Advise Brand and agency partners on hooks, edits, cutdowns, aspect ratios and platform-native versions, so big campaign moments carry through to always-on performance and lifecycle.
  • Source player insight, competitor ad libraries, creator content and platform trends to identify new angles and white space.
  • Lead performance strategy/creative insight sessions and contribute a strong POV to creative brainstorms, working closely with the Casino Creative Studio.
  • Present performance learnings and recommendations in GTM forums and monthly reviews, turning results into a clear story for senior leadership.
  • Lead, mentor and develop an Associate, building their craft in briefing, analysis and testing.

How This Role Connects Across the Team:

  • Partners with the internal producer, who owns production timelines and delivery, to keep briefs, priorities and the content calendar aligned.
  • Partners with the Casino Creative Studio and Integrated Marketing to shape high-quality output, providing direction and feedback while respecting executional ownership.
  • Partners with Brand and Integrated Marketing to embed performance best practice into campaigns, ensuring work is both distinctive and built to perform across the funnel.
  • Partners with Media, Analytics and CRM to define success measures, read results and feed learnings back into strategy.
  • Works with Legal, Compliance and Creative Operations to keep all creative compliant and aligned with Responsible Gaming standards.
  • Partner with the affiliates teams to produce UGC briefs aligned to channel best practice, adapting content that’s optimised for performance (via creative briefs)

Skills & Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance creative or brand strategy, including 3+ years leading creative strategy for a fast-growing D2C brand, mobile app, gaming or casino business.
  • Portfolio demonstrating hook-led, insight-driven creative and the performance results behind it.
  • Deep knowledge of platform-native creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap and app networks, including UGC and creator formats.
  • Proven track record building and running creative testing programs at volume.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to read performance data, size results and translate them into clear recommendations.
  • Excellent storytelling and writing skills, from a 6-second hook to a campaign narrative to an executive readout.
  • Experience influencing brand and integrated campaigns across matrixed teams without direct ownership.
  • Experience managing and developing direct reports.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally for team meetings and Fanatics events.

Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.

title: Senior Manager, Sales UKI
descriptionHtml:
About Pleo

At Pleo, we believe that finance is the strategic force at the heart of how every business runs. When a finance team leads with its craft, they make better decisions and steer the business with more confidence. In order to do that, the busywork that comes with expense management needs to move out the way.

That’s why we built a spend management platform that streamlines the whole process, from employee spending to approvals and reconciliation. Finance teams get clarity and control of all the numbers and data in one place and employees get an experience that they actually enjoy.

The word “Pleo” in Greek means “more than you’d expect,” and that mindset has driven our growth since 2015 and our 40,000+ customers. Today we’re 750+ people from over 65 nationalities who take pride in understanding customer needs, turning complex problems into simple solutions, challenging the way things are done, and aiming for the highest outcome. We haven’t got everything figured out, but we’re committed to developing and delivering an experience as elevated as the craft of finance.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Sales Manager to join our commercial team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help drive hyper-growth across the UK/I market, lead and scale our high-performing Mid-Market sales organisation, and be part of our commercial leadership team as we scale our smart company spending platform. If you're excited about leading an entrepreneurial sales engine, empowering reps through coaching and frameworks like MEDDIC, and are passionate about the future of corporate spend management and Fintech, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director of Sales and work closely with teams in Sales Development, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Marketing and Product. Our sales leaders and account executives are highly collaborative and dedicated to expanding our UKI market share and delivering exceptional revenue growth.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Sales Manager, you will:

  • Lead and executive the UKI GTM strategy to hit ambitious targets, expanding our reach within our mid-market segment

  • Hire, develop, and mentor high-potential sales professionals across all stages of the sales cycle, from prospecting to complex closes

  • Instill rigour through MEDDIPICC and value-based selling frameworks, while personally stepping into high-stakes deal cycles to help reps close

  • Represent Pleo’s commercial function in the fion, championing our vision, brand, and product across the industry.

  • Partner with Marketing, RevOps, and Product to align pipeline generation, process efficiency, and product feedback loop with market demand

To put things into context, we’re currently scaling our mid-market footprint across UKI and optimising cross-functional GTM alignment on our roadmap. You can expect to work with the following tech stack: HubSpot, Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Claude.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Proven track record leading sales teams to consistently hit revenue targets in a high-growth SaaS environment

  • Expertise in embedding MEDDPICC, value- based selling, and structured pipeline management across a sales organization

  • Passion for hiring, coaching, and developing talent while maintaining a culture of accountability and healthy competition

  • Hands-on approach with the confidence to jump into complex deal discussions and coach on objection handling or closing strategies

  • Deep knowledge of closing deals with UKI mid-market decision makers in fintech, SaaS, or finance tech.

  • Background in B2B SaaS, fintech, or scaling scale-up commercial organisations

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You thrive on building, coaching, and elevating high-potential sales talent into high performers

  • You love being both strategic and hands-on, willing to hop on high-value calls alongside your reps to close deals

  • You want to be the executive face of a hyper-growth product with an incredible culture

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer hands-off management and delegate all coaching or pipeline reviews

  • You do not use structure frameworks like MEDDPICC to guide sales forecasts and deal execution

  • You prefer a rigid corporate structure over a dynamic, fast-paced scale up environment

How you’ll develop in this role
In your first 6 to 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the UKI sales organisation to drive hyper-growth in revenue and team headcount

  • Collaborate with RevOps and Marketing to optimise pipeline velocity and deal conversion metrics

  • Grow your leadership trajectory, taking ownership of larger regional strategies as Pleo continues its global scale

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: 45 mins interview with the Hiring Manager to go deeper on your experience and how your profile can fit to the role

  3. Pleo Challenge and Panel Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present it during a 60 mins team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a Senior Leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Senior Manager, Solution Engineering EMEA
descriptionHtml:
At Sanity.io, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS, Figma, Riot Games, Anthropic, COMPLEX, Nordstrom, and Morningbrew are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

In this role you'll own EMEA as your region: full remit over the Solution Engineering team's success, working as a player-coach who hires, develops, and holds the bar on how the team runs discovery, demos, and evaluations, while getting hands-on in the highest-impact deals across the region. You'll own execution of Sanity's core presales motions — discovery, tailored demos, POVs, and architecture/security reviews — coaching SEs to run them with consistency and to connect Sanity's value drivers to real business outcomes, not just features or functionality.

You'll partner closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing across EMEA, reporting into and collaborating with the Sr. Director of Solution Engineering on strategy and priorities. You'll also make sure your team is set up to win with the presales toolkit — demo environments, collateral, evaluation guides — iterating and building where you see gaps for your region.

We care about the impact we make for our customers, and we show up as a consultative partner in every interaction to support their success. If this is how you operate, this role is for you.

What you would do

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of Solution Engineers across EMEA — hiring, ramping, and running regular 1:1s and deal reviews.

  • Get hands-on in the team’s highest-impact opportunities, from discovery through close, modelling the behaviours you want your team to run.

  • Execute and reinforce Sanity’s established presales motions (discovery, demos, POVs, architecture/security reviews) with consistency across the team, rather than defining new ones.

  • Coach SEs to translate technical capability into business outcomes for developers, architects, product leaders, and content teams.

  • Evangelise and drive consistent use of AI tools — for call prep, faster POC/demo environment setup, and turning discovery notes into follow-up docs — to cut cycle time without sacrificing quality.

  • Own regional forecasting and pipeline hygiene for presales involvement, and report on team performance and technical win rates.

  • Partner with Sales leadership, Product, and Marketing in EMEA, and route field feedback up to the Sr. Director of Solution Engineering.

  • Make sure your team is set up to win with the presales toolkit — demo environments, collateral, evaluation guides — iterating and building where you see gaps for your region.

About you:

  • Experience managing or leading a Solutions Engineering / Presales team in B2B SaaS, ideally selling highly technical, composable, headless, or API-first platforms — CMS, DXP, or adjacent tools in the modern content stack..

  • Strong technical foundation: comfortable discussing APIs, data models, front-end frameworks, integrations, and modern architecture patterns.

  • Track record of improving team performance through coaching, hands-on deal support, and consistent execution of an established presales process.

  • Clear, inclusive communicator who can flex from deep technical detail to executive-level value narratives.

  • Experience selling developer-facing, composable, or API-first SaaS platforms — content management, digital experience, or similar tooling in the modern content stack.

  • Familiarity with content workflows, editorial tooling, or digital experience stacks.

  • Collaborative leadership style with high integrity and a bias toward developing others.

  • Fluent with AI-based tools across your technical work — evaluations, architecture conversations, research, day-to-day productivity — and able to bring that fluency to how the team operates.

Not sure you’re exactly what we’re looking for in this role? Apply anyway!

What we can offer:

  • A highly-skilled, inspiring, and supportive team.

  • Positive, flexible, and trust-based work environment that encourages long-term professional and personal growth.

  • A global, multi-culturally diverse group of colleagues and customers.

  • Comprehensive health plans and perks.

  • A healthy work-life balance that accommodates individual and family needs.

  • Competitive salary and stock options program.

Who we are:

Sanity.io is a modern, flexible content operating system that replaces rigid legacy content management systems. One of our big differentiators is treating content as data so that it can be stored in a single source of truth, but seamlessly adapted and personalized for any channel without extra effort. Forward-thinking companies choose Sanity because they can create tailored content authoring experiences, customized workflows, and content models that reflect their business.

Sanity recently raised a $85m Series C led by GP Bullhound and is also backed by leading investors like ICONIQ Growth, Threshold Ventures, Heavybit and Shopify, as well as founders of companies like Vercel, WPEngine, Twitter, Mux, Netlify and Heroku. This funding round has put Sanity in a strong position for accelerated growth in the coming years.

You can only build a great company with a great culture. Sanity is a 300+ person company with highly committed and ambitious people. We are pioneers, we exist for our customers, we are hel ved, and we love type two fun! Read more about our values here!

Sanity.io pledges to be an organization that reflects the globally diverse audience that our product serves. We believe that in addition to hiring the best talent, a diversity of perspectives, ideas, and cultures leads to the creation of better products and services. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

title: Senior Presales Consultant Identity & Trust (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
At G+D Netcetera, we create digital solutions that make interactions more secure, convenient and seamless. Our Identity & Trust business line combines our expertise in digital identity, authentication and identity management with trusted digital services such as electronic signatures and seals.

Join us and help turn complex Identity & Trust challenges into solutions that create real value for our customers.

Your Responsibilities

  • Lead functional and technical solution consulting throughout the sales process for our Identity & Trust portfolio.
  • Understand customer needs and translate them into compelling solution concepts, architectures and integration approaches.
  • Design and deliver product demonstrations, Proofs of Concept and customer workshops for both business and technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to translate complex functional and technical requirements into clear solution concepts and compelling customer presentations.
  • Experience with product demonstrations, workshops, Proofs of Concept and RFIs/RFPs in collaboration with technical and business experts.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills and confidence working with both technical specialists and executive-level decision-makers.
  • A structured, independent and solution-oriented way of working, taking ownership from initial customer requirements through to handover.
  • Fluent in German and English and willing to travel.

Nice-to-have

  • Knowledge of eIDAS 2.0, EUDI Wallets, Verifiable Credentials and decentralized identity.
  • Familiarity with identity technologies and standards such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, FIDO2/Passkeys or Keycloak.
  • Experience with electronic signatures, electronic seals, PKI or qualified trust services.
  • Experience with security- or regulatory-driven solutions in Financial Services, Insurance or Public Sector.
  • Understanding the business models of Digital Identity and Trust Services
  • A relevant degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Business Administration or a comparable field.

title: Senior / Principal Chemist, AI Safety
descriptionHtml:
Your Impact at LILA

We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

We are seeking a chemist to map risk across the chemical sciences domain: you will connect deep chemistry expertise with dual-use risk assessment to help safeguard increasingly capable scientific AI. You will investigate how advances in chemical research could change harmful capabilities, including established and emerging chemical threats.

What You'll Be Building

  • Map chemical misuse risks across scientific models, agents and automated experimentation, connecting scientific advances to harmful applications and identifying emerging or overlooked pathways.
  • Assess how scientific feasibility, practical complexity and actors' expertise or resources affect the plausibility and likelihood of misuse, including which constraints AI could change.
  • Distinguish established capabilities, plausible future developments and weakly supported hypotheses, updating assessments as scientific evidence and AI capabilities evolve.
  • Identify gaps in coverage, frame questions for consultants and specialist organizations, and assess and integrate their findings with support from the expert-program team.
  • Translate scientific risk judgments into dual-use policy boundaries, evaluation priorities and mitigation requirements that preserve beneficial chemistry.
  • Partner with threat modelers, evaluation researchers and mitigation teams to design informative assessments, interpret red-team findings and test safeguards.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Deep expertise (a PhD, or comparable experience) in synthetic chemistry or a closely related discipline, demonstrated through substantial research or applied work and sound interpretation of experimental evidence. This includes a background in molecular design and medicinal chemistry, inorganic and organometallic chemistry, synthesis, process development and formulations, or other relevant sub-fields.
  • Substantive experience assessing chemical dual-use risks (e.g. across national security, export controls, or other chemical risk tracking such as the CWC).
  • Strong scientific judgment about feasibility, uncertainty and practical constraints, including the ability to investigate unfamiliar questions and recognize the limits of your expertise.
  • The ability to identify appropriate specialists, critically assess their evidence and combine findings across disciplines into defensible risk assessments.
  • Clear scientific communication, independent research judgment and an ability to collaborate across science, engineering and policy.

Bonus Points For

  • Prior experience applying domain expertise to AI safety through one or more of: scientific analysis informing threat models; evaluation or red-teaming work; or mitigation design.
  • Experience commissioning specialist research or coordinating external scientific collaborators.
  • Experience with automated chemistry, scientific modeling or the translation of computational findings into physical experiments.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range$268,000—$384,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.
