title: Senior Privacy Counsel (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deep Blue Recruitment is working with an international technology company looking to appoint an experienced Senior Privacy Counsel to join its legal team.

Operating in the enterprise technology sector, the business develops software and digital solutions for customers across a range of industries. With continued investment in emerging technologies, including AI, data protection is becoming an increasingly important consideration in how the business develops its products, manages risk and works with customers.

We're looking for a commercially minded privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, understanding how technology works and finding practical solutions to complex legal questions.

This is a broad, hands-on role combining privacy advisory work, commercial support and the continued development of internal data protection processes.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Advise colleagues across the business on a broad range of privacy and data protection matters, providing clear, commercially focused legal guidance.

  • Work closely with product, technology and commercial teams on the development of new services, ensuring privacy considerations are addressed early in the process.

  • Support the negotiation of commercial agreements, particularly around data processing, international transfers, customer relationships and third-party arrangements.

  • Advise on GDPR and other applicable international data protection regulations, helping the business understand and manage its obligations across different markets.

  • Provide legal guidance on emerging technologies, including AI, and the implications of new products and data processing activities from a privacy perspective.

  • Review and improve existing privacy policies, internal procedures and governance frameworks to ensure they remain practical and fit for purpose.

  • Work alongside information security and IT teams on data governance, risk assessments and privacy-related incidents.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency of privacy operations, including through automation and better internal processes.

  • Monitor regulatory developments affecting technology businesses, particularly around data protection, AI and digital services.

  • Provide training and guidance to colleagues across the organisation, helping non-legal teams understand their responsibilities when handling personal data.

What They're Looking For

  • A qualified lawyer with approximately 4-10 years of experience specialising in data protection, privacy or technology law, with significant experience advising B2B technology businesses, in an in-house setting.

  • Strong knowledge of GDPR and European data protection law, with proven experience applying these regulations in B2B software, SaaS, AI or technology infrastructure environments.

  • Hands-on experience advising companies that develop or provide enterprise software, AI platforms, cloud infrastructure, APIs or other data-intensive B2B technology solutions.

  • A good understanding of AI technologies, particularly AI models, infrastructure and enterprise applications, and the privacy and regulatory challenges associated with their development, deployment and commercialisation.

  • Experience advising on B2B commercial agreements, including data processing agreements (DPAs), international data transfers, enterprise customer contracts and complex controller/processor arrangements.

  • Comfortable working closely with product, engineering and infrastructure teams, understanding technical architectures, data flows and product development processes to provide practical, commercially focused legal advice.

  • A commercial approach to risk management, with an understanding of the challenges facing high-growth B2B technology companies and the ability to find workable solutions that support product development and commercial objectives.

  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities independently in a fast-moving technology environment.

  • Experience working within an international B2B technology business, particularly one scaling its enterprise customer base or operating across multiple jurisdictions, would be beneficial.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to join an international technology business where privacy plays an important role in how the company operates, develops its products and works with customers.

You'll have a broad remit, working closely with different teams across the organisation on a range of commercial, operational and regulatory matters, including some of the challenges emerging technologies bring to data protection.

If you're a privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, has an interest in technology and takes a practical approach to solving legal challenges, we'd be interested in hearing from you.

We are seeking a Senior Procurement Specialist, Technology and SaaS Sourcing, to lead the strategic sourcing, negotiation, renewal, and optimization of approximately $20M in annual technology spend across software, SaaS, cloud, and hosting services.

  • Demonstrated success in independently leading supplier negotiations and renewals, including preparing negotiation strategies, analyzing supplier proposals, challenging pricing, managing escalations, and securing measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Strong experience reviewing and interpreting software and SaaS agreements, order forms, service schedules, renewal terms, termination rights, usage commitments and license structures in partnership with Legal and business stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently prioritize and lead multiple strategically significant sourcing initiatives, balancing stakeholder requirements, competing business priorities and commercial objectives.

  • Highly organized with excellent time management skills and the flexibility to manage multiple priorities, short timeframes, unplanned requests and competing stakeholder requirements.

  • Ability to work independently, demonstrate confidence, sound judgement and integrity, and take ownership of deliverables with limited day-to-day management oversight.

  • Strong ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional, complex environment, including experience engaging with senior stakeholders and influencing business decisions.

  • Successful completion of a background screening process including, but not limited to, employment verifications, criminal search, OFAC, SS Verification, as well as credit and drug screening, where applicable and in accordance with federal and local regulations

Requirements that will differentiate your candidacy:

  • Experience managing software development, enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, IaaS, hosting and technology service provider vendors and related spend.

  • Experience with vendor consolidation, renewal planning, license optimization, software asset management or post-merger supplier rationalization.

  • Professional Procurement qualification is desirable.

  • Prior experience working with enterprise technology suppliers such as Microsoft, Salesforce, ServiceNow, AWS, Oracle, Workday, Zoom, Docusign or similar vendors.

  • Familiarity with software asset management, usage analysis, license optimization, pricing benchmarks, supplier commercial models, market comparison data and emerging technology trends.

  • Prior experience with a leading technology company.

title: Senior Product Analyst, Marketplace
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Delivery companies have always bought capacity by guesswork. Book too few drivers and parcels wait; book too many and you pay for empty vans. Most carriers accept that waste as the price of being reliable. Relay is building a marketplace where it isn't. You can't schedule drivers. You can only design what's on offer, and measure what happens.

Every part of our network runs on decisions. The next two years are about building the systems that make them well, and proving they do. Engineering and operational research build what you design.

Marketplace Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what Marketplace changes on booking, matching and shifts, and recommend on pay. Our scientists' models and experiments feed your calls, and the squad lead acts on them.

  • Drivers choose when to work. What makes a shift worth booking early, and how do you prove what works when a clean experiment isn't possible?

  • Every booked shift is paid, used or not, and every unserved route means late parcels. Where should each area sit between the two, and what would let the network get there on its own?

  • Local shops hold our parcels while running their own businesses. Where does the network need more of them, what should a shop be paid, and how would you see a closed shop coming?

  • A whole area, not a slice: no playbook, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Product Analyst, Marketplace at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Marketplace problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Marketplace decides: which signals count, and what good looks like for booking, matching and pay.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, Marketplace's booking and pay decisions run on a system you designed.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned the decisions a matching, pricing or incentive model fed, in a two-sided marketplace or gig platform, rather than building the model itself.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Can trace why drivers or couriers stop booking or cancel, and can read the experiments behind a pricing or incentive change, including when a clean test isn't possible.

  • Have been through real change, such as a pivot, fast growth or a new market, and rebuilt something because of it.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and happy to build their own analysis apps, monitors and alerts.

  • Would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Senior Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Adclear

At Adclear, we're building the trust layer for how the world's most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review that slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'.

This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we're only at the beginning. The product you'll design is what people actually touch when they experience that shift.

Founded in 2024, we've already earned the trust of leading innovators as well as established enterprises including Monzo, Lloyds, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others. Our early traction let us raise 2.6m in funding, and we're now scaling fast. We're building the product engine that turns a genuinely novel category into something people love to use, and this is where you come in.

The Role

This is a full-stack product role with real scope: you won't be handed a corner of a system, you'll own complete product slices end-to-end, from spec through to something live that customers depend on every day. Here's a taste of what that looks like in practice:

  • A Chrome extension that runs compliance checks inline in Google Docs, where marketers actually write copy. Built with Monzo as the design partner. Public on the Chrome Web Store.

  • A natural-language copilot for compliance work. Users ask in plain English, the platform proposes typed actions, a human approves, the action runs. Not chat over a database.

  • The interface where reviewers watch the model reason through a decision, step in when they disagree, and feed structured corrections back into the rules.

  • An integration surface that reaches into wherever customers create marketing: Canva, Figma, Google Docs, Contentful, Workfront, Monday.com, Frame.io for video.

  • A dashboard that takes a long, unsorted list of compliance tasks and turns it into a single prioritised queue.

You think in user outcomes and shipped work, not tickets closed. Your code handles edge cases, your APIs have clean contracts, and the work you ship stays shipped. Our users are compliance and marketing teams at leading fintechs. They use Adclear every day, and they'll tell you fast when something's wrong, which is exactly the kind of feedback loop that makes this job good.

What you'll do

  • Own product delivery. Take features from spec to production, frontend-first but covering backend and integration where needed.

  • Build the product surfaces compliance reviewers live in: workflows, review UIs, the moments where model output meets human judgement.

  • Work with AI in the critical path. Ship features where the model is genuinely part of the product, not a bolted-on feature.

  • Ship a change to production on your first day and a feature in your first week. We deploy continuously, so you'll feel the pace immediately.

  • Have real input on what we build, how we build it, and which problems are worth solving next. Nobody here is precious about a roadmap someone else wrote.

What we're looking for

  • Independent delivery. You can own and ship end-to-end product slices with minimal supervision. Your track record shows features that shipped, stuck, and solved real user problems.

  • Product trade-off judgement. You balance speed, quality and user impact under ambiguity. You push back when something is underspecified, and make pragmatic calls when it needs to ship anyway.

  • Product taste. You notice when something feels wrong and aren't afraid to raise it. You care about the smaller details while still knowing when to ship at pace.

  • Cross-functional pragmatism. You work effectively with founders, designers and AI engineers, and you unblock yourself rather than waiting on someone else.

  • AI literacy. You're fluent with modern coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, agents). You treat them as collaborators, know when to trust them and when to override them, and have real opinions about where they help and where they get in the way.

Strong technical depth in:

  • Strong TypeScript and React. Comfortable end-to-end.

  • Building products where AI is in the critical path.

  • Modern web tooling. Node, Postgres.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Hono, or Drizzle.

  • Experience in regulated industries: fintech, healthtech, legaltech.

The Stack

React and TypeScript on the frontend. A Hono API on Cloudflare Workers. Drizzle and Postgres on the data layer.

How we work

  • Location in London (4 days a week in our Farringdon office)

  • Founders are closely involved in the day-to-day.

  • You talk to customers, you input your expertise on the strategy and execute it with our vision in mind

  • You own what you ship, including after it's shipped.

  • This isn't the right role if you want tightly scoped tickets, a fixed lane, or a strict 40-hour week. The pace is fast and the scope moves.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary

  • Meaningful equity

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Hardware budget

  • Monthly gym contribution

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Founded in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN, Proton was built on the belief that privacy is a fundamental human right. What started as an encrypted email service has grown into an ecosystem of privacy-first products, including Proton Mail, VPN, Drive, Pass, and Calendar, used by millions of people worldwide.

We're profitable, independent, and building for the long term. Free from venture capital control and advertising-driven business models, we focus on what matters most: our users. Our work helps protect digital freedom, from everyday privacy to supporting journalists and activists in challenging environments.

Today, we're an international team of 700+ people, with offices across 9 countries. We have high standards for the people we hire and the work we do. You'll work alongside talented, driven colleagues who challenge each other, take ownership, and care about getting things right.

Explore our open-source projects.

The Role

We're building something new at Proton and we're hiring a Senior PM to lead it from the front.

This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, community dynamics, and Proton's mission to give people back control over their digital lives. You'll own the roadmap and execution for a product that brings privacy-first community experiences to millions of users. The team is small and senior; the scope is large. You’ll turn an ambitious product direction into clear strategy, crisp requirements, shipped experiences, and measurable outcomes.

We're looking for someone who has lived inside community products: who understands how engagement compounds, why moderation decisions shape culture, and how trust is built (and destroyed) at scale. If you've helped build or grow a platform where users interact, organize, and belong, and you want to do it in a way that doesn't exploit the people using it, this is the role.

What You'll Own

  • Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap end-to-end — from first principles through to shipped features — without waiting for direction from above
  • Own the metrics that matter: activation, engagement, retention, and community health. Set the targets, instrument the product to track them, and course-correct fast when signals shift
  • Translate deep knowledge of how online communities work — growth loops, moderation, network effects, content dynamics — into a clear product point of view and a prioritized execution plan
  • Lead cross-functional execution across a team of 6–12 engineers plus design, data, and growth — maintain velocity, surface blockers early, and keep the team focused on outcomes over activity
  • Drive structured discovery: user research, competitive analysis, and direct feedback loops that keep product decisions grounded in real behaviour, not assumptions
  • Represent the product externally when needed — to users, partners, and internal leadership — with clarity and confidence

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on a social, messaging, or community platform
  • Deep understanding of community product mechanics — you can reason clearly about engagement loops, content moderation trade-offs, trust and safety, and network effects without needing it explained
  • Analytically sharp: you define success in numbers, run structured experiments, and make data-informed calls without losing sight of user intuition
  • Strong, direct communicator — you write and speak with precision, push back when something doesn't make sense, and keep stakeholders aligned without over-meeting
  • Proven ability to lead a product autonomously: you identify the right problem, build the case, and drive it to shipped — without a roadmap handed to you

Nice to Have

  • Experience building privacy-respecting alternatives to mainstream social or community platforms
  • Familiarity with open-source community protocols (atproto, IETF MLS, Matrix, etc.)
  • Background scaling a community product from early traction to millions of active users

    Mainstream community platforms often optimize for attention, ads, and control. Proton has a different opportunity: to build community communication around privacy, user agency, and trust. This role is for a PM who understands the mechanics of social and community products, but wants to apply them in a way that respects the people using them.

What We Offer

  • Work that Matters: Millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments.
  • A Great Team: Diverse, collaborative, and tight-knit, with people from MIT, Harvard, Stanford, Caltech, Cambridge, ETH, and more.
  • Technology: The right hardware and software to do your best work.
  • Learning & Development: We invest in your growth. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career — real challenges, real ownership, from day one.
  • Employee Benefits: Strong health coverage, solid retirement options, generous leave, and wellness support.
  • Stock Options: From day one, you have a real stake in what we're building. When Proton wins, you win.
  • In-Person Collaboration: Offices across Geneva, Zürich, Barcelona, London, and more. You'll spend most of your time collaborating face-to-face.
  • Food: Lunch and snacks on us every day in the office.
  • Transport: We cover public transport, bike allowances, or parking — whichever works for you.
  • Flexible Working: You own your schedule. Outcomes matter more than clock-in times.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals — regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background — feel valued and empowered.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position at Proton AG, your information is stored in Greenhouse in accordance with its Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position and may be retained for future roles.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymise it. For questions about your data, contact: Proton does not accept unsolicited CVs from any sources other than directly from candidates.

title: Senior Product Manager - Reconciliation
descriptionHtml:
About us:

BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.

We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.

Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.

Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.

By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.

We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:

  • CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
  • FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
  • Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
  • LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

About this role in the team:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead Reconciliation and Financial Reporting at BVNK.

Your mission is to make sure every movement of money across the BVNK platform, in fiat and in stablecoins, is accounted for, matched and reported correctly. You'll own our internal financial reporting engine and reconciliation platform, and make sure every product we build, including the products we're building with Mastercard, goes live with the right reconciliation and reporting in place.

This is an operations and data-heavy product. You'll work closely with the Reconciliation Operations and Operations Delivery teams to understand where breaks and manual work come from, and turn that into a prioritised backlog. You'll also partner with finance, treasury and compliance, who rely on accurate reconciliation for safeguarding, month-end close and regulatory reporting.

You'll work with engineers across the payments, wallets and ledger teams on the data structures and events that reconciliation depends on, and with small, autonomous engineering squads across BVNK. We see AI as a key lever in how we build, and we expect you to use it in your day-to-day work.

Key Areas of Responsibilities:

  • Own the reconciliation and reporting strategy and roadmap, from how transaction data is captured at source to the reports that finance, operations and regulators rely on.
  • Own BVNK's internal financial reporting engine, including balance, transaction, fee and safeguarding reporting, and make sure it is accurate, timely and auditable.
  • Make sure every new product, currency, payment rail, banking partner and blockchain network is backed by the correct reconciliation and reporting before it launches. Build reconciliation requirements into launch readiness, and work with other PMs so they are planned from the start rather than added afterwards.
  • Work closely with the Reconciliation Operations and Operations Delivery teams to find the root causes of breaks, exceptions and manual workarounds, and build the backlog accordingly.
  • Work with engineers on the payments, wallets and events data structures, so that every transaction carries the identifiers, statuses and metadata needed to match it automatically across internal ledgers, bank and PSP statements, and on-chain activity.
  • Improve the matching engine and exception tooling, including matching rules, break ageing and investigation workflows, and audit trails.
  • Own how external data comes into the platform, such as bank statements (for example camt.053 and MT940), PSP and liquidity provider reports, and blockchain data, along with the data quality controls around it.
  • Partner with finance, treasury, compliance and audit on safeguarding reconciliation, month-end close, and regulatory and audit reporting.
  • Take part in resolving reconciliation and regulatory incidents, including safeguarding incidents. When issues arise, respond quickly, work with Operations, Engineering, Finance and Compliance to find the cause and fix it, and follow up with product changes that stop it happening again.
  • Write clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and see work through to release.
  • Define and track the measures that matter, such as auto-match rate, number and age of open breaks, time to resolve, reporting timeliness and manual effort. Use data to decide what to build next.

What we need from you:

  • Several years of product management experience in payments, banking or fintech, ideally owning reconciliation, ledger, finance or reporting products.
  • Solid technical knowledge. You're comfortable working with engineers on data models, ledgers, event-driven systems, APIs and data pipelines, and you can reason about technical trade-offs without needing to write the code. You're happy to query data yourself using SQL.
  • A good understanding of reconciliation and financial reporting: double-entry accounting, transaction lifecycles, settlement, matching logic and why breaks happen.
  • Experience in operations, or working closely with operations teams. You understand how exceptions and manual processes are handled day to day, and you build products that reduce them. When something goes wrong, you respond quickly and stay calm under pressure.
  • Experience in the payments and/or banking industry, for example with payment schemes such as SEPA, ACH, Faster Payments or SWIFT, bank statement formats, or settlement with banks and PSPs.

title: Senior Product Manager, Technical (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the Company

Affinidi is a technology company dedicated to changing data ownership for good. We empower businesses and individuals with control and ownership of their data, with a comprehensive approach to managing their holistic identity – accounting for all aspects of their digital footprint while ensuring privacy and security.

Affinidi’s technology enables users to benefit from decentralised digital identity solutions. We believe that everyone has the right to own and control their data, and we are committed to creating a trusted digital credentials ecosystem that empowers businesses and individuals to securely exchange data and services across borders and industries.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager (Technical) who wants to help define how trust is built into the next generation of AI systems. At Affinidi, we’re building the Trust Fabric product suite to give AI agents verifiable identity, policy guardrails, and real-time observability, so organisations can move from promising proofs of concept to secure, governed production deployments with confidence. 

This is a role for builders. You’ll work side by side with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into real, high-impact products, fast, iteratively, and with strong product judgment. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t come with a playbook, bring structure to what matters, and help the team move with clarity, speed, and conviction. You’ll also collaborate with deeply engaged teams and senior leaders in an environment that expects high standards, values ownership, and gives you the chance to shape meaningful products from the ground up. 

If you like combining technical depth, product thinking, and execution, you’ll fit right in. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Shape and deliver solutions: Partner closely with engineers to define and refine solutions early, helping move ideas from concept to production in practical, incremental steps while staying close enough to implementation to understand trade-offs and guide decisions. 
  • Drive focused, outcome-oriented delivery:Balance user needs, market context, and execution speed while focusing on getting working solutions into users’ hands for validation, then iterate based on feedback and measurable outcomes. 
  • Work through ambiguity: Take ownership of areas where requirements are not fully defined, structure problems into clear, actionable paths forward, and maintain momentum even as direction continues to evolve. 
  • Own product direction:Contribute to product strategy and roadmap definition, align short-term priorities with longer-term platform thinking, and make thoughtful trade-offs that support both delivery and scalability. 
  • Collaborate across stakeholders: Work across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams, engage effectively with senior and executive stakeholders, and bring alignment and clarity in environments with diverse perspectives. 
  • Be developer-obsessed: Understand developer workflows and key pain points, and help improve integration, usability, and the overall product experience. 

 What we’re looking for 

  • Core experience: You bring 5+ years of experience in Technical Product Management, a strong technical background that lets you engage deeply with engineering topics, hands-on experience working with APIs, systems, and integrations, and a proven track record of delivering products in close collaboration with engineering teams. 
  • Technical depth: You are comfortable understanding how systems are designed and operate in practice, able to engage in technical discussions, challenge assumptions, and evaluate trade-offs, and willing to go into detail when needed by reviewing flows, investigating issues, or clarifying implementation approaches. 
  • Mindset: You take ownership from problem to outcome, are comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving priorities, combine structured thinking with a bias toward action, and can move between big-picture strategy and practical execution. 
  • Collaboration & communication: You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, are comfortable working with experienced, highly engaged stakeholders, and know how to build alignment and drive decisions forward. 
  • Nice to have: It’s a plus if you have had exposure to identity, distributed systems, or similar domains, and experience in fast-paced, product-led environments. 

What you’ll get 

  • A team that values ownership, quality, and speed 
  • Close collaboration between product and engineering 
  • Hybrid working model in Berlin + flexible hours 
  • Unlimited vacation 
  • Competitive compensation 
  • A strong environment to learn, build, and have impact 

Equal Opportunity 

We believe in hiring different and diverse talent and providing a safe space where everyone can share their views without fear, where differences are celebrated, and where no one is left out. Inclusive cultures are the foundation for collaboration and innovation within our team. 

Privacy Notice

By applying for this position, you confirm that you have read and understood Affinidi’s Candidate Privacy Policy, and consent to the collection, use, and disclosure of your personal data for recruitment purposes, as described in the policy.

title: Senior Python Engineer (Full Stack)
descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

We’re looking for a full-stack Python engineer to join our Central Operations team.

Central Ops sits across our core products (Cards, Loans and Motor), focusing on shared operational challenges and opportunities. We build a mix of internally facing web applications and robust automations to help our Operations teams deliver great outcomes for customers, efficiently and at scale.

It’s a broad space: Operations makes up roughly half of our employee headcount and covers everything from day-to-day customer support up to complex areas like Fraud and Fincrime prevention. As our customer base grows rapidly, our role is to help ops keep pace without relying solely on headcount growth. We make intelligent, pragmatic use of AI where it adds real value, working closely with Product, Data Science and Analytics to deploy solutions that genuinely support our ops agents.

You’ll have real ownership from an engineering perspective, shipping features that are used daily by Ops teams. It’s an evolving space at Zable, and what you build will help shape both our tools and our technical direction.

Some examples of things we’ve built recently:

  • Rebuilt our Ops QA admin system from the ground up, replacing an off-the-shelf tool with something tailored to our needs

  • Deployed a pipeline to summarise customer calls into concise notes using LLMs, automatically surfaced in ops admin panels — removing the need for manual note-writing

  • More than doubled the number of complaints processed by agents through a combination of targeted AI automation and improved UX

 

What we’re looking for

We’d consider the following essential to the role:

  • You have 8+ years of professional experience as a software engineer

  • Solid experience with Python in a web application context. You have some experience with web frameworks like FastAPI, Django or Flask. We use FastAPI.

  • Experience with Javascript/Typescript and a modern JS framework such as React, Angular or Vue.js. We generally use React & NextJS. You can build a frontend that's good enough for internal tooling

  • Strong engineering principles & practices: design patterns, testing, clean code and a good reviewer

  • Previous experience working in a product-focused team

  • A keen desire to want to learn and input into a highly collaborative team

  • You use AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, Claude or others in your day-to-day coding

 

The following are also a plus, but by no means essential. If you don’t meet all of these, please apply anyway!

  • Exposure to Domain Driven Design, Message-Driven Systems and Event Sourcing

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS

  • SQL, and finding your way around data schemas

  • Shipping containerised software with Argo, Kubernetes, Docker and Terraform

  • A 30 minute introductory call

  • Take Home Task

  • Technical Interview

  • Cultural/behavioural interview

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

title: Senior Radar Navigation Engineer (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Perception and AI team is responsible for how STARK's unmanned systems perceive their surroundings and know where they are. We are a multidisciplinary group of software and navigation engineers developing perception and navigation algorithms for resource-constrained platforms. As a member of this team, you will collaborate closely with sensor, autonomy and test engineers in a fast-paced, hands-on environment. Together, we make sure our systems navigate and operate reliably in contested environments, even when GNSS is not available.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Radar Navigation Engineer at STARK, you will lead the development of radar-based navigation and mapping: estimating how our systems move and what surrounds them, without relying on GNSS. Your ultimate goal is to deliver motion estimates and 3D maps that our autonomy stack can depend on in the most demanding conditions.


WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

- Develop radar odometry and radar-inertial state estimation for position, velocity and orientation in GNSS-denied environments.
- Build real-time 3D mapping of the surroundings from radar detections and extract the information our autonomy needs for obstacle avoidance.
- Apply SLAM, factor-graph and probabilistic estimation methods within the constraints of embedded, real-time systems.
- Define the measurement interface with our radar signal processing engineers and integrate your work with autonomy, embedded software and test teams.
- Take algorithms from research prototypes to production C++, and analyse field data to characterise performance and failure modes.
- Constantly challenge requirements and take ownership of radar-based navigation as a capability at STARK.


WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

- You have taken state estimation, localization or navigation algorithms into production on real-world robotic, automotive or aerospace systems.
- Deep understanding of state estimation â€” SLAM, Kalman filtering, Bayesian estimation, factor graphs â€” and of 3D geometry, coordinate frames and kinematics.
- Strong C++ for real-time systems; Python or MATLAB for prototyping and analysis.
- Master's degree or PhD in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a comparable field.
- Fluent English; German is a plus.
- Citizenship of a NATO member state.

NICE TO HAVE

- Radar odometry or radar-based mapping; lidar or visual odometry also counts
- GTSAM, Ceres or similar optimization libraries
- Deployment on resource-constrained embedded compute
- Alternative navigation methods and navigation sensor calibration
- ROS2 and experience with field testing

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.

We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over 260 employees spread across 13 countries (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from +190 markets, globally.

Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? 🚀

Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process, and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together:here

Your mission as a (Senior) Research Consultant

We are looking for a (Senior) Research Consultant (m/f/d) with a strong quantitative market research background to join our newly dedicated B2B research team in the DACH region.

This specialized unit focuses on research projects that specifically survey B2B target groups, professional decision-makers, and niche business audiences (rather than only standard B2C consumer panels). You will work closely with leading global strategy and management consultancies as well as major international corporates, supporting high-stakes projects where research needs to be delivered quickly, precisely, and with a clear focus on the business question.

What you’ll be doing

  • End-to-End B2B Project Lead: Manage quantitative research projects end-to-end, including B2B screening design, questionnaire drafting, platform setup, fieldwork monitoring, and data delivery.

Work directly with experienced consultants and senior stakeholders to translate business questions into robust research approaches, advise on sample feasibility and survey methodology, and make pragmatic decisions when timelines are tight.

title: Senior Robot Control Software Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Your tasks

Imagine fleets of autonomous forklifts, each weighing several tons, lifting heavy loads into racks up to 14 meters high, safely and around the clock, right next to people. That's what we build at Jungheinrich Robotics, and AI-assisted engineering plays an important role in how we do it. In this role, you help ensure that every one of these vehicles moves exactly as intended.

We are hiring at both Senior and Staff levels. Apply for the role that fits you best, and we'll find the right fit together!

  • You develop and take ownership of control software components for our autonomous forklifts, from the hardware abstraction layer and actuator control based on ros_control/ros2_control to the interfaces with localization and navigation.
  • You model and implement vehicle kinematics for different forklift types, including acceleration- and jerk-limited motion.
  • You integrate motor controllers, drives, and actuators using fieldbus systems, particularly CANopen.
  • You integrate and calibrate robot sensors, including encoders, IMUs, laser scanners, cameras, and lift height sensors.
  • You improve the reliability of our robots in real-world environments through intelligent error handling, automated recovery mechanisms, and logging and analysis tools.
  • You define and execute integration and system-level tests on real robots, test benches, and in simulation.
  • You use AI-assisted engineering tools in your daily work, from coding and test generation to log analysis.
  • You contribute to technical concepts and the development of our control architecture while supporting less experienced colleagues.

Requirements

  • You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field, or bring equivalent practical experience.
  • You bring at least 4 years of professional experience in robotics software development, including at least 2 years working with real mobile robots.
  • You actively use AI-based tools, such as coding assistants, in your daily work and are eager to explore their potential further.
  • You have a solid understanding of mobile robot kinematics, including acceleration-limited motion, and how localization and navigation interact with the hardware.
  • You bring solid experience with ROS1/ROS2 or comparable middleware, as well as ros_control/ros2_control or similar frameworks.
  • You have experience integrating sensors, actuators, and fieldbus systems, ideally CANopen.
  • You have strong programming skills in C++ and solid knowledge of Python. Experience with Rust is a plus.
  • You are passionate about developing software that enables heavy autonomous vehicles to move smoothly and safely, and want to help shape the future of large robotic fleets in real warehouse environments.
  • You ideally bring in-depth expertise in at least one of the following areas:
    • Safety PLC applications, such as Siemens S7 / TIA Portal Safety, Beckhoff TwinSAFE, or SICK Flexi Soft.
    • Low-level, hardware-related software development, including CAN drivers, PROFINET, timing, and synchronization in sensor networks, ideally combined with microcontroller or embedded systems knowledge.
    • Autonomous software for real robots, such as localization, navigation, and motion planning, combined with an interest in developing deeper expertise in low-level control.
  • You ideally have experience with jerk-limited motion, setting up complete mobile robot software stacks, or intralogistics applications involving automated forklifts, AGVs, or AMRs.
  • You communicate fluently in English and have intermediate German language skills (B1 level or higher).
  • You are willing to work on-site at our Munich location.

What we have to offer

  • Cutting-edge technology: As pioneers in robotics we can navigate and manipulate without rails and guides and offer solutions to processes that no one could automate ever before!
  • Team: We are an international team with more than 25 nationalities. You’ll work in a team with exceptionally smart, humble, collaborative and hardworking individuals.
  • Culture: Come as you are! Join a vibrant, inventive, and diverse team that values collaboration over hierarchy. To innovate you need to fail from time to time — we always learn and improve.
  • Workplace: Our office is located near the S‑Bahn station “Hirschgarten”. We work in a loft-style office with great equipment, our own workshop and testing area.
  • Full Board: You don’t feel like thinking about what you want to have for lunch tomorrow, not to mention preparing it? Luckily, our french cook treats us with a freshly cooked free lunch everyday! And as the cherry on top, there is a packed fridge with drinks, fresh fruits and of course coffee!
  • Flexibility: Flexibility is a top priority for us. Our hybrid working model for positions where presence is dispensable helps to achieve a healthy work-life balance.
  • Benefits: We offer attractive holiday, EGYM, health care, and compensation packages. Learn more about our current benefits here.

Not sure if you meet every single requirement? That's okay. We know that great people don't always tick every box. If you're excited about the opportunity to help shape the future of robotics and believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Your experience may be a great fit for this role or another opportunity at Jungheinrich Robotics.

At Jungheinrich Robotics, where Magazino GmbH found its place, fostering inclusivity is very important to us. We are dedicated to create an inclusive environment for all candidates and provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, national origin, sexual orientation, culture, or education. If you need any reasonable adjustments to make the application process accessible for you, we’ll do our best to accommodate you. Feel free to approach us for that!

title: Senior Sales Engineer - Select UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Sales Engineer for our Enterprise Select business, you'll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting sales in winning new business and expanding existing business, and (2) contributing to the SE Team on the quest of continually raising the bar. There is an expectation that an SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win business. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc.

Additionally, an SE is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team.

This is a remote role, requiring travel up to 75%.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customer's value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Demonstrate the value proposition of Samsara's products and services along with the platform's core capabilities on-site, remotely via webinar sessions, or at field events such as conferences and trade shows.
  • Facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers including hardware installation in and around vehicles and/or equipment ensuring prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform.
  • Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform.
  • Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.
  • Be organized and analytical, and eliminate sales obstacles using creative and adaptive approaches.
  • Demonstrate comfort working for a dynamic technical organization with a fast-growing partner and customer base.
  • Remain highly available to Sales and cross-functional teams, making a measurable impact on Sales and product development in your region, and contributing to SE Team enablement.
  • Be a dynamic contributor on both Sales and SE Team internal communications channels.
  • Partner with account executives to plan, prepare, and execute strategic deals in complex sales cycles.
  • Discover customer processes, needs and pain, translate that understanding to become a welcomed trusted advisor.
  • Successfully match customer pain points and requirements to proposed solutions.
  • Contribute to the team via technical and industry knowledge, training, etc.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles and 3+ years of pre-sales experience
  • Experience with Enterprise sales cycles or equivalent
  • Consistent track record selling complex solutions
  • Clinical execution of discovery, through to POV, and technical win.
  • Understand and appreciate value selling, and MEDDICC.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Previous hands-on experience with customer evaluations and deployments
  • Well-versed in one of the following: cloud software, IOT, networking, automation, and control systems
  • Experience with integration projects. At minimum comprehend RESTFul APIs. A plus for scripting (Python, javascript, etc.) experience
  • IoT, hardware gadgets, vehicles, or general tinkering experience (work or hobby) a plus
  • Experience working with Fleet, Logistics, Supply Chain, Telematics, Manufacturing, or general operations background a plus

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. title: Senior Software Engineer, Agents
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations.

  • Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules, while we provide the compute, infrastructure, and collaboration layer so their scientists can move faster.

The two feed each other: open-source adoption earns scientific credibility and community insight, and Boltz Lab turns that into real impact on our partners' discovery programs.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

About the role

As a Software Engineer on Agents, you will own the design agents inside Boltz Lab: the agentic workflows that take a scientist from a target and a hypothesis to a ranked set of candidate molecules. Our goal is that scientists can set up, run, review and export protein design and small-molecule design work on their own, and agents are how much of that happens.

You will work closely with our product engineers and Product Designer, our research teams and Research Engineering, who build agent workflows on the research side, and our scientists who use the product every day.

This role is ideal for an engineer who has shipped agent-powered products to real users, knows how they fail, and cares about making them reliable and trustworthy.

What you'll do

  • Build and ship agentic design workflows in Boltz Lab, for protein design and small-molecule lead optimization.

  • Design the agent runtime around them: tool calling over our models and pipelines, long-running jobs, state, retries and cost control.

  • Make agent behavior visible and trustworthy to scientists: what the agent did, why, and how confident it is.

  • Take research agent workflows to production quickly, as part of getting new models, filters and pipelines from research into the product in under a day.

  • Build evaluations and monitoring for agents in production, and feed what you learn back to Research and Product.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • Senior or Staff-level software engineering experience, with strong Python and/or TypeScript.

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM agent products or agentic workflows to real users.

  • Solid backend and distributed-systems fundamentals: APIs, queues, long-running jobs, failure handling and observability.

  • A track record of owning features end to end, from design through launch and iteration.

  • Close collaboration with designers, researchers and scientists, and clear communication of trade-offs.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience evaluating agents (offline evals, production monitoring) and with current agent frameworks and model APIs.

  • Exposure to computational biology, chemistry or other scientific domains; early-stage startup experience.

  • Experience using Boltz models, or open-source contributions to agent tooling.

We know great people don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you meet most of the minimum requirements, we'd like to hear from you.

What we offer

  • Own the agents that leading discovery teams use to design new medicines in Boltz Lab.

  • Work alongside one of the most talent-dense teams in the field.

  • Significant ownership and independence, with responsibility for driving projects from concept to deployment.

  • Highly competitive salary with meaningful equity in a public benefit company.

  • Benefits:

    • 25 days plus bank holidays a year

    • Annual team offsite trip

    • Private healthcare (BUPA), covering pre-existing conditions

    • Pension program

    • Paid parental leave

    • Wellhub gym membership

    • Free lunch every day

    • Travel expenses

How we hire

  1. Initial screen with a member of the Talent team

  2. Agentic system design interview

  3. Onsite in London or virtual onsite with the team

  4. Offer + Onboarding

Our commitment

Boltz is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, tell us at [email] and we'll make it work.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Non-Realtime Controllers
descriptionHtml:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: Oxford, UK
Office commitment: Hybrid

The Role:

Quantum is now, and it's built here. Oxford Ionics, now part of IonQ, is pioneering the next generation of quantum computing. Using our world-leading trapped-ion technology, we're building the most powerful, accurate and reliable quantum systems to tackle problems that today's supercomputers cannot solve.

We're looking for an enthusiastic and highly technical Senior Software Engineer for our non-realtime controllers team who will thrive in our dynamic cross-disciplinary environment. You will be working closely with our skilled software engineers, our systems teams who operate the physical quantum computers, and our world-leading quantum scientists to build and operate the software that controls the hardware surrounding our quantum computers. Previous exposure to quantum systems is not required.

You will own areas of the hardware control surface end to end, from the device protocol up to a service running reliably across our fleet. This is a hands-on engineering role and stays that way as you grow.

A working quantum computer is far more than the ion trap and its real-time control electronics. It depends on a fleet of supporting hardware, including cryogenic compressors, vacuum pumps, power supplies, lasers, temperature controllers, wavemeters and cameras, that has to be kept observable, controllable and reliable. The timing-critical operations such as gate waveforms and ion transport run on dedicated real-time FPGA systems, while this team owns everything that does not need hard timing guarantees. These services run on general-purpose Linux hardware and must be rock-solid, because a failed compressor or an un-noticed pressure drift takes a whole machine offline.

Responsibilities:

This is a hands-on engineering role, balancing delivery of your own areas with support for the teams and scientists who depend on them.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Own a group of device controllers end to end, covering API design, implementation, rollout and ongoing operational health.
  • Make services robust against the ways real instruments fail.
  • Bring devices onto our current framework, and roll the result out across the fleet without disrupting running experiments.
  • Improve the shared framework where a problem turns out to be common to many controllers rather than specific to one.
  • Work closely with the systems teams and scientists who depend on these services, and strengthen observability, health checking and alerting.
  • Raise the standard of the code around you through review, and bring less experienced engineers on by working alongside them.

Requirements:

To be successful, you will need experience working with Linux based systems and interfacing with hardware, and a track record of making software behave well against unreliable external dependencies. We're looking for someone who can own a problem area with little supervision and judge where robustness is worth the effort.

You’d be a great fit with:

  • Strong systems engineering skills. Our controllers are written in Rust, so either solid Rust experience or deep proficiency in another systems language and the appetite to work in a Rust codebase, including async programming.
  • Experience designing and operating networked services such as gRPC or REST, with a real grasp of error handling, observability and failure modes.
  • Experience of hardware and instrument protocols and interfaces such as SCPI, Modbus, serial and Ethernet.
  • Comfortable owning the production behaviour of what you build, not just its correctness in test.
  • Excellent communication skills both within software and across disciplines, and an interest in helping other engineers get better at the craft without wanting to stop building yourself.

Benefits

Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of quantum. We offer more than just a role, you’ll join a world class community of scientists, engineers and innovators working to unlock the full potential of quantum computing.

We offer a range of benefits, including opportunities to further your career alongside industry leaders, a competitive salary with IonQ stock options, an annual performance bonus, generous annual leave, flexible hybrid working, private medical and dental insurance for you and your family, and much more.

Join us and be part of the future of quantum computing.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.
