title: Senior Software Engineer - Security
descriptionHtml:
What You'll Do

As a Senior Software Engineer - Security, you will design, build, and operate the security capabilities that protect Radiant's cloud platform and infrastructure.

You'll work across identity, access control, secrets, network security, platform hardening, auditability, and compliance controls. You'll partner closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, networking, security, and compliance teams, and with customers on their most demanding security requirements.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on making security embedded, scalable, automated, and easy to consume across the platform. You'll own significant security services from design through production, working alongside our Principal Engineers on their architecture.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and own security services and platform capabilities, and contribute to their architecture and technical designs.

  • Build core security services across IAM, RBAC, workload identity, secrets, encryption and key management, audit logging, network controls, and policy enforcement.

  • Turn product, customer, and regulatory requirements into well-designed APIs and implementations, working with the Security Product Manager and Principal Engineers.

  • Automate policy enforcement, configuration hardening, detection, remediation, and software supply chain security.

  • Implement strong tenant isolation and least-privilege access across the control plane and network and data plane.

  • Support enterprise customer security reviews, audits, and incident response.

  • Contribute to security engineering standards through code review, and support less experienced engineers.

 

Your Profile

  • Strong hands-on engineering skills in one or more systems languages such as Go or similar.

  • Solid experience building and operating distributed systems, with depth in cloud and network security, IAM, or security infrastructure.

  • Experience owning significant components end to end, from design through production and operation.

  • Strong technical knowledge across several of:

  • Identity & access: IAM, RBAC/ABAC, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SSO, federation, mTLS, workload and service identity

  • Security controls: applied cryptography, encryption at rest and in transit, secrets management, KMS/HSM, key rotation, policy engines

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes internals, containers and runtime isolation, cloud networking, compute, storage

  • Security operations: audit logging pipelines, detection engineering, vulnerability management, incident response

  • Automation: policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD security, software supply chain (signing, SBOMs, provenance)

  • Experience with technologies such as Vault, OPA/Gatekeeper, SPIFFE/SPIRE, Kubernetes admission control and security tooling, Sigstore, SIEM platforms, cloud KMS, or similar.

  • Good understanding of multi-tenancy, least privilege, zero-trust architecture, threat modelling, and shared-responsibility models.

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001, and how they translate into technical controls.

  • Able to balance security, performance, reliability, operational complexity, and developer experience.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including design documents and explaining trade-offs to your team and stakeholders.

 

What You Bring

  • Security mindset: Think like an attacker and design systems that fail safely, without making them painful to use.

  • Engineering excellence: Write well-tested, maintainable code and give thoughtful code reviews.

  • Sound judgement: Make careful design decisions on systems that are hard to change once built.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Principal Engineers, product, SRE, and other teams, and help the engineers around you grow.

  • Systems thinking: Understand how controls interact across the full cloud platform, from network and infrastructure up to APIs and user experience.

  • Ownership: Drive security capabilities from design through production, operation, and continuous improvement.

 

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

 

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (two Senior Engineers) → Final.

 

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

About the Advanced Technology Group 

The Advanced Technology Group (ATG) is a part of Foundational Systems and Experiences Engineering (FSEE) within the Platform Business Group. Established over 20 years ago as part of PlayStation®’s first-party game development studios, ATG has always focused on helping game developers get the most out of PlayStation® hardware - a mission that continues to this day. As a team, we are responsible for large parts of the graphics software stack used by all PlayStation® games, and collaborate with leading engineering teams worldwide, from game developers to hardware vendors, to deliver key platform technologies. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • You will be working on the current and future rendering APIs used by PlayStation games, as well as the hardware underpinning them. 
  • You will design and implement features that enable efficient game development, push GPU programming forward, and create a healthy platform. 
  • You will observe industry trends, understanding of – and empathy for – our customers, and business needs as the foundation of your decision making. 
  • You will help shape the path of the PlayStation graphics stack going forward. 
  • You will collaborate with the platform software and hardware teams, as well as game developers. 
  • You will often take the role as the game-developer advocate when working with the platform teams, or the role as the platform-team advocate when working with game developers. 

This is a senior position at the core of PlayStation GPU technology with an unusual degree of influence on future of console graphics-programming. ATG is granted a high degree of trust and autonomy in shaping the graphics software stack and we are looking for people who are passionate about carrying this forward. You will not be spending your time in committee meetings or writing endless proposals, this is very much an engineering role where your primary role is to determine what needs to be implemented, how best to implement it and to then sit down, code, debug. We believe that this practical focus is crucial in building up the skill, experience, and insight required to make the large-scale and long-term decisions we have been entrusted with. 

What we are looking for 

  • Experience and interest in low-level graphics architecture and engineering. 
  • Experience writing rendering code on top of multiple existing rendering APIs. 
  • Experience writing rendering code on console. 
  • The ability to keep an eye on the big picture, even when deep in the weeds. 
  • An eagerness to learn and to take responsibility for the long run.

You will take technical ownership at the intersection of Systems Engineering, R&D, Production and Industrialization. Rather than leading a team from a disciplinary perspective, you will act as a senior technical expert and sparring partner, helping establish robust processes, solve complex system-level issues and continuously improve the maturity of our products and production environment.

The role offers a high degree of ownership in an environment where structures and processes are still evolving and where your expertise can have a direct impact on how we industrialize our systems.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Take technical ownership of system-level topics throughout the industrialization lifecycle.

  • Analyze and resolve complex technical issues arising during production, integration, testing and operation.

  • Identify whether technical issues originate from product design, system integration, manufacturing processes or individual components and drive them toward sustainable resolution.

  • Define and continuously improve technical processes, standards and methodologies for industrialization and system integration.

  • Work closely with Systems Engineering, R&D, Production, Quality, Testing and Supply Chain to ensure product and production readiness.

  • Translate lessons learned from production and field feedback into concrete technical improvements.

  • Support root cause analysis and structured problem solving for recurring or critical system-level issues.

  • Ensure that system requirements, interfaces and technical dependencies are understood and adequately reflected in the production environment.

  • Act as a senior technical sparring partner for engineers and stakeholders across different disciplines.

  • Mentor colleagues through your technical expertise and help establish best practices without formal disciplinary leadership responsibility.

  • Contribute to building scalable structures as products and production volumes continue to grow.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Mindpeak is a Hamburg-based AI company on a mission to make cancer diagnosis more accurate, efficient and personalized.

We build deep-learning solutions for computational pathology that bring AI directly into clinical practice. Our technology is already used in routine diagnostics across more than 25 countries and supports leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies in developing and advancing new cancer treatments.

What makes Mindpeak special is the combination of disciplines required to make this work. Software engineers and machine learning experts work alongside pathologists, scientists, product specialists and commercial teams to turn cutting-edge AI into products that deliver real value in healthcare.

This also makes building our team unusually interesting. Many of the people we hire sit at the intersection of different disciplines and are difficult to find through conventional recruiting. Identifying exceptional talent, understanding what great looks like and building hiring processes that allow us to make consistently strong decisions are therefore critical to Mindpeak’s next stage of growth.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager to take ownership of recruiting across Mindpeak.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys recruiting and sees Talent Acquisition itself as their profession.

You will recruit across different functions, with a particular focus on senior, business-critical and hard-to-fill roles spanning Product, Technology and Business. You will work closely with our founders and hiring managers to define what we actually need, identify what great looks like for each role and translate this into rigorous, efficient hiring processes.

This is a hands-on recruiting role, not a generalist People & Culture or Organizational Development position. You will personally run critical searches, source candidates, conduct interviews and close hires. At the same time, we expect you to help raise the quality of hiring across Mindpeak by challenging unclear requirements, improving interview practices and bringing structure and discipline to how we make hiring decisions.

You will not inherit a recruiting team, but you will have the mandate and budget to work with external recruiters and specialist search partners where they add value.

Your Mission

  • Own the full recruiting cycle: from search strategy, sourcing and screening through interviews, offers and closing.

  • Partner with our CEO and hiring managers as a trusted talent advisor: clarify requirements, challenge assumptionsand drive decisions forward.

  • Proactively identify and engage high-quality candidates, particularly for senior, leadership and hard-to-fill roles.

  • Run high-quality interviews that go beyond CVs and polished answers, uncovering concrete evidence of impact, decision-making and individual contribution.

  • Select, brief and actively manage external recruiters and search partners where they add value.

  • Keep pipelines, bottlenecks and risks transparent for leadership, and keep improving how Mindpeak hires without unnecessary bureaucracy.

What Success Looks Like

  • Priority searches run with clear role profiles and explicit assessment criteria, even when requirements start out ambiguous.

  • You successfully engage high-quality passive candidates and build genuine interest in Mindpeak and our roles.

  • Interviews across Mindpeak become more rigorous and consistent, based on evidence rather than titles or impressions.

  • Most importantly, critical roles get closed with people who raise the quality of the organisation.

Your Experience

  • Substantial hands-on experience owning full-cycle recruiting; a background in executive search or another environment with a strong sourcing and assessment culture is a plus.

  • Proven track record of closing senior, leadership and hard-to-fill searches, with strong active sourcing skills and confidence approaching passive candidates.

  • Experience in a technology-driven, high-growth environment, recruiting across functions such as Product, Technology and Business. You don't need to be technical, but you understand how these teams work well enough to recruit credibly.

  • Experience working directly with founders or demanding senior hiring managers and influencing their decisions rather than simply executing requirements.

  • Experience translating unclear business needs into clear role profiles, scorecards and structured interview processes.

  • Experience selecting and managing external agencies or headhunters.

  • Fluent English and German (at least C2 level)

Your Profile

  • You interview for evidence and have strong talent judgment. You can tell an impressive CV or polished answer from real evidence that someone will succeed.

  • You know what good looks like and can credibly bring that standard into an organisation still developing its own.

  • You challenge senior stakeholders constructively and communicate clearly and directly with executives, hiring managers and senior candidates alike.

  • You take ownership. When a search isn't working, you diagnose why and change the approach, and you know when requirements need to change.

  • You create structure without bureaucracy, just enough process to improve speed, quality and accountability.

  • You learn quickly and immerse yourself in unfamiliar domains until you can recruit credibly in them.

Why Mindpeak

  • Take real ownership of Talent Acquisition in a growing AI company where hiring exceptional people has a direct impact on the success of the business.

  • Recruit across some of the most interesting talent markets today – from AI and software engineering to medicine, science and commercial roles.

  • Work directly with our founders and senior leaders Shape and continuously improve how we identify, assess and hire exceptional people rather than simply executing a fixed corporate recruiting process.

  • See the impact of the teams you build on cancer diagnostics and treatment.

  • Work from our centrally located Hamburg office with a beautiful view over the harbor.

Application Details

Please send us:

  • Your CV and reference letters

  • Your salary expectations

  • Your earliest possible starting date

Note: Direct applicants only. We do not work with recruiting agencies for this position.

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Working at CreateFuture

CreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team:

CreateFuture is looking for a collaborative, technically grounded Senior Business Analyst to join our team.

Our Senior Business Analysts drive high-impact change across a broad spectrum of client engagements. While we deliver end-to-end digital products, this role is tailored for a BA who is as comfortable driving complex back-end environments (such as API integrations, platform migrations, data architecture, and system integration logic) as they are crafting front-end user experiences and feature specifications.

You’ll leverage your proficiency in business analysis, system architecture, and product strategy to guide project development, acting as the crucial bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders. Your responsibilities span meticulous requirements analysis, data flow mapping, estimation, and championing delivery best practices within your team.

Your exceptional communication skills are pivotal for translating complex client objectives into clear, developer-ready specifications and data flows, ensuring what we build is both valuable for users and technically robust under the hood.

Does this sound like you? Do you have a passion for the craft of Business Analysis, a natural curiosity for how complex backend systems work, and an interest in how modern tools are changing how we work? If so, we’d love to talk to you.

What you'll be doing:

  • Evaluate current and emerging business procedures, collaborating with clients and internal teams to propose impactful system solutions and process improvements.
  • Proactively bring cross-functional teams together to shape user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and technical specifications (including API contracts, payload logic, and data mappings).
  • Facilitate data analysis, query system data to uncover edge cases, and map complex integration dependencies across backend architecture.
  • Manage project backlogs during discovery, build, and run phases, balancing business priorities against technical constraints, non-functional requirements (NFRs), and engineering effort.
  • Support and lead client discovery conversations, driving estimation efforts, facilitating workshops, and championing best practices across your project team.

We'd love to talk to you if you have: 

  • Proven experience delivering both product-led user initiatives and complex technical projects (e.g., API integrations, platform migrations, data architecture).
  • Experience working for a Consultancy or Client facing environment
  • Strong experience as a Technical Business Analyst working closely with engineering, architecture and product teams.
  • Experience working with data, including data mapping, data models, databases and ideally SQL.
  • A strong track record of working alongside engineering teams to analyse data flows, system logic, and technical dependencies.
  • A user-centric mindset that ensures backend architectural choices directly support a seamless end-user experience.
  • Proven ability to bridge the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of business context and translating complex goals into clear. specifications.
  • Bring meticulous requirements analysis, lead estimation efforts, and champion best practices across your project team.

    Bonus points if you have:

    • Experimented with AI tools to accelerate research, draft baseline specifications, map data fields, or red-team edge cases in system flows.
    • Exposure to or curiosity about how modern AI capabilities, LLMs, or agentic workflows integrate into backend system architectures.
    • A proactive approach to exploring new tools and techniques that improve the speed and quality of business analysis, with a desire to share those learnings with colleagues.

    You don’t need to arrive as an AI expert. If you haven’t yet had much opportunity to put AI into practice in your BA work, that shouldn’t stop you from applying. What matters to us is curiosity, a willingness to experiment, and a commitment to high-quality analysis. Everyone at CreateFuture undertakes AI-native training, and we’ll support you to build these capabilities and put them into practice.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 
  • Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

title: Senior Video Creative, Performance - Kraken Consumer
descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

  

The opportunity

As our Senior Performance Video Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid video for Kraken and Krak. You ideate, generate, edit and ship, and you treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and speed leadership: you set the bar for paid video on the team, work with AI-enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with video questions.

 

  • Own paid video for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

  • Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform’s specs and native feel.

  • Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets.

  • Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn’t. Keep your tooling current as the models change, and build repeatable workflows the rest of the team can reuse.

  • Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, including experimental ones alongside BAU work, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

  • Version and localize video at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you’ll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

  • Build creative with testing in mind. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.

  • Flex into AI-assisted paid static when a campaign calls for it, working from the team’s brand baselines.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

  • Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

  

What you bring

  • 5+ years in performance video creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

  • A portfolio submitted with your application. Paid video above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you’re able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.

  • Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.

  • High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.

  • Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

  • Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You’re fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.

  • Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic instincts and a feel for what’s about to feel dated.

  • Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

  • Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with work that survives risk warnings, disclaimers and market-specific requirements.

  • A solid copywriting instinct for scripts and on-screen text. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

title: Signal Processing Engineer (Radar)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a confirmed Radar Signal Processing Engineer on Harmattan AI's Radar team in Paris, you will own the signal processing algorithms behind our next-generation airborne radar payload. You will take full ownership of your workstream, from algorithmic research through embedded implementation and flight validation, working with high autonomy and minimal oversight. You will work closely with the EW and RF analytics teams to translate product-level requirements into deployed, mission-ready capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement near-real-time algorithms for radar image formation, including inverse SAR (ISAR) processing of moving targets.

  • Develop and refine detection and tracking algorithms (e.g., EKF/UKF-based approaches) for moving target indication on airborne radar data.

  • Build jamming estimation capabilities, combining out-of-band spectral sniffing with in-band spatial covariance analysis, and the adaptive logic that drives radar behavior in response.

  • Contribute radar-derived observables and algorithms that support navigation when GNSS is unavailable.

  • Prototype and port algorithms onto the selected embedded computing platform, balancing algorithmic performance against real-time and resource constraints.

  • Validate algorithms end-to-end through hardware-in-the-loop bench testing, anechoic chamber campaigns, and real flight conditions, iterating quickly on results.

  • Work closely with the EW and RF analytics modules to align signal processing development with system-level requirements.

Candidate Requirements

  • 2 to 5 years of confirmed, hands-on experience in radar signal processing, gained in the defense or automotive radar industry preferably.

  • Solid experience in Signal Processing on radar systems, either FMCW or pulsed, is required; exposure to moving target tracking, ECCM, radar-based navigation, or live/real-time processing is a strong plus.

  • Strong theoretical foundations and genuine hands-on comfort with the underlying mathematics, not reliance on off-the-shelf tools or LLM-generated solutions.

  • A quick thinker, comfortable taking full ownership of a technical scope end-to-end with minimal oversight.

  • Comfortable working in a fast, iterative cycle: writing code, running hardware-in-the-loop tests, and pushing validated changes independently.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Signal AI, we use cutting-edge AI technology to offer clarity on decisions that shape businesses and society. We value restless curiosity, creative thinking, and diverse perspectives as we strive to become AI-native. We believe that AI is a collaborator, not just a tool, and we invite passionate individuals to join us on our journey as we continue to learn, experiment, and grow together.

We're hiring a Senior SRE to help us run and evolve the infrastructure behind Signal AI's decision intelligence platform.

You'd be joining a small, collaborative Infrastructure team at a moment when the work is genuinely changing shape. Over the last year, we've hardened the platform, reduced cost, and built serious observability into our highest-volume systems. The next year is about scaling that work, absorbing infrastructure from a recent acquisition, and being thoughtful about how AI shows up in operational work: not as a gimmick, but as a tool we trust ourselves to use well.

We're looking for someone who wants to shape the team's direction; someone people can rely on for tricky or urgent problems; someone who brings curiosity and care to the work; and someone who wants to leave things meaningfully better than they found them.

What we've shipped recently

  • Cut ~$50k/year off our Elasticsearch bill by migrating compute to more efficient chips. (Apr 2026)

  • Built the foundation for our MCP server platform: leveraging and contributing to open-source tooling to give the whole company extensible, production-grade AI integrations. (2025–2026)

  • Rebuilt production from scratch in a full DR game day. End-to-end restore validated across our multi-account AWS setup. (Jan 2026)

What we're working on next

  • AI-augmented operations: Claude Enterprise is deployed across Signal. We want this team to help define what good looks like for SRE: incident triage, runbook generation, capacity planning, cost analysis. This is a strategic investment, not a side project, and we'd love someone genuinely curious about what these tools can and can't do.

  • Security in the age of AI: The threat landscape has shifted. Supply chain security is more at threat than ever, and powerful models are emerging that promise to change how the industry thinks about security. We're looking for someone interested in thinking seriously about what actually matters to protect now.

  • Acquisition integration: Bringing a recently acquired product's infrastructure under our reliability, security, and operational standards. A substantial, multi-quarter piece of work with real technical and organisational complexity, and plenty of room to make your mark.

  • Batch workload consolidation: Moving disparate batch jobs onto EKS for unified scheduling, cost visibility, and operational tooling.

Your first six months

We want to set you up to thrive. Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Month 1: You're onboarded across our AWS estate, Terraform, and observability stack. You've completed your first on-call shift with team support, landed your first PR in the DevOps repo, and started working Claude Enterprise into your daily flow.

  • Month 3: You're owning a workstream end-to-end. You've led the SRE response to at least one production incident and hosted your first post-mortem. You've surfaced a real opportunity and pushed it to a measurable result.

  • Month 6: You're driving a multi-quarter workstream with clear direction, coaching less experienced teammates along the way, and contributing insights to our AI-in-operations playbook: including where Claude adds real leverage and where it doesn't.

What we're looking for

You have solid AWS and Terraform experience, and you're comfortable writing Python or Go to solve operational problems. You think in distributed systems: failure modes, observability, blast radius: and you take problems end-to-end rather than stopping at the edges of your own work.

When a problem is complex, you can lay out a few ways to solve it, weigh the trade-offs, and recommend the one that meets our needs now without sacrificing tomorrow. You take personal ownership of customer-impacting issues in the systems you look after.

You communicate openly and you're comfortable pushing back when you think something could be better. You give clear, actionable feedback and you enjoy helping others level up.

You're pragmatic about AI tooling. Not evangelical, not dismissive. You can tell us when you'd reach for an LLM and when you wouldn't, and you'd have a clear reason either way.

We know not every strong candidate will have every skill on this list. If you're excited about the work and you're close on the experience, we'd encourage you to apply.

title: Software Engineer (gn) @ Industrial AI Venture, Berlin
descriptionHtml:
This is an Atlantic portfolio company.

About Marentis

Marentis develops AI-supported software for manufacturing, robotics and complex automated machinery. We turn machine data and operational information into useful knowledge for troubleshooting, decision-making and automation. Our work connects sensor measurements, machine and robot states, quality data, alarms and expert knowledge. These problems require understanding both the data and its context: a fault may originate elsewhere in a production line, and similar symptoms can have different causes. We are a small, early-stage startup where individual contributions directly shape the product. We value curiosity, initiative and people who enjoy understanding difficult problems and making things work.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Software Engineer with strong Python skills and sound technical judgment. You will own backend features from problem definition through implementation, testing, deployment and maintenance.

After onboarding, you should be able to investigate unfamiliar production code and independently review Python/backend pull requests: understand intended behavior, question assumptions, assess tests and failure paths, and identify effects on the wider system.

We actively encourage AI-assisted development. You remain responsible for understanding, verifying and maintaining the resulting software. We value demonstrated delivery, ownership and learning ability more than a fixed number of years in the industry.

What You Will Do

  • Build backend services, APIs and SQL-backed data pipelines for industrial analytics, knowledge retrieval and agent workflows.

  • Read and improve existing code, review pull requests, and make informed decisions about interfaces, data models, state and failure handling.

  • Design meaningful unit, integration and end-to-end tests, supported by continuous integration.

  • Test with representative machine data, recorded streams and simulated device inputs, including missing measurements, duplicate or out-of-order events, invalid values and connection failures.

  • Reproduce bugs, inspect whether test assertions verify the intended behavior, and add useful regression coverage.

  • Understand manufacturing users and equipment, contribute across integration and deployment, and communicate trade-offs and blockers early.

What You Bring

  • Strong practical Python and backend engineering skills, supported by software you personally shipped and maintained.

  • Independent code-review ability: you can investigate a change, assess correctness, maintainability and security, and justify whether it is ready to merge.

  • Practical system-design judgment across APIs, SQL, database design, data validation, state management and concurrency where relevant.

  • Strong testing and debugging skills: you choose useful test boundaries, construct representative data and investigate failures.

  • Experience making imperfect operational, machine, sensor or similarly complex data trustworthy, with an interest in its industrial meaning and consequences.

  • Resourcefulness: you learn unfamiliar code and technologies through documentation, small experiments, focused questions and feedback.

  • Clear written and spoken English, constructive collaboration and reliable follow-through.

We welcome different educational and professional paths. Direct manufacturing experience is especially useful; equivalent engineering depth from adjacent domains is also relevant.

Particularly Relevant Experience

Bring depth in one or more of these areas; expertise in all of them is not expected.

  • Machine data, analytics and machine learning: Time-series or sensor-data processing, curation, feature engineering, anomaly detection, condition monitoring or quality prediction. Explain how you handled timestamps, units, asset identity and data quality, and evaluated whether the result was useful.

  • Knowledge graphs and retrieval: Entity and relationship modeling, graph or relational database design, provenance, versioning and conflicting information. Experience combining identifiers, aliases, lexical search and semantic retrieval, with evaluations of relevance and applicability.

  • Agent systems and workflows: LLM tools, multi-agent coordination, orchestration, context and memory management, validation and failure recovery. Show how you evaluated quality, cost and latency, enforced permissions and chose appropriate execution boundaries.

  • Industrial integration, robotics and automation: Connecting software with production equipment, robot cells or automated machinery through telemetry, device interfaces or protocols such as MQTT and OPC UA. Experience with simulators, physical-device testing and equipment-specific behavior is valuable.

  • Cloud deployment, containerization, observability and operating software across customer environments are also useful.

title: Software Provisioning and E/E Vehicle Integration Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Join Quantum-Systems and keep our autonomous ground vehicles on the latest software, every day. You flash, update, and bring up our prototypes (Mandrill UGV and autonomous trucks), find out why something does not work, and make sure it works next time without you. You work AI native: you let agentic tools write the scripts that turn manual steps into one command.

Why this role matters? A prototype is only as good as the software running on it. You make sure our engineers test the latest version, on a vehicle that works, with data that explains what happened.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

Provision Software and Firmware

  • Flash new software releases and firmware onto vehicle computers, ECUs, sensors, and radios; verify the result and roll back safely when needed.

  • Keep a clean record of which vehicle runs which software, firmware, and configuration.

  • Turn manual provisioning into repeatable, scripted, documented procedures.

Integrate and Troubleshoot the E/E System

  • Bring up and commission compute, ECUs, sensors, and vehicle networks (CAN / CAN FD, automotive Ethernet).

  • Find faults systematically across hardware, wiring, network, and software, using multimeter, oscilloscope, and bus tools.

  • Support sensor swaps, harness changes, and upfits on prototype vehicles.

Pull Logs and Find Root Causes

  • Collect logs, traces, and recordings from the vehicle, work through them, and isolate the root cause.

descriptionHtml:
Orcrist is building a next generation data intelligence platform using cutting-edge technologies. We're handling petabyte-scale data with sub-second queries. Our product is a Kubernetes‑based platform delivered as B2B SaaS or as a self‑hosted on‑prem solution, including air‑gapped deployments. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.

Role

We're looking for a hands-on Solution Architect to join our GovDev team. You are the technical counterpart to our customers in the public sector, defence and intelligence space: you run the technical dialogue with incoming leads, turn their requirements into
working prototypes on our platform, and hand what survives over to Product & Engineering in a state they can build on.

This is not a pre-sales or slideware role. Roughly half of your time you build: integrating customer data sources into our platform, wiring up pipelines on our data fabric (ODFF), and shipping demo-grade frontends. The other half you spend with customers and our product teams, making sure what we promise is what the platform can do, and what the platform can't do yet lands on the roadmap.

What you'll do

  • Act as technical lead on incoming opportunities: run discovery calls, qualify technical fit against the platform's current state, answer architecture, integration and security
    questions, and own the technical part of pitches, demos and workshops.
  • Build prototypes yourself: ingest a customer's data (files, APIs, message exports, sensor feeds, geodata) through our ingest layer, model it into our universal record and
    entity schema, and expose it in the platform frontend or a purpose-built demo UI.
  • Design integration architectures for customer environments: on-premise and air-gapped Kubernetes deployments, identity (OIDC/Keycloak, Kerberos/Ranger), connections to legacy systems and interfaces common in government and military IT.
  • Lead technical deep dives with customer architects and IT security: platform architecture, data flow, lineage, classification handling, deployment options.
  • Hand over won opportunities to the owning Product & Engineering team: architecture decision records, integration docs, data model, open gaps, customer context. 
  • Feed platform gaps and friction found during prototyping back to the product teams as concrete tickets and RFC input.
  • Represent the voice of the market to Product: cluster recurring requirements across leads and bring them into roadmap and OKR discussions.
  • Maintain reusable demo assets: reference prototypes, scenario data sets, architecture diagrams, integration guides, technical FAQ.

About you

  • 5+ years in software or data engineering, of which at least 1-2 in a customer-facing technical role (like solution architect, forward deployed engineer, technical consultant with delivery responsibility).
  • You write production-quality code today, in Python and TypeScript or a comparable combination, and can show prototypes or systems you built end to end.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed data pipelines (Spark, Kafka or equivalent) and with integrating heterogeneous data sources: files, APIs, databases, message streams.
  • Experience deploying and operating software on Kubernetes, including on-premise or restricted environments.
  • Comfortable leading technical discussions with customer architects, IT security and executives, in German and in English (C1+).

Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The Role

We’re hiring Solutions Engineers to build Synthesia’s pre-sales function for the DACH region. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model. If you’re someone who is excited by building whilst scaling, we’d love to hear from you.

As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product.

This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across DACH.

What You'll Do

  • Co-plan and support discovery calls with your AE to understand customer requirements, technical environment, and business challenges.

  • Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia's business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, building Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product.

  • Build and maintain strong working knowledge of Synthesia's platform capabilities, roadmap, and positioning across all product lines, so you can speak to the use cases that drive value

  • Deliver demonstrations that speak to customer problems and tell a credible story of why Synthesia is the right solution.

  • Identify technical objections and integration questions as they come up, working with your AE and the broader ecosystem to find a path forward.

  • Contribute your assessment of technical fit and opportunity risk to help your AE shape account and deal strategy.

  • Keep your deal team and manager informed on deal status, timeline, and technical dependencies.

  • Identify, build relationships with, and actively enable technical champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally.

  • Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities, API and SDK integrations, security, compliance topics (SOC 2, GDPR, enterprise identity), and scalability for global deployments, troubleshooting issues and validating integrations with LMS, HCM, and content systems as they surface.

  • Partner with Enablement to complete certifications, stay current on new releases, and keep your demo and objection-handling skills sharp.

     

We’d love to hear from you if you have

  • 2+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical experience in a SaaS environment (or equivalent technical customer-facing experience).

  • Delivers a strong standard demo aligned to the discovery points and agenda set with the AE, with a solid grasp of core demo technique (e.g., Tell-Show-Tell).

  • Applies established solution designs and best practices to the customer's use case, working with core ecosystem functions (Product, Customer Success) as the deal requires.

  • Identifies and surfaces deal risk and next steps based on what the customer tells you, escalating clearly to your AE so it gets actioned.

  • Working knowledge of MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and can articulate why Synthesia is a fit for the prospect.

  • Resourceful: knows how to find the right person or tool internally, and is building their own network across the GTM organization.

  • Comfortable with the technical fundamentals in at least one area (creation flows, APIs, integrations, security, compliance) and eager to build depth quickly.

  • Self-motivated and organized, able to manage a growing book of POCs, demos, and customer conversations while hitting deadlines.

  • Willing to travel for customer discovery and on-site demos as needed.

  • You like staying ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development.

  • Strong written and spoken communication in English and German

 

We'd be particularly excited if

  • Like working in a fast pace environment

  • Can also speak Spanish and or Italian

  • Based in Munich or London so you can spend time in our offices. This is a hybrid role, with 2-3 days a week in the office.

 

Compensation

We offer a competitive salary, equity and benefits. Your offer will reflect your experience, skills and the scope of the role.

About TULIP

TULIP is the frontline operations platform that helps manufacturers digitize, connect and continuously improve how they run production, with AI at the core of the product. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries.

In January 2026, TULIP closed its $120M Series D, at a valuation of $1.3B. Leading global manufacturers run on TULIP, including VEKA, DMG Mori, Roche, AstraZeneca, Richemont, Saint-Gobain Aerospace and Mitsubishi Electric. The opportunity in DACH for TULIP

Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Key Responsibilities:

title: Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

Solutions Engineers at Axle build the integrations and technical infrastructure that enable our customers to connect distributed energy devices, orchestrate them, and participate in electricity markets.

This is a generalist engineering role, encompassing core software engineering, customer implementation, and solution design. You will work closely with our customers to understand their technical requirements, build integrations, solve complex technical challenges, and help shape our product based on real world feedback.

We encourage engineers to own as much of the problem space as they can. You will spend time talking to customers, getting feedback from users, and working closely with market operators, while collaborating with Product to deliver scalable engineering solutions.

At Axle, we work in a deliberately flat structure. That means fewer layers, faster decisions, and more ownership for everyone.

 

Solutions Engineering at Axle looks like

  • Forming a deep understanding of our domain, our platform, and our customers' technical challenges, so you have enough context to execute at speed.

  • Building and maintaining integrations with customer systems, distributed energy devices, and third-party platforms.

  • Working closely with customers to troubleshoot technical issues, support implementations, and design scalable solutions.

  • Steering customers towards a more direct launch plan and a better user experience.

  • Collaborating closely with our Product team to turn customer feedback into product improvements.

  • Focus on outcomes rather than process, taking ownership of the quality and impact of the final product you deliver.

  • Manage your own time and support others to adapt to changing scope and deadlines, to deliver 80% of the value in 20% of the time

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, ideally building integrations or customer-facing technical solutions.

  • A track record of working directly with customers: scoping requirements, leading implementations, and owning the technical relationship.

Tech stack

🐍 We build in Python + React for the frontend

🐋 Everything we build lives in Docker, for minimal cross-platform faff and maximal reproducibility.
🤖 Unlimited Claude Code tokens - we are aggressive users and explorers of AI, and encourage everybody to reconsider their workflows regularly

☁️ We deploy on GCP

What's in it for you

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

 

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Remote pair programming

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

Tu es gestionnaire de paie et tu as envie de rejoindre un éditeur de logiciel ? Alassio constitue son équipe Support et recrute son ou sa Spécialiste Support Paie !

En un coup d'œil

  • Contrat : CDI

  • Équipe : Support

  • Expérience : 1 à 2 ans en paie, alternance comprise

  

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d'expertise comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio a levé 2,6 M€ en pre-seed auprès de Partech et de business angels de référence. Nous accélérons pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l'accompagnement.

 

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Pour un gestionnaire de paie, une question sans réponse un jour de clôture, c'est une paie en retard. La qualité du Support est un élément clé de l'accompagnement qu'Alassio propose à ses cabinets partenaires, et l'arrivée de nouveaux cabinets nous amène à constituer une équipe dédiée.

 

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu es le premier contact de nos cabinets partenaires quand ils ont une question. Ta réactivité et la clarté de tes réponses conditionnent leur confiance dans Alassio dès leurs premières semaines en production. En accompagnant les gestionnaires de paie dans leur pratique quotidienne du logiciel, tu contribues directement à la qualité du produit, et tu montes en compétences sur toute la paie et sur notre outil.

 

🧭 Ton parcours et tes missions

  • Tu te formes sur le produit, sur la paie telle qu'Alassio la calcule et sur les process de l'équipe

  • Tu prends le relais d'Alassio Intelligence, notre agent IA qui apporte la première réponse, quand un gestionnaire de paie a besoin d'un humain : tu réponds sur Intercom aux questions d'utilisation de l'outil, de paramétrage de dossier et de paie courante

  • Tu gagnes en autonomie et tiens nos standards de service : première réponse en moins de 5 minutes, satisfaction des cabinets supérieure à 98 %

  • Tu qualifies chaque demande et tu l'escalades quand il le faut, avec tous les éléments utiles : aux Consultant(e)s Support Paie & DSN pour les cas complexes de paie et de DSN, à l'équipe Tech pour les bugs

  • Tu contribues aux contenus d'aide et à la base de connaissances d'Alassio Intelligence, pour rendre les cabinets plus autonomes

  • Tu portes la voix des utilisateurs en remontant au Product des retours structurés

  • Tu testes les nouvelles fonctionnalités avant leur mise en production

 

🤝 Ton environnement

  • Rattachement : notre Lead Support Paie & DSN et Huy Anh (Resp. Métier)

  • Tu travailles au quotidien avec nos Consultant(e)s Support Paie & DSN, notre Expert(e) Métier Paie & DSN et notre Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie

  • Outils : Alassio, Alassio Intelligence, Intercom, Linear, Notion, Mintlify

 

🗓️ Tes 6 premiers mois

  • À 1 mois : tu connais le produit et nos process, et tu réponds aux demandes simples avec relecture du Lead Support Paie & DSN

  • À 3 mois : tu es autonome sur le niveau 1, tu tiens nos standards et tes escalades sont complètes et bien qualifiées

  • À 6 mois : tu prends en charge tes premières demandes de niveau 2 et tu contribues régulièrement à la documentation

  

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

Indispensable :

  • Formation en paie (BTS, licence pro, master ou titre professionnel Gestionnaire de paie)

  • 1 à 2 ans d'expérience en paie, alternance comprise (cabinet, entreprise ou éditeur)

  • De bonnes bases : établissement du bulletin, cotisations, absences, congés payés

  • Une vraie appétence pour le numérique et de l'aisance à l'écrit

Un plus :

  • Bonnes notions de DSN

  • Pratique d'un logiciel de paie du marché

  • Expérience en relation client ou en support

  • Un parcours ou un intérêt pour la tech (formation, projets personnels)

 

💎 Qualités

  • La curiosité et l'envie d'apprendre

  • La rigueur et le sens du service

  • La capacité à garder le cap lors des pics d'activité (clôtures de paie mensuelles, mois de janvier)

  

Processus de sélection

1️⃣ Appel d'introduction avec Hector (COO) : 30 min

2️⃣ Entretien et cas pratique en direct avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier) : vérifier un bulletin et rédiger une réponse à un cabinet : 1 h

3️⃣ Rencontre avec l'équipe : 1 h

  

Ce que nous offrons

 

👊 Une mission unique

Développer tes compétences au contact d'experts et d'une équipe tech ambitieuse, dans une startup qui change le quotidien des gestionnaires de paie, et contribuer chaque jour aux améliorations du produit.

descriptionHtml:
CSQ427R397

As a Sr Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will work with customers to build and productionize solutions to their data & AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data. 

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

The impact you will have:

  • Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration
  • Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational big data projects including end-to-end design, build and deployment of industry-leading big data and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer
  • Empower Customers: Guide customers on architecture and design; bootstrap or implement customer projects which leads to a customers' successful understanding, evaluation and adoption of Databricks.
  • Own the Architecture: Lead architecture and design decisions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Databricks best practices.
  • Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs.
  • Work with Engineering and Databricks Customer Support to provide product and implementation feedback and to guide rapid resolution for engagement specific product and support issues.
  • Customer Immersion: Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.
  • Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.

What we look for:

  • 6+ years experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering
  • Comfortable writing code in either Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks
  • Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one
  • Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments
  • Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs
  • Design and deployment of performant production end-to-end data architectures and applications that combine data pipelines, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces.
  • Experience with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines and measurable outcomes, translating complex concepts into actionable solutions.
  • Documentation and white-boarding skills.
  • Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range
  • Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.
  • Travel to customers 20% of the time
  • Databricks Certification

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

descriptionHtml:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

Data isn't a support function at Vibe, it's the fuel. Every decision about which ad reaches which household, and when, runs on it. You'll join the Data Platform team and specialize in identity, turning billions of raw events into coherent, usable entities that power targeting, measurement, and the training sets Vibe's models learn from. You'll report to the Head of Data Platform. This role exists because identity resolution at Vibe's scale is a hard, unsolved problem, and the team needs someone who can build models that catch the right signal across petabytes of events. You'll get direct, measurable impact: your work decides which ad reaches whom and whether it worked, not a metric buried in a research paper. You'll shape the roadmap for a system every team at Vibe depends on, and work on a problem that only gets more interesting as CTV scales.

What You'll Do

Identity Stack Ownership

  • Research and build algorithms that resolve coherent entities, like users and households, from billions of events

  • Turn machine learning, clustering, and statistical approaches into scalable, production-ready systems

  • Lead projects end-to-end, from stakeholder requirements through research, implementation, and post-launch iteration

  • Build platform-level identity-resolution tooling so every team can resolve identity behind their own events

  • Design for scale from the start; treat unscalable local tests as unfinished work

Cross-Team Partnership

  • Help shape and execute the roadmap for Vibe's identity stack

  • Surface tradeoffs, risks, and decisions to stakeholders without burying them in implementation detail

  • Translate ambiguous requests from Product, Sales, ML, and Finance into concrete deliverables

  • Collaborate with other ML engineers on MLOps problems

What You Need

  • 5+ years of experience as an ML engineer or data scientist building and operating production services

  • Experience operating at data scale, using tools like Dagster, Spark, or Iceberg

  • Familiarity with MLOps tooling and practices

  • A track record of leading technical projects end-to-end, from ambiguous requirements to shipped systems

  • Strong cross-functional communication skills, including adjusting detail level for your audience and pushing back constructively

  • Judgment about when to invest in abstraction and when to keep things simple

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in streaming TV advertising or programmatic advertising

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

The pay range for this role is €99,000 - €171,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect — no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  2. Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

  3. Technical Interview — A real problem, not a trick. We'll work through it together.

  4. Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

  5. Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

  6. Reference checks — Two calls, handled with discretion.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

title: Staff Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Lead/Staff Product Designer to shape some of the most important experiences in our marketplace. You'll own complex, high-impact problem spaces end to end — from ambiguous discovery through to shipped, measured outcomes — and raise the bar for design craft and pace across the whole team.

A note on how we work: AI fluency is integral to the role. Our design team works AI-natively. We use Claude Code/Design (and similar tools) to move from idea to high-quality prototype in hours, not weeks, and we expect designers at this level to be genuinely fluent in this way of working, not just curious about it. If you're still designing the way teams did in 2023, this probably isn't the right role. If you've rebuilt your workflow around AI and it's made you dramatically faster and more ambitious, we'd love to talk.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own end-to-end design for a major problem space in our marketplace — buying, selling, or dealer-facing products — from discovery and framing through to launch and iteration

  • Set direction, not just execute: identify opportunities, make the case with evidence, and bring product and engineering partners with you

  • Strong end-to-end craft: you can go from a fuzzy problem statement to polished, production-ready design, and everything you ship is considered

  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace — you make good decisions with incomplete information and iterate quickly

  • Excellent communication and influence: you can align senior stakeholders, tell a compelling story with your work, and hold your ground constructively

  • Experience mentoring designers and lifting the standard of a team

 

STRONGLY PREFERRED

In your first six months you'll have taken ownership of a significant problem space, shipped work that measurably moves a core metric, and become someone other designers seek out — both for the quality of your craft and for how you use AI tools to work at a pace and ambition level others want to copy.

  • Identify and tackle systemic design opportunities that improve performance, accessibility, and user satisfaction at scale.

  • Act as a bridge between functions, using your influence to align cross-functional teams around a unified product vision.

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • Extensive experience leading complex design initiatives from conception to launch within large-scale, high-growth environments.

  • Proven ability to define and drive design strategy, successfully managing multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

  • Demonstrated track record of mentoring designers and elevating the quality of work within high-performing teams.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex design visions and influence senior leadership.

  • Deep technical fluency and a strategic understanding of how design influences engineering constraints and product outcomes.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

​​💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
