title: Staff Robotics Software Engineer (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Aufgaben

Stell dir Flotten autonomer Gabelstapler vor, die jeweils mehrere Tonnen wiegen und schwere Lasten in bis zu 14 Meter hohe Regale heben, sicher, rund um die Uhr und in unmittelbarer Nähe von Menschen. Genau das entwickeln wir bei Jungheinrich Robotics. Dabei spielt KI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung eine wichtige Rolle. In dieser Position stellst du sicher, dass sich jedes dieser Fahrzeuge genau so bewegt, wie es soll.

Wir suchen Verstärkung sowohl auf Senior- als auch auf Staff-Level. Bewirb dich auf die Position, die am besten zu dir passt, und gemeinsam finden wir die richtige Rolle für dich.

  • Du verantwortest die Steuerungssoftware unserer autonomen Gabelstapler, von einer einheitlichen Hardware-Abstraktionsschicht und der Aktuatorsteuerung auf Basis von ros_control/ros2_control bis hin zu den Schnittstellen zur Lokalisierung und Navigation.
  • Du modellierst und implementierst die Fahrzeugkinematik für unterschiedliche Gabelstaplertypen, einschließlich beschleunigungs- und ruckbegrenzter Bewegungsabläufe.
  • Du integrierst Motorsteuerungen, Antriebe und Aktuatoren über Feldbussysteme, insbesondere CANopen.
  • Du integrierst und kalibrierst Robotersensoren, darunter Encoder, IMUs, Laserscanner, Kameras und Hubhöhensensoren.
  • Du verbesserst die Zuverlässigkeit unserer Roboter im realen Einsatz durch intelligente Fehlerbehandlung, automatische Wiederherstellungsmechanismen sowie Logging- und Analysetools.
  • Du definierst und führst Integrations- und Systemtests an realen Robotern, Prüfständen und in Simulationen durch.
  • Du gestaltest den Einsatz KI-gestützter Entwicklungsmethoden, von der Programmierung und Testgenerierung bis hin zur KI-gestützten Loganalyse, und treibst deren Einführung innerhalb des Teams voran.
  • Du entwickelst technische Konzepte und Architekturen für unsere Robotersteuerung, analysierst Anforderungen und technische Abwägungen und stimmst Designentscheidungen auf Augenhöhe mit Systemarchitekt:innen sowie Expert:innen aus den Bereichen Safety und Navigation ab.
  • Du übernimmst je nach Erfahrung und Expertise die Verantwortung für teamübergreifende Initiativen und unterstützt Kolleg:innen durch Mentoring.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Informatik, Robotik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich oder bringst entsprechende praktische Erfahrung mit.
  • Du bringst mindestens 6 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Robotik-Softwareentwicklung mit, davon mindestens 3 Jahre in der Arbeit mit realen mobilen Robotern.
  • Du nutzt KI-basierte Tools, wie beispielsweise Coding-Assistenten, aktiv in deinem Arbeitsalltag und möchtest deren Einsatzmöglichkeiten weiter ausbauen.
  • Du verfügst über nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Entwicklung technischer Konzepte und Architekturen für Robotiksysteme.
  • Du bringst ein fundiertes Verständnis der Kinematik mobiler Roboter, einschließlich beschleunigungsbegrenzter Bewegungen, sowie des Zusammenspiels von Lokalisierung, Navigation und Hardware mit.
  • Du verfügst über umfangreiche Erfahrung mit ROS1/ROS2 oder vergleichbarer Middleware sowie mit ros_control/ros2_control oder ähnlichen Frameworks.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Integration von Sensoren, Aktuatoren und Feldbussystemen, idealerweise CANopen.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in C++ und solide Kenntnisse in Python. Erfahrung mit Rust ist ein Plus.
  • Du bringst vertiefte Kenntnisse in mindestens einem der folgenden Bereiche mit:
    • Sicherheitsgerichtete SPS-Anwendungen, beispielsweise Siemens S7 / TIA Portal Safety, Beckhoff TwinSAFE oder SICK Flexi Soft.
    • Hardware-nahe Softwareentwicklung, beispielsweise CAN-Treiber, PROFINET, Timing und Synchronisation in Sensornetzwerken, idealerweise mit Kenntnissen im Bereich Mikrocontroller und Embedded Systems.
    • Autonome Software für reale Roboter, beispielsweise Lokalisierung, Navigation und Bewegungsplanung, kombiniert mit dem Interesse, dein Wissen im Bereich Low-Level-Control weiter zu vertiefen.
  • Du begeisterst dich dafür, mit deiner Software mehrere Tonnen schwere autonome Fahrzeuge sicher und präzise zu bewegen, und möchtest die Zukunft großer Roboterflotten in realen Lagerumgebungen mitgestalten.
  • Du bringst idealerweise Erfahrung mit ruckbegrenzten Bewegungsabläufen, dem Aufbau vollständiger Software-Stacks für mobile Roboter oder Intralogistik-Anwendungen mit automatisierten Gabelstaplern, AGVs oder AMRs mit.
  • Du kommunizierst fließend auf Englisch und verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf mittlerem Niveau (mindestens B1).
  • Du bist bereit, vor Ort an unserem Standort in München zu arbeiten.

Was wir bieten

  • Spitzentechnologie: Als Pioniere der Robotik sind wir in der Lage, ohne Schienen und Leitlinien zu navigieren und zu manipulieren, und bieten Lösungen für Prozesse, die noch nie jemand zuvor automatisieren konnte!
  • Team: Wir sind ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten. Du wirst in einem Team mit sehr smarten, bescheidenen, kooperativen und fleißigen Individuen arbeiten.
  • Kultur: Sei einfach Du selbst! Werde Teil eines dynamischen, innovativen und vielfältigen Teams, das Zusammenarbeit über Hierarchie stellt. Um innovativ zu sein, muss man ab und zu scheitern – wir lernen und verbessern uns ständig.
  • Arbeitsplatz: Unser Büro befindet sich in der Nähe der S‑Bahn-Station „Hirschgarten“. Wir arbeiten in einem Büro im Loft-Stil mit toller Ausstattung, eigener Werkstatt und Testbereich.
  • Vollverpflegung: Du hast keine Lust, darüber nachzudenken, was Du morgen zu Mittag essen willst, geschweige denn, es vorzubereiten? Zum Glück verwöhnt uns unser französischer Koch jeden Tag mit einem frisch gekochten kostenlosen Mittagessen! Und als Sahnehäubchen gibt es einen gefüllten Kühlschrank mit Getränken, frischem Obst und natürlich Kaffee!
  • Flexibilität: Flexibilität wird bei uns großgeschrieben. Unser hybrides Arbeitsmodell für Positionen, bei denen Anwesenheit verzichtbar ist, trägt zu einer gesunden Work-Life-Balance bei.
  • Benefits: Wir bieten attraktive Urlaubs‑, EGYM‑, Gesundheits- und Vergütungsleistungen. Erfahren Sie hier mehr über unsere aktuellen Mitarbeiterbenefits.

Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 %? Kein Problem. Wir wissen, dass die besten Talente nicht immer jeden Punkt einer Stellenanzeige mitbringen. Wenn Du Dich für Robotik begeisterst und die Zukunft der Automatisierung mitgestalten möchtest, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht ist genau diese Position der richtige nächste Schritt für Dich oder eine andere spannende Gelegenheit bei Jungheinrich Robotics.

Für uns bei Jungheinrich Robotics ist die Förderung der Inklusion sehr wichtig. Wir sind daher bestrebt, ein inklusives Umfeld für alle Kandidaten zu schaffen und bieten allen qualifizierten Bewerbern unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Alter, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Kultur oder Bildung gleiche Chancen. Wenn Du gewisse Anpassungen benötigst, um den Rekruitingprozess für Dich zugänglich zu machen, werden wir unser Bestes tun, um Dir entgegenzukommen. Sprich uns gerne darauf an!

title: Staff Windows Low Level C++ Engineer - Endpoint security
descriptionHtml:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Windows Low Level Engineer - Endpoint security, you will design and develop advanced security features for SentinelOne’s Windows endpoint protection platform, operating across both user-mode and kernel-mode environments. You will build and optimize mission-critical components including anti-tampering protections, network sensors, and agent infrastructure while solving complex performance and stability challenges at massive scale. By researching Windows internals and debugging deep system issues, you will collaborate with distributed engineering teams to deliver high-impact security capabilities protecting millions of devices worldwide.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in low-level C++ programming and a deep understanding of Windows OS, to help us in developing our Endpoint Protection product, the core part of our business, and to join one of our Platform group teams. (We're currently growing multiple teams and are open to new colleagues with a wide variety of backgrounds within Windows development!).

The Platform group teams are in charge of some of our most complex low-level areas, such as:

  • Windows agent’s Anti-Tampering (self-protection from malware attempting to harm the agent), network sensors, device control, and other kernel-side features involving both research and development,
  • usermode security & agent infrastructures - e.g. installers, logging, services such as communication layer & interfaces for our Windows agent, for improving the quality, performance & stability of the agent and making the user experience smoother.

By joining our group, you will collaborate with talented engineers who are leading a feature through the whole development lifecycle. Your work will have an impact on millions of endpoints in one of the mainstream areas of the EPP/EDR agent of SentinelOne - a product recognized 5x-in-a-row as Gartner MQ Leader, scoring highly in many MITRE Att&ck assessments, valued by users in Gartner Peer Insights and more.

What will you do?

  • As a new member of one of our distributed development teams, you will work in both user-mode & kernel-mode, and deal with a large variety of fields.
  • You will have the chance to design, develop primarily in modern C++ (23), test and debug the most complicated real-world problems (often unseen before). In order to successfully deal with this challenge, you will continuously enrich your knowledge and experience with Windows OS internals & Kernel, Endpoint Protection, and Endpoint Detection & Response eco-system.
  • Our teams design and execute significant new features, as well as rewrite and reimplement the existing ones from scratch. You will also deal with extraordinary performance & optimization challenges, given the scale of our cybersecurity SW (handling hundreds of billions of events every day).
  • Your work will influence the security of tens of millions of Windows devices, that we protect at enterprise & government customers across the globe (incl. 4 of Fortune 10 and hundreds of Global 2000).
  • You’ll also be encouraged to share knowledge within both Platform teams and the broader Windows group.
  • Working setup: Flexible working hours, this is a 100% remote role on full-time permanent employment based within France. We provide optional membership in major coworking chains. Currently for this role in France we are able to consider only candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying. Optionally for those willing to relocate to the Czech Republic relocation assistance is available for any candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying.

What skills & knowledge should you bring?

  • Multiple years of experience as a software engineer in the area of lowlevel programming using modern C++ (or using C and a willingness to learn modern C++)
  • Hands-on experience and in-depth understanding of Windows OS design & internals, Windows low-level development, with debugging of Windows applications and familiarity with related standard debugging and profiling tools
  • Previous experience working on a production-grade product with a wide-scale deployment
  • Great communication skills and the ability to work both independently and with peers from different time zones, problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking
  • Attention to detail and high coding standards
  • An advantage: experience with Windows Kernel and Windows Drivers development, experience in security-oriented development, with reversing or malware analysis

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Competitive leave benefits
  • Gender-neutral parental leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical and insurance benefits
  • Disability insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Global home office allowance
  • Mobile phone reimbursement
  • Work-from-home allowance

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Stage Lead Generation & Growth Marketing en scale up healthtech
descriptionHtml:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

⚡ Notre équipe Marketing

Chez Lifen, nous travaillons à mieux faire circuler les données de santé pour faciliter le travail des professionnels et améliorer la coordination des soins. Cela passe aussi par notre capacité à faire connaître nos solutions aux bons interlocuteurs.

Ce stage rejoint l’équipe Marketing pour renforcer ses actions de visibilité, d’acquisition et de génération de demandes pour les équipes commerciales. Le poste couvre aussi une dimension événementielle : webinaires, salons et autres rendez-vous qui permettent de rencontrer nos audiences et de faire avancer les projets marketing.

Tu interviendras sur des sujets variés, avec un périmètre à construire avec ta manager. L’objectif : faire avancer des actions concrètes, mesurer leurs résultats et proposer les prochaines étapes.

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

  • Faire évoluer le site pour améliorer sa visibilité, son trafic et la conversion des visiteurs en demandes de rendez-vous.

  • Identifier des opportunités marketing : requêtes sur lesquelles Lifen pourrait mieux se positionner, parcours à optimiser, contenus, campagnes ou partenariats à tester.

  • Mettre en place et suivre des actions d’acquisition et de génération de leads : séquences email, campagnes, retargeting, partenariats ou activation de la base existante, selon les priorités.

  • Appuyer l’organisation de webinaires, salons et autres événements : recherche de lieux, coordination opérationnelle, préparation des éléments nécessaires et suivi des actions associées.

  • Analyser le comportement des visiteurs et les résultats des actions menées pour comprendre ce qui fonctionne, ce qui bloque et quoi tester ensuite.

  • Transformer tes analyses en recommandations concrètes, puis les faire avancer avec l’équipe Marketing et les équipes commerciales.

À la fin du stage, tu auras contribué à construire un pipe marketing pour une équipe commerciale, à générer du trafic, à optimiser la conversion et à organiser des actions événementielles.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

  • Tu recherches un stage de fin d’études de 6 mois dans le cadre d’un M2.

  • Tu as déjà acquis des bases en marketing, idéalement sur des sujets d’acquisition, de CRM, d’email marketing ou d’événementiel.

  • Une première expérience, un projet personnel ou un travail mené dans le cadre de tes études montre que tu as déjà travaillé sur des sujets marketing.

  • Face à un problème, tu sais chercher, comprendre le contexte, formuler une approche et aller jusqu’à une proposition concrète.

  • Tu as envie de travailler sur des sujets variés, avec de l’autonomie et de la prise d’initiative.

Nice-to-have

  • Des connaissances en référencement, web performance ou acquisition payante.

  • Une première pratique du scraping.

  • Une expérience, même ponctuelle, dans l’organisation de webinaires, de salons ou d’autres événements.

  • L’habitude d’utiliser l’intelligence artificielle pour avancer dans ton travail, tout en restant capable d’expliquer et de challenger ce que tu produis.

Soft skills

Tu es curieux·se, organisé·e et tu apprends vite. Tu ne te contentes pas d’exécuter une demande telle quelle : tu cherches à comprendre le problème, tu vas chercher les informations qui te manquent et tu proposes des pistes utiles. Tu sais tenir un sujet opérationnel dans la durée, coordonner les interlocuteurs concernés et demander de l’aide quand c’est nécessaire. Le diplôme ou l’école ne feront pas la différence : ce qui compte, c’est ce que tu as déjà appris, ce que tu veux comprendre et le soin que tu mets dans ton travail.

Nos valeurs

  • Embrace Complexity : tu sais découper un sujet large, tester des pistes et relier les résultats aux enjeux marketing et commerciaux.

  • Bienveillance : tu échanges simplement avec tes interlocuteurs, tu écoutes les retours et tu construis avec eux.

  • Real Impact : tes actions doivent aider à accroître la visibilité de Lifen, générer du trafic qualifié et créer des occasions de rencontre avec nos audiences.

👥 Process de recrutement

Le process est volontairement court :

  1. Entretien initial - 30 minutes
    Avec Pauline, ta future manager. L’objectif est de comprendre ton parcours, ton intérêt pour le stage, tes premières expériences ou projets marketing, ainsi que ta manière d’aborder un problème.

  2. Use case préparé en amont, puis présentation live - 60 min
    Tu recevras un cas à préparer avant l’échange. Tu présenteras ensuite ton raisonnement, les informations que tu es allé·e chercher et les actions que tu proposes. Nous évaluerons surtout ta curiosité, ton autonomie, ta compréhension des enjeux marketing et ta capacité à faire des choix.

Nous partageons un retour sous 48 heures ouvrées après chaque étape et prenons la décision finale sous deux jours ouvrés après le dernier entretien.

Compensation: €1K – €1.2K per month

title: Stage R&D Hardware - Banc de test multi-produits
descriptionHtml:
🚲Derrière chaque piste cyclable pérennisée, chaque site naturel préservé, il y a une décision. Et derrière cette décision, il y a nos données.

Chez Eco-Compteur, nous aidons les villes et les gestionnaires d’espaces naturels à décider sur des faits, pas à l’intuition.

Nos capteurs connectés mesurent la fréquentation piétons et cyclistes, en ville comme en pleine nature, et nos logiciels transforment ces données en indicateurs concrets : impact d’un aménagement, évolution de la pratique, effet des saisons. Parce que compter, c’est bien, mais donner du sens aux chiffres, c’est encore mieux !

🌍 Pionniers et leader mondial d’un métier que nous avons créé il y a plus de 20 ans, nous sommes basés en Bretagne, avec des filiales sur quatre continents et des solutions présentes dans plus de 55 pays.

🤝 Une entreprise à taille humaine, portée par l’autonomie, la responsabilité et la transparence, avec beaucoup de passion (et de plaisir !).

Envie que vos compétences aient un impact concret ? Nous recherchons notre prochain·e :

Stage de fin d’études · 6 mois · Lannion (22)

Nous préparons un nouveau banc de test capable de piloter une dizaine de produits différents. Chaque produit sera relié à une carte de pilotage qui gère ses interfaces, son alimentation et la mesure de sa consommation. Un poste central dialogue ensuite avec chacune de ces cartes pour dérouler les tests et scénarios attendus.

Le défi : router les bons bus vers le bon produit selon le test en cours (USB, UART, I2C, JTAG, …), et pouvoir déconnecter physiquement les équipements pour mesurer la consommation sans perturbation.

Tu utiliseras Claude (IA) au quotidien pour t’aider dans la conception, le développement et la documentation.

✏️Tes rôles :

– Recenser les besoins de test des produits (interfaces, séquences, mesures) et définir l’architecture du banc

– Concevoir la carte de pilotage (schéma, routage, mise au point) : commutation des bus, déconnexion physique des équipements, alimentation et mesure de consommation (précision, calibration, asservissement)

– Développer son firmware et le protocole de communication avec le poste central

– Développer le logiciel de supervision qui pilote chaque carte et déroule les scénarios de test

– Intégrer le banc à notre chaîne CI/CD (Jenkins, Git) pour lancer les tests automatiquement

– Valider le banc sur les produits, documenter et le mettre en service

Le poste est basé à Lannion, Bretagne, au sein d’une technopole à taille humaine d’envergure mondiale (1er centre R&D Orange Labs en France et 2ème site Nokia français). Les loisirs, nautiques notamment, sont particulièrement accessibles par la localisation à 5 km de la Côte de Granit Rose

Ce que l’on te met à disposition :

  • Des outils performants qui permettront d’exprimer pleinement tes talents

  • Une équipe de passionnés qui travaillera à tes côtés


👉Et si c’était toi ?

– Bac+5, école d’ingénieur ou master en électronique / systèmes embarqués

– Électronique numérique : bus UART, I2C, JTAG, conception de cartes

– Firmware embarqué en C sur microcontrôleur

– Bases en mesure de courant, alimentation et asservissement

– Python pour la supervision et l’automatisation des tests, Git, CI/CD (Jenkins)

– Curieux(se), autonome, rigoureux(se), à l’aise en laboratoire

L’entreprise et le projet te plaisent ?

title: Stagiair Social Media - vtwonen
descriptionHtml:
Amsterdam – Ben jij altijd online en heb je een passie voor wonen, interieur en social media? Tijdens deze allround stage werk je mee aan de online kanalen van vtwonen, vtwonen Landelijk en vtwonen Design en ontwikkel je jezelf binnen een professioneel mediateam. Je krijgt veel ruimte om te leren, mee te denken en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Twee keer per jaar zoeken wij een stagiair voor ons online team, die start in februari of september. Lijkt dit je leuk, lees dan snel verder!

Wat ga je doen?
Tijdens deze stage speel je een actieve rol in het beheren en verder ontwikkelen van de socialmediakanalen van vtwonen. Met jouw creativiteit en gevoel voor online content draag je bij aan het vergroten van de betrokkenheid van onze doelgroep en zorg je ervoor dat onze merken dagelijks zichtbaar en relevant blijven. Dit doe je onder andere door:

  • Het beheren van de socialmediakanalen Instagram, TikTok, Facebook en Pinterest voor vtwonen, vtwonen tuin, vtwonen Landelijk en vtwonen Design.

  • Het creëren van aansprekende content in tekst en beeld die aansluit bij de verschillende merken.

  • Het versterken van de relatie met onze online community door middel van communitymanagement.

  • Het analyseren van campagnes en het opstellen van heldere rapportages.

  • Het ondersteunen bij video-opnames, zowel in onze studio in Amsterdam als op locatie.

Daarnaast vinden we het belangrijk dat jouw stage aansluit bij jouw leerdoelen en interesses. In overleg met je stagebegeleider is er ruimte om je verder te verdiepen in onderwerpen die jij belangrijk vindt.

Wie zijn wij?
Wij zijn vtwonen, dé wooncoach voor een fijn en stijlvol thuis dat helemaal bij jou past. Met onze magazines, het televisieprogramma vtwonen Weer verliefd op je huis, eigen collecties, een website, nieuwsbrieven, socialmediakanalen en een eigen vtwonen marketplace inspireren we iedere dag onze doelgroep. Van binnenkijkers en stylingideeën tot DIY-projecten, tuintips en de nieuwste woontrends: vtwonen helpt mensen bij het creëren van een persoonlijke woonstijl.

Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat?
Voor deze stage zoeken wij een enthousiaste en leergierige student met affiniteit voor social media en digitale content. Daarnaast bezit jij:

  • Je volgt een relevante hbo- of universitaire opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in online marketing, journalistiek, media of communicatie.

  • Je hebt een vlotte pen en een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

  • Je hebt ervaring met of affiniteit voor social media, interieur en digitale content.

  • Je hebt gevoel voor beeld, tekst en video en bent creatief in het ontwikkelen van content.

  • Je bent minimaal vijf maanden fulltime beschikbaar en vindt het geen probleem om incidenteel in de avond of het weekend online actief te zijn.

Bij DPG Media staan we open voor alle talent in de maatschappij. Ongeacht je achtergrond, nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren op deze functie. Juist door de verschillen tussen collega’s ontstaan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen. En dat past dan weer heel erg goed bij ons als organisatie. We zijn benieuwd wie jij bent en welke kwaliteiten en ervaring jij meebrengt. Wil je meer weten over onze inclusieve werkomgeving, klik dan hier!

Stagelopen bij DPG Media
Stagelopen bij DPG Media betekent niet alleen dat je de door jou geleerde theorie in de praktijk brengt door een bijdrage te leveren aan onze ambitieuze teams, ook ga je bij ons écht wat leren. Een aanvulling ben je zeker, want jouw creatieve en frisse blik wordt erg gewaardeerd. Na je stage kan je zeggen dat je ook nog eens écht toffe dingen hebt bereikt én hebt gewerkt bij het grootste mediabedrijf van Nederland. Zet dat maar op je cv!

Over DPG Media
DPG Media heeft met haar sterke merken een stevige marktpositie in alle onderdelen van de mediabranche. Elke dag werken we met ontzettend veel plezier aan ons portfolio dat bestaat uit uiteenlopende A-merken, waaronder AD, AutoWeek, DonaldDuck, Libelle, Margriet, Linda, NU.nl, Qmusic, vtwonen en RTL. Je wordt dus onderdeel van een groter geheel: met al onze merken bereiken we elke maand 98% van de Nederlanders. Hoe tof is dat?

Wat krijg je van ons?
Bij ons krijg je een inspirerende werkomgeving die continu in beweging is. Collega’s die denken in mogelijkheden, het glas halfvol zien en we geven jou de kans je dagelijks te ontwikkelen. Dit doen we onder andere door onze DPG Academy. Dit geeft jou alle mogelijkheid het beste uit jezelf te halen en een echte mediamaker te zijn!

title: Strategic Account Director (Perm, UK, Remote)
descriptionHtml:
Strategic Account Director (Perm, UK, Remote)

About Nearform  

Nearform is an independent team of data and AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capabilities at pace. We create AI‑enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact. Our deep expertise in solving complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people‑first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI. Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media O2, and Walmart

About the role

Nearform has worked with this Client for over a decade. They are one of our most strategically important clients — a Client that we both sell to (as a direct client) and sell with (as a partner taking joint propositions to their end-clients). 

We're hiring a strategic account director to own the commercial growth of this account. This is a senior, hands-on role: equal parts business developer, marketer, account strategist, and trusted operator inside one of Nearform's most important relationships. You will be the commercial centre of gravity for everything Nearform does with this Client.

What you'll do

  • Own the executive relationship. Build and maintain a network of senior sponsors across the Client’s consulting and technology leadership teams, creating new advocates for Nearform and deepening executive engagement over time. 
  • Own the business development plan. Build, maintain, and execute a multi-year account plan with clear targets, named opportunities, and a credible path to growth.
  • Win new business, across both sides of the relationship. Lead pursuit of new opportunities — directly into this Client and jointly into their end-clients — from origination through to close.
  • Bring commercial framing to technical pursuits. Partner with Nearform's Technical Directors and Solutions leaders to translate strong technical propositions into compelling commercial cases that win.
  • Manage marketing for the account. Own how Nearform shows up in and around this Client — joint content, co-branded propositions, events, case studies, and the steady drumbeat of presence that keeps us front of mind.
  • Define and align the account management model. Agree with the Client (and internally) how the relationship is governed — who meets whom, on what cadence, with what outcomes — and keep that model healthy as the account scales.
  • Be a commercial face of the relationship. Build and maintain senior stakeholder relationships across this account, and act as the internal owner of the commercial health at Nearform.
  • Forecast, report, and run the rhythm. Maintain accurate pipeline, forecast confidently, and run the operational cadence (QBRs, pipeline reviews, account standups) that keeps the account predictable.
  • Work with local GTM teams where appropriate so we are bringing local intimacy with global consistency. 

What we're looking for

Commercial track record

  • Demonstrable experience growing a strategic enterprise account, ideally one that combines direct selling and partner/channel motions
  • Track record of winning new business in a services or technology environment — not just managing existing revenue
  • Comfortable owning a number and forecasting against it

Consulting and Partner fluency

  • Has worked with, in, or alongside consulting firms — understands how they sell, how they buy, and how to be useful to them in front of their clients
  • Knows how to navigate a "sell-to and sell-with" relationship without confusing the two
  • Knows how to elevate the partnership-building dimension to develop and execute joint GTM strategies with the client by identifying repeatable plays, solution offerings and routes to market that creates growth for both organisations. 

AI and technology background

  • Strong working knowledge of modern technology delivery — software engineering, cloud, data, and (especially) applied AI
  • Credible in technical conversations: doesn't need to architect the solution, but can shape, qualify, and commercially frame it
  • Conversant in the AI landscape as it applies to enterprise — agents, AI-native engineering, the difference between hype and production

Operator instincts

  • Plans the work and works the plan — strong account-planning discipline
  • Confident running marketing for an account: brief, prioritise, and partner well with central Marketing
  • Builds trust quickly with senior stakeholders, internally and externally
  • Comfortable holding the commercial line in a room of technical specialists, and the technical line in a room of commercial buyers

Nice to have

  • Existing relationships in the management consulting ecosystem
  • Experience standing up or refining an account management operating model
  • Background that includes time in a delivery or technical role earlier in career

The position provides technical and administrative product information, demonstrations, and/or product training. You will take charge of a significant proportion of customers and engage in significant complex sales opportunities, often of 7- and 8-digit value. Your success will be built on exceptional relationship building at both operational and board-equivalent levels both externally and internally.

At Axon, our goal is to make each individual feel valued for his or her contributions to the company’s mission to protect life. We are looking for intelligent people who want to do remarkable things. We strive to create an environment where people can succeed and enjoy coming to work every day. Life at Axon is fast paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. You will constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage and grow revenue and market share at designated agencies to maximize customer satisfaction and achieve Axon’s strategic objectives
  • Develop and maintain client relationships to ultimately drive revenue growth
  • Develop and execute account strategy by collaborating with account team to deliver stronger, more relevant value propositions
  • Cultivate customer relationships and ensure effective service delivery to accounts
  • Focus on customer's satisfaction, know the customer's business and workflows, develop proper contact network within accounts
  • Support execution of strategy at the account level
  • Work with and bring in experts/specialists where required
  • Oversee all account activities
  • Responsible for forecasting, keep management in touch with accounts in a timely fashion, gather intelligence on competitor activity, and give feedback to marketing
  • Track customer activity in internal systems in order to execute on account strategy and identify additional opportunities
  • May provide customer product training as necessary
  • Accountable for individual expense budget management
  • Own account relationship and drive overall customer satisfaction for assigned accounts

What You Bring

  • Able to travel up to 70%
  • An extensive demonstrable track record in Software Sales (SaaS / Cloud)
  • Relationship / consultative selling experience
  • Able to clearly and directly articulate complex solution offerings
  • Data management experience using Salesforce or similar CRM
  • Virtualization and Cloud understanding
  • Team Player - collaborate with various team members regularly
  • Ready to own & drive the territory
  • Startup experience & some vertical experience a plus
  • Defense / Law Enforcement / Public Safety experience a plus

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

title: Strategic Account Executive - France
descriptionHtml:
France-based | French required | English required | Additional languages are a plus | Approximately 30% travel

About Rescale

Rescale is pioneering the future of engineering and scientific discovery. As the leader in digital engineering, we help the world’s most advanced organizations develop better products faster through intelligent automation, applied AI, data management, and access to the world’s largest network of engineering and R&D applications.

Rescale brings together elastic, enterprise-grade HPC with advanced modeling and simulation, agentic engineering, AI Physics, and the software and data workflows that connect them. Our customers use Rescale to modernize R&D, accelerate simulation, automate engineering processes, and turn engineering data into faster, better decisions across industries including automotive, manufacturing, aerospace, energy, life sciences, and semiconductors.

Joining Rescale means becoming part of a diverse, collaborative, and mission-driven team solving complex challenges that traditional HPC alone cannot address.

The Role

We are looking for a high-performing Strategic Account Executive to lead direct enterprise sales and account growth across France.

This is an entrepreneurial, field-based role focused on building and expanding strategic relationships with key and enterprise accounts. You will own a defined portfolio of named accounts, create demand, develop executive relationships, win new business, and expand Rescale’s footprint from foundational HPC into advanced modeling and simulation, agentic engineering, and AI Physics.

You will operate as the commercial owner of your territory: setting the account strategy, identifying business problems, building internal champions, creating compelling value cases, and leading complex sales cycles from first engagement through renewal and expansion. This is a direct-sales role, not a channel-led position. You will work closely with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Sales Development, Product, and Rescale leadership, while retaining ownership of the commercial strategy and outcome.

France is a priority market, with particular emphasis on automotive and manufacturing enterprises where engineering organizations are investing in digital engineering transformation. Success requires the ability to sell both into existing strategic relationships and into new enterprise accounts where Rescale can create meaningful business impact.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and grow a focused portfolio of strategic key and enterprise accounts across France.

  • Build account and territory plans that identify the highest-value expansion paths, whitespace, executive relationships, and competitive risks.

  • Expand existing Rescale customers by introducing additional capabilities across the platform, from Rescale HPC to Advanced Modeling and Simulation, Agentic Engineering, and AI Physics.

  • Develop new enterprise relationships and win new logos where Rescale’s platform can transform engineering and R&D workflows.

  • Generate pipeline through proactive prospecting, account-based engagement, executive networking, customer insight, and disciplined market development.

  • Engage senior stakeholders across engineering, R&D, simulation, IT, digital transformation, finance, procurement, and executive leadership.

  • Lead the full enterprise sales cycle, including account planning, discovery, qualification, value engineering, business-case development, solution alignment, negotiation, procurement, and close.

  • Position Rescale as a strategic platform for HPC modernization, simulation acceleration, engineering workflow transformation, and AI-driven product development.

  • Articulate how Rescale’s offerings work together: HPC as the scalable foundation; Advanced Modeling and Simulation as the workflow layer; Agentic Engineering as the automation layer; and AI Physics as the intelligence layer that turns simulation data into predictive insight.

  • Build trusted relationships across the customer organization, from end users and technical champions to business sponsors, procurement leaders, and C-level decision-makers.

  • Orchestrate internal teams to deliver coordinated account plans, executive engagement, technical validation, pilots, and commercial proposals.

  • Maintain rigorous Salesforce hygiene, forecast accuracy, opportunity inspection, and pipeline coverage, with clear weekly visibility into commit, likely, best case, and risk.

  • Represent Rescale in customer meetings, industry events, and executive forums across France, with travel expected at approximately 30%.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent achievement and overachievement of quarterly and annual revenue targets through a healthy mix of account expansion and net-new enterprise business.

  • Durable growth within strategic accounts, including broader adoption of Rescale’s platform and expansion into new teams, workloads, geographies, and use cases.

  • A high-quality, self-generated pipeline across automotive, manufacturing, and other engineering-intensive industries.

  • New enterprise logos and meaningful strategic wins in the French market.

  • Executive-level credibility with customers navigating HPC modernization, simulation, AI, and digital engineering transformation.

  • Clear customer value cases that connect technical outcomes to business priorities such as faster product development, higher engineering productivity, improved infrastructure flexibility, and better R&D economics.

  • Consistent operating discipline, urgency, ownership, resilience, and transparency in a high-growth environment.

Who You Are

  • An entrepreneurial enterprise seller who creates opportunity rather than waiting for inbound demand.

  • Equally comfortable expanding an established strategic account and opening a new enterprise relationship.

  • A strong hunter with the persistence and commercial judgment to create access, build consensus, and win competitive deals.

  • Confident engaging technical practitioners while earning credibility with senior business leaders and executives.

  • Resilient and resourceful in long, complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Commercially disciplined and accountable for your number, account strategy, forecast, pipeline quality, and execution.

  • Consultative, curious, and able to translate complex technology into compelling business outcomes.

  • Collaborative and low-ego, with the influence to mobilize cross-functional teams without losing ownership of the result.

  • Motivated by the opportunity to help define a new category at the intersection of cloud HPC, digital engineering, automation, and AI.

Key Qualifications

  • 5+ years of success in enterprise or strategic account sales, ideally selling complex technical, cloud, SaaS, platform, engineering, or scientific-computing solutions.

  • Demonstrated success growing enterprise accounts and/or winning new business in France.

  • Experience selling to large organizations in automotive, manufacturing, industrial technology, engineering software, simulation, HPC, cloud, or adjacent technology environments.

  • A track record of managing long, complex, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles from discovery through close and expansion.

  • Ability to engage credibly with engineering, R&D, IT, digital transformation, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders.

  • Strong skills in consultative discovery, value selling, negotiation, executive communication, and closing.

  • Experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM with disciplined opportunity management and forecasting.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in French and English. Additional languages are an advantage.

  • Strong organization, prioritization, and account-planning skills.

  • Must be based in France and able to travel regularly to customer sites and industry events across the country.

Why Rescale

Rescale serves many of the world’s most advanced engineering organizations and is helping define the next generation of digital engineering. For the right sales leader, this is an opportunity to shape strategic accounts in a category where cloud HPC, advanced simulation, agentic engineering, and AI Physics are converging to change how products are designed, tested, and brought to market.

If you are energized by building executive relationships, creating demand, expanding strategic accounts, and helping engineering organizations move from traditional infrastructure and fragmented workflows to an intelligent digital engineering platform, this role offers significant strategic and commercial upside.

Rescale is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified persons regardless of race, sex, disability, religion or belief, sexual orientation, age, or any other protected characteristic. Employment with Rescale is contingent upon successful completion of a comprehensive background check. For details on the information Rescale collects during the application process, please see the Applicant Privacy Notice.

Compensation: €150K – €177K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Art Director & Brand Designer
descriptionHtml:
International Brands ist ein schnell wachsendes Schweizer Unternehmen im Bereich Personal Care / FMCG. Mit unseren Marken bringen wir Produkte in zehntausende Verkaufspunkte weltweit, von Drogerien über führende Retail Chains bis hin zu E-Commerce.

Wir bauen Marken, die im Regal funktionieren.

Nicht nur auf Slides. Nicht nur auf Instagram.

Schnell. Sichtbar. Greifbar. Skalierbar.

Wir entwickeln und skalieren Marken, die Design, Produkt und Performance kompromisslos verbinden und genau dort gewinnen, wo es zählt: im Markt.

Über 90’000 Verkaufspunkte weltweit.

Und wir sind noch lange nicht am Limit.

Wir suchen einen Art Director (100%).

Keinen klassischen Designer.

Wir suchen den kreativen Kopf unseres gesamten Brand Powerhouses.

Jemanden mit einem klaren, tiefen Verständnis für FMCG Design. Jemanden, der weiss, was im Regal stoppt, Aufmerksamkeit gewinnt und Produkte verkauft.

Jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt. Von Packaging über Markenwelten bis hin zu den kleinsten Details, die am Ende den Unterschied machen.

Jemanden, der Bestehendes hinterfragt, Dinge besser machen will und nicht akzeptiert, „wie es schon immer war“.

Die Rolle ist anspruchsvoll, schnell und sehr hands-on.

Wir suchen keinen Verwalter.

Wir suchen einen Macher.

Jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt, Tempo bringt und Dinge mit hoher Qualität konsequent umsetzt.

Jemanden, der Marken aktiv weiterentwickeln will. Nicht nur konzeptionell, sondern bis zum fertigen Produkt im Regal.

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest alles, was unsere Marken visuell und kreativ nach vorne bringt – mit klarem Fokus auf FMCG Performance im Markt.

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung kreativer Konzepte über alle Brands hinweg mit Fokus auf Sichtbarkeit, Wiedererkennung und Wirkung
  • Aufbau, Schärfung und Weiterentwicklung starker Markenwelten mit konsistenter Handschrift
  • Bestehendes hinterfragen, challengen und aktiv verbessern – nicht verwalten
  • Gestaltung von Packaging mit klarer FMCG-Logik: aufmerksamkeitsstark, markengerecht und mit Fokus auf Conversion am Regal
  • Entwicklung von Designs für Web, Social und Marketing Assets mit Fokus auf Performance statt nur Ästhetik
  • Ideen schnell, pragmatisch und effizient umsetzen – ohne sich in endlosen Abstimmungen zu verlieren
  • Aktiver Einsatz von AI und modernen Tools, um Workflow, Geschwindigkeit und Output kontinuierlich zu verbessern
  • Projekte eigenständig steuern und umsetzen – von der Idee bis zum fertigen Produkt im Markt
  • Steuerung von Freelancern und externen Partnern mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Brands sowie dem gesamten Team
  • Blick fürs Ganze: vom Produkt über Kommunikation bis hin zum physischen Umfeld

Du machst aus Design Produkte, die verkaufen. Und aus Kreativität Performance.

Qualifikation

  • 2–5+ Jahre Erfahrung im kreativen Bereich (Design, Art Direction o.Ä.)
  • Starkes Portfolio mit echten FMCG- oder Retail-Projekten und sichtbaren Resultaten
  • Sehr gute Skills in Figma sowie Erfahrung in UI und Web
  • Erfahrung in Packaging, Social Media, Web und Print
  • Tiefes Verständnis für FMCG Design, Retail, Consumer Behavior und Kaufentscheidungen
  • Du hinterfragst Dinge und entwickelst sie weiter
  • Du denkst nicht nur in Ästhetik, sondern in Wirkung, Performance und Ergebnissen
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, schnell, hands-on und lösungsorientiert
  • Du bringst Eigeninitiative mit und treibst Projekte aktiv voran
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung statt auf Briefings zu warten
  • Du nutzt AI als sinnvolles Tool im kreativen Alltag
  • Deutsch & English

Was nicht zu der Rolle passt

  • Rein ästhetisches Denken ohne Verständnis für Markt, Konsumenten und Wirkung
  • Kreative ohne echtes Interesse an FMCG, Retail und marktorientiertem Design
  • Sehr starre oder übermässig prozessgetriebene Arbeitsweisen
  • Menschen, die primär auf Vorgaben warten statt selbst Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Menschen, die Konzepte lieben, aber Schwierigkeiten mit Umsetzung und Geschwindigkeit haben

Benefits

  • Direktes Arbeiten mit dem Head of Brands
  • Echten Einfluss auf Marken, Produkte und deren Erfolg im Markt
  • Schnelle Entscheidungen statt endlosen Abstimmungsrunden
  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und viel Raum, Dinge wirklich zu bewegen

Wenn du etwas bewegen willst, dann bist du hier richtig.

Du wirst hier nicht einfach gestalten.

Du wirst Marken bauen.

Produkte entwickeln, die sichtbar werden.

Produkte, die im Regal stoppen.

Produkte, die gewinnen.

Und Produkte, die Menschen kaufen.

Wenn du jemand bist, der Dinge nicht nur schön machen, sondern erfolgreich machen will, dann sollten wir sprechen.

title: Support Systems & Programs Lead | Europe Remote
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to build and scale the systems, automations, and AI-powered processes that enable n8n's Support teams to deliver exceptional service at scale, while leading and developing the engineers who make it happen.

To achieve this, you'll take ownership of four key areas:

Lead and grow the Support Systems team

  • Lead, coach, and develop our Systems & Programs engineers, helping them grow their technical expertise and careers.

  • Establish a clear team scope, planning processes, and delivery rhythm to ensure consistent execution against priorities.

  • Support hiring and onboarding while staying close to technical decisions and hands-on problem-solving.

Own the Support tooling strategy and roadmap

  • Own the Support tooling portfolio and build a prioritised roadmap that enables Reactive and Proactive Support to scale efficiently.

  • Establish structured project intake, scoping, and prioritisation processes to focus engineering efforts on the highest-impact opportunities.

  • Partner with Support leaders and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Cloud, Security, Legal, Data, Customer Success, Sales, and Partnerships to align priorities and deliver improvements.

Drive AI-first Support and automation

  • Lead the expansion of Nate, our AI-powered Support solution, across Support tiers to increase the share of tickets handled through AI.

  • Guide the development, maintenance, and adoption of reliable automations, AI agents, and integrations that reduce repetitive work and improve Support efficiency.

  • Measure the impact of AI and automation through metrics such as time saved, AI-handled ticket share, and cost per AI ticket.

Build scalable processes and operational foundations

  • Rebuild and optimise foundational Support processes, ensuring workflows are efficient, documented, and scalable.

  • Establish strong governance for standard operating procedures (SOPs), tooling ownership, and automation reliability.

  • Drive continuous improvement by tracking tooling adoption, SOP compliance, operational efficiency, and capacity freed up for Support teams.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • Hands-on n8n expertise: You have practical experience building and maintaining complex workflows and automations using n8n.

  • Strong technical foundations: You're comfortable working with APIs, HTTP, authentication, webhooks, and SaaS architecture.

  • Support systems ownership: You've owned and improved technical Support systems, tooling, and automations in a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Engineering leadership: You have at least 5 years experience leading or mentoring engineers, helping them develop their skills and deliver high-quality work.

  • Roadmap and stakeholder management: You can translate business needs into clear technical priorities and align cross-functional stakeholders around a shared roadmap.

  • AI and automation expertise: You have hands-on experience implementing AI agents or AI-assisted Support tooling to improve operational efficiency.

Nice-to-haves

  • Technical product background: You've worked as a developer, in DevOps, or on an automation-focused technical product.

  • Support analytics: You're familiar with Support performance metrics and have experience using analytics or dashboarding tools such as Hex or Metabase.

  • Open-source ecosystem: You have experience working in open-source or community-led SaaS environments.

  • Remote-first experience: You've worked in distributed, remote-first teams, ideally within a European startup or scale-up.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll have the opportunity to shape a growing Support Systems function and define how we scale customer support through AI, automation, and better tooling. You'll lead a team of talented engineers, own a high-impact technical roadmap, and work closely with teams across the company to turn ambitious ideas into real operational improvements.

You'll join one of Europe's fastest-growing startups, where your work will directly influence how we deliver exceptional customer experiences as we grow. With a remote-first culture that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning, you'll have the freedom to build the foundations of an AI-first Support organisation.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

As our Talent Acquisition Associate, you get the unique opportunity to be a key player in building the greatest brand within Insurtech. descriptionHtml:

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer-obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

Lakebase enables teams to deliver applications faster with an optimised database developer experience, integration with the lakehouse, and simplified operations. It provides a managed Postgres transactional layer for application state and workloads that combine operational data, analytics, and AI. You'll join as one of the founding leaders building out both the Lakebase product and our London presence.

This is a Tech Lead Manager role: a hands-on technical leader who guides a small team of around five engineers while staying deep in the engineering work. You'll spend the majority of your time hands-on — driving architecture and design, solving the hardest problems in your team's projects, aligning with partner teams on dependencies, and writing code — and the rest leading and growing the engineers around you, who will report directly to you. It's  role for a strong senior engineer who wants to lead a team and take on people management without stepping away from the technical work.

  • Lakebase Proxy — Build the heart of the Lakebase data path, the network edge that every customer touches. The proxy handles all client connections and transfers every byte of query traffic, serving every data protocol: Postgres, HTTP, WebSockets, and the Data API. We route and manage large volumes of concurrent connections, solving load balancing, authentication, and data access at high throughput, with a focus on performance, observability, and reliability.
  • Lakebase Storage — Drive continuous delivery within a team of experts in storage technology, distributed systems, and Rust. We manage the development and rollout of storage services that host millions of customer databases across dozens of regions, partnering with peer engineering teams across Databricks to co-evolve Lakebase services with our global infrastructure, and leading operational excellence in the 24/7 operation of our system.

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

title: Technical Instructional Designer (AI Programmes)
descriptionHtml:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The opportunity

AI can draft a lesson in seconds. It can't tell you whether that lesson will actually land with a nervous career-switcher three weeks into a Data or AI apprenticeship — or whether the concept it just explained is subtly, but fundamentally, flawed.

That's where you come in.

You'll be the human judgement layer sitting on top of our AI-assisted content pipeline — part subject-matter expert, part instructional designer. You'll decide what AI got right, fix what it didn't, and build the parts no AI can: the high-touch, high-stakes, deeply human moments in a learner's journey that make the difference between content that's technically correct and content that actually changes someone's career.

You'll have experience building content in generative and agentic AI, Data Analytics, and Data Science — not just someone who's read about it, but someone who can explain it, question it, and know when the AI-generated explanation of a neural network is actually going to help a learner or quietly confuse them.

What you'll actually do

  • Design outcomes, not just content. Apply end-to-end backward design to build Data and AI programmes where success is measured by what learners can do on the job — not just what they can pass a test on. You'll own the hardest part: turning a job-aligned outcome into a curriculum that actually gets learners there.

  • Chase real-world impact, relentlessly. When a piece of learning isn't landing — when a Data Analyst cohort isn't showing the outcomes it should — you won't wait to be told. You'll spot it, own it, and scope the revisions that bring it up to the standard it needs to hit.

  • Build what AI can't. Design the custom, high-touch programmes and creative assets — branching narratives, bespoke multimedia, high-stakes onboarding moments — that need real human empathy, creativity, and nuance. If AI could've built it, it's not your job; if only a person could, it is.

  • Put AI to work, deliberately. Use AI tools and prompt engineering to accelerate your own content development and uncover learning design approaches nobody's tried yet. This isn't about using AI because it's there — it's about knowing exactly where it earns its place.

  • Advise up, not just build. Work directly with Programme Designers and senior stakeholders on the quality and pedagogical effectiveness of AI and human output. Your feedback doesn't stay in the room — it shapes how our AI rules and frameworks evolve.

  • Prototype for the long game. Lead new learning formats and modalities that don't exist yet — and know how to balance shipping fast against building something sustainable enough to reuse.

What you'll bring

  • Real command of end-to-end ADDIE and backward design — you've built measurable, job-aligned outcomes and the assessments that prove learners hit them, not just theoretical frameworks on a CV.

  • A habit of treating "good enough" as a starting point, not a finish line — you notice when learning isn't driving real outcomes, and you take the initiative to fix it.

  • Genuine fluency with AI-powered tools and prompt engineering, used to accelerate content development and find genuinely new applications in Data/AI learning design.

  • The ability to take a genuinely complex AI, Data Science, or Analytics concept and design a learning experience around it that actually works — for someone with zero technical background.

  • The confidence and track record to influence peers and senior stakeholders toward a specific, measurable curriculum improvement — not just raise a concern and move on.

  • Resilience when things don't go to plan — you can point to a time a project hit a real obstacle (a blocker, a shifting SME, a launch that missed the mark) and describe exactly what you did about it, and what you learned.

What gets you in the door

You'll need at least one of these:

  • Hands-on experience producing technical content for Data Science or generative/agentic AI.

  • 2+ years designing instructional content in a commercial environment or for commercial clients.

  • Plus one of:

    • A Data Science degree (or close cousin of one)

    • Completion of a technical apprenticeship in Data or AI

    • 2+ years working as a practitioner in Data or AI

If you're a strong technical practitioner who's never formally studied instructional design, or a seasoned learning designer who's spent the last year deep in AI tools — either path can get you here. We're looking for the judgment, not a checklist.

What we'll actually explore together

We're upfront about what our process looks for, because we'd rather you come prepared to talk about the real thing than guess what we want to hear. Across the conversations, we'll dig into:

  • Advanced curriculum & applied design — how you turn an end-to-end backward-design process into measurable, job-aligned outcomes, and how you build creative assets that genuinely need a human touch.

  • Impact & excellence — what you do when a piece of learning isn't hitting its real-world mark, and how you weigh speed against building something built to last.

  • AI integration & innovation — where and how you've put AI tools and prompt engineering to work, and what that's actually unlocked.

  • Influence & stakeholder management — how you've moved a curriculum forward through a genuine disagreement or feedback conversation, not just delivered a good pitch.

  • Coachability & resilience — how you've handled a launch that didn't land, or a project blocker outside your control, and what you changed as a result.

 

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!

title: Technischer Projektleiter Robotik & Physical AI (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft von Physical AI und Robotik!

Mit unserem Future Robotics Exploration Hub in Stuttgart bauen wir aktuell einen hersteller- und technologieunabhängiger Innovations- und Testraum für mobile und humanoide Robotik, Physical AI und industrielle Automatisierung der Zukunft auf. Unternehmen erproben im Hub Robotikplattformen, KI-Modelle, neuartige Sensorik und Greiftechnik anhand realer industrieller Anwendungsfälle. Ziel ist es, die flexible Fabrik von morgen zu gestalten.

Der Hub verbindet Datenerfassung mittels Motion Capture, Physical-AI-Training und Multi-Robot-Benchmarking. Im Mittelpunkt stehen industrielle Use Cases unter industrienahen Bedingungen, darunter Materialtransport, das Be- und Entladen von Maschinen sowie die Automatisierung von Montageschritten.

Wir sind das INC Innovation Center, ein internationales Team, das produzierende Unternehmen dabei unterstützt neue Technologien zu erschließen und innovative Ideen in die Praxis umzusetzen.

Für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Hubs suchen wir Menschen, die Lust haben, selbst anzupacken, technische Lösungen zu entwickeln und die Zukunft der Robotik aktiv mitzugestalten.

Ihre Mission

Sie bauen die technische Infrastruktur des Hubs auf und machen sie für unsere Anwendungs- und Technologiepartner sowie unser Entwicklungsteam nutzbar. Dabei verantworten Sie das Zusammenspiel von Robotik-Hardware und -Software, Sensorik, Greiftechnik, Datenpipelines und Automatisierungstechnik als integriertes Gesamtsystem.

Gemeinsam mit unserem Entwicklungsteam in Aachen und Stuttgart leiten Sie die technische Umsetzung industrieller Use Cases. Ihre Verantwortung reicht von der Anforderungsaufnahme über Architektur und Integration bis zur Inbetriebnahme, zum Benchmarking und zur Validierung.

Ein zentraler Fokus liegt auf Physical AI: Sie evaluieren und vergleichen aktuelle Foundation Models und Physical-AI-Modelle in verschiedenen Use-Case-Szenarien. Sie bereiten Modelle für konkrete industrielle Use Cases vor, passen sie durch anwendungsspezifisches Training/Fine-Tuning an und validieren ihre Leistungsfähigkeit in realen Robotik-Umgebungen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Aufbau, Integration und Betrieb der technischen Infrastruktur für Datenerfassung, Modelltraining, Simulation und die Umsetzung realer Use Cases mit Robotik- und Physical-AI-Systemen. Dazu gehören unter anderem Sensorik, Greiftechnik, Motion-Capture-Equipment, Edge-Devices sowie Cloud- und Datenplattformen.

  • Gemeinsame Ausgestaltung industrieller Use Cases mit Industriepartnern zur Erprobung mobiler und humanoider Roboter. Evaluation, Vergleich, Integration und Anpassung von Physical-AI-Modellen und Foundation Models für unterschiedliche Robotik-Hardwaresysteme. Durchführung von Machbarkeitsstudien, Benchmarks, Pilotprojekten und Validierungen unter industrienahen Bedingungen.

  • Aufbau von Trainingsworkflows für das Erlernen von Bewegungsabläufen durch verschiedene humanoide Robotiksysteme. Die Workflows umfassen reale Datenerfassung/Data-Capturing-Pipelines (z.B. mittels Teleoperationssystemen), Simulation, Datenaugmentation, Modelltraining sowie die Übertragung auf physische Robotik-Hardware.

  • Technische Leitung und Durchführung von Industrieprojekten im Hub gemeinsam mit dem technischen Team in Stuttgart und Aachen. Planung und Steuerung sprintorientierter Arbeitspakete entlang der gesamten Software- und Hardware-Toolchain. Koordination interner Teams, externer Technologiepartner und industrieller Kunden.

  • Entwicklung der technischen Roadmap sowie Identifikation neuer Technologien, Partner und Anwendungsfelder. Beratung von Industriepartnern sowie industriellen Kunden bei der technischen Vorbereitung, Umsetzung und Bewertung ihrer Robotik- und Physical-AI-Use-Cases.

Ihr Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Diplom- oder Masterstudium in Robotik, Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Maschinenbau, Automatisierungstechnik, Künstlicher Intelligenz oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich. Promotion ist wünschenswert, jedoch keine Voraussetzung.

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Robotikumfeld; idealerweise bringen Sie mehr als fünf Jahre Erfahrung mit. Besonders relevant sind Bezüge zu Robotik-Hardware, Robotik-Software, Automatisierung, Physical AI, Robot Learning, Sensorik, Simulation oder industriellen Anwendungsfällen.

  • Erfahrung in der technischen Projektleitung komplexer Projekte mit internen und externen Partnern.

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau, in der Integration und im Betrieb von Robotik-Infrastruktur oder Automatisierungssystemen. Dazu gehören Kenntnisse über Robotik-Hardware verschiedener Hersteller, Sensorik, Greiftechnik und Edge-Devices sowie über die Integration robotischer Gesamtsysteme.

  • Grundlegende Erfahrung mit ROS 2, Python und Linux sowie mit Simulationstools wie NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Lab oder MuJoCo beziehungsweise vergleichbaren Technologien.

  • Wünschenswert sind Erfahrungen mit Physical AI und Foundation Models, insbesondere VLA-Modellen, sowie mit robotischen Lernverfahren wie Imitation Learning und Reinforcement Learning. Erfahrung im Fine-Tuning von KI-Modellen und im Aufbau von Data-Capturing-Pipelines ist ebenfalls von Vorteil.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise

  • Hohes Eigenengagement, unternehmerisches Denken und die Energie, neue Themen proaktiv voranzutreiben.

  • Freude an einem dynamischen, sich schnell entwickelnden Umfeld und Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Fähigkeit, sich eigenständig in neue Technologien und Fachgebiete einzuarbeiten.

  • Offenheit für kontinuierliches Lernen, Experimentieren und Weiterentwicklung im Bereich Physical AI, Robot Learning und autonomer Robotik.

  • Sie möchten Gestaltungsspielraum nutzen, mit dem Hub wachsen und seine Zukunft aktiv mitprägen. Dabei sind Sie Teil eines Teams mit großem Entwicklungspotenzial.

Was wir bieten

  • Die Möglichkeit, einen hersteller- und technologieunabhängigen Physical-AI-Hub in Stuttgart von Beginn an aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Zugang zu mobiler und humanoider Robotik, Sensorik, Greiftechnik, Simulations- und KI-Infrastruktur.

  • Ein internationales Netzwerk aus Industrieunternehmen, Technologiepartnern, Startups und Forschungseinrichtungen.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau und bei der Weiterentwicklung des Hubs: Sie prägen die technische Roadmap, das Team und die Partnerschaften mit.

  • Die Stelle ist zunächst auf zwei Jahre befristet. Wir streben jedoch eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit an, sodass eine anschließende Entfristung ausdrücklich möglich ist.

Sie möchten den Future Robotics Exploration Hub aktiv mitgestalten? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihren Lebenslauf und ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben.
